jobs.title: GROWTH & MARKETING OPERATIONS
jobs.description: ABOUT LUMINA BUILD Lumina Build designs and constructs luxury villas and commercial projects in Bali for international investors and expatriate residents. Our projects are good. The marketing is currently invisible in the numbers. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Growth & Marketing Operations specialist to build the systems, tracking, and funnel infrastructure that turns our marketing activities into measurable results. You will own the systems behind our marketing performance — from landing pages and tracking to CRM automation, SEO foundations, and lead attribution. This is not a media buying role . We already have a media buyer. You set the numbers. You build the system. You prove what works. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Website & Landing Pages Manage the company website and build dedicated landing pages for every target audience. Structure landing pages around clear conversion objectives. Continuously improve website and landing page performance. Tracking & Attribution Build and maintain tracking systems so every lead has a clear and measurable source. Ensure marketing activities can be properly attributed to leads and conversions. Monitor and improve the accuracy of marketing data. CRM & Automation Own and manage HubSpot and related marketing operations. Build automation workflows, lead scoring, and follow-up sequences. Develop reporting systems to track funnel performance and lead quality. SEO & Website Performance Build the foundations of the company's SEO strategy. Monitor website performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Ensure technical and on-page SEO fundamentals are properly implemented. Lead Generation & Performance Establish the target cost per qualified lead (CPQL) . Work closely with the media buyer to ensure campaigns are executed against clear performance targets. Analyse funnel performance and identify where improvements can be made. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who understands growth through real numbers and hands-on execution . You have personally managed real advertising budgets . You can talk about cost per lead and campaign performance without being asked. You have built landing pages and installed tracking yourself. Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager are second nature to you. Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM is a strong advantage. Working proficiency in English , as most of our clients are international. A background in property, hospitality, or high-ticket products will be highly relevant. WHO FITS THIS ROLE? We are looking for someone who: Thinks in terms of funnels, conversion, attribution, and numbers . Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions. Is comfortable building systems from scratch. Can identify problems in a marketing funnel and work out how to fix them. Makes decisions based on data rather than vanity metrics. Can work independently while collaborating closely with the wider marketing team. WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This is not a media buying position . We already have a dedicated media buyer who executes campaigns. Your role is to: Define the performance targets. Build the tracking and attribution system. Build and optimise the funnel. Manage the CRM and automation. Measure and report the results. Make sure we know where our leads come from and what they cost . WHAT WE OFFER IDR 9–11 million per month , depending on experience. Full ownership of a marketing operations function being built from scratch. Budget and resources to build and improve the system. Direct access to the people making key business and marketing decisions. The opportunity to build the infrastructure behind the growth of a luxury property business in Bali. HOW TO APPLY Step 1 — Apply through JobStreet Submit your CV through JobStreet for the Growth & Marketing Operations position. Step 2 — Send additional requirements via WhatsApp After applying through JobStreet, please send the following to: Flo — HRD 📱 08•• •••• •249 Please include a short note covering: The last marketing funnel you personally built or managed. The cost per lead / qualified lead achieved by that funnel. A brief explanation of your role in building and optimising the funnel. A portfolio is optional. Numbers are not. Please note: This is a full-time, on-site position. Remote work is not available for this role.

jobs.title: Merchandiser
jobs.description: About the role This role involves comprehensive merchandising responsibilities across planogram management, inventory and stock management, sales analysis and reporting, product and assortment planning, promotion and campaign execution, visual merchandising execution, store coordination and communication, supplier and vendor coordination, pricing and product information management, and market and competitor analysis. Key responsibilities Analyze market trends and consumer behavior to support sales strategies. Coordinate with Warehouse team, marketing, and sales teams for product launches and promotions, and stock availability. Determine product placement, shelf arrangement, and number of facings to maximize visibility and sales. jobs.description: Kualifikasi Utama: Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK (diutamakan jurusan Perhotelan/Tata Graha). Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di posisi yang sama (pengalaman di hotel bintang 3/4 diutamakan). Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar jika memiliki pengalaman on-the-job training (OJT) yang relevan. Memahami standar kebersihan area kamar ( room cleaning ), area publik ( public area ), serta penanganan linen & laundry . Memiliki etos kerja yang tinggi, jujur, teliti, dan ramah. Siap bekerja dengan sistem shift , akhir pekan, dan hari libur nasional. Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan: Memastikan kebersihan, kerapian, dan kelengkapan kamar tamu sesuai dengan standar SOP perhotelan. Mengatur dan mengontrol pemakaian perlengkapan kamar ( guest amenities ) serta linen . Menjaga kebersihan dan kerapian area publik ( Public Area ) di sekitar lingkungan hotel. Melaporkan setiap kerusakan fasilitas atau barang hilang/tertinggal kepada Supervisor Housekeeping. Memberikan pelayanan yang ramah, cepat, dan responsif terhadap kebutuhan tamu.

jobs.title: BRAND & CONTENT SPECIALIST
jobs.description: ABOUT LUMINA BUILD Lumina Build designs and constructs luxury villas and commercial projects across Bali. Our clients are primarily international private owners, developers, and hospitality operators. Our projects range from private villas to commercial developments, including wellness and spa facilities. The construction work is strong. The visibility is not. This role exists to close that gap. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Brand & Content Specialist to build and protect the Lumina Build brand while producing content that demonstrates the quality of our projects. This is a hands-on creative role . You will work directly with the Head of Marketing and Partnership and regularly visit our construction sites with a camera. This is not a scheduling-only role. You create. You shoot. You edit. You publish. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Brand Build and maintain the Lumina Build brand identity system, including logo, colour, typography, and visual patterns. Develop and maintain brand guidelines covering usage rules and standards. Define and document the brand voice, tone, and messaging pillars. Produce a bilingual company profile in English and Indonesian. Produce an annual portfolio lookbook in both print and digital formats. Maintain brand consistency across all channels, documents, and client-facing materials. Create branded templates for proposals, partner kits, and sales collateral. Content Own the content calendar and publish 12 pieces of content per month across our channels. Plan and execute construction site shoots, including drone, timelapse, walkthrough, and handover photography. Shoot and edit videos, reels, carousels, and short-form content. Produce written and visual case studies for every completed project. Write website project pages, blog articles, and SEO content. Produce creative assets for paid social media campaigns. Manage and organise the company's photo and video asset library. Capture client testimonials and project handover moments. REQUIREMENTS Minimum 2 years of experience in content production, brand, or creative marketing. Able to shoot and edit independently , not only plan or schedule. Proficient in CapCut for video editing. Proficient in Canva or Figma for design and layout. Working proficiency in English and Indonesian , both written and spoken. A portfolio that includes video work , not only static designs. Comfortable working on active construction sites. Own a laptop capable of video editing. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Background or experience in property, hospitality, architecture, or interior design . Experience with drone operation . Experience producing brand guidelines or visual identity systems . Photography experience, particularly in architecture or interiors . WHO FITS THIS ROLE? We are looking for someone who: Brings ideas rather than waiting for a brief. Thinks out loud and is comfortable sharing work before it is finished. Can run a site visit independently without supervision. Takes ownership of how the work looks and feels. Is comfortable working toward quarterly milestones. WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This role does not include: Ad budget management or media buying. Inbox and comment management, which is handled by our media buyer. Lead qualification and sales. Partner and client relationship management. WHAT WE OFFER Permanent employment with BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. A defined quarterly milestone plan developed together with the Head of Marketing and Partnership. Full creative ownership of a brand being built from the ground up. Equipment and production budget provided. Direct access to real projects, construction sites, and clients. HOW TO APPLY Step 1 — Apply through JobStreet Submit your CV through JobStreet for the Brand & Content Specialist position. Step 2 — Send additional requirements via WhatsApp After applying through JobStreet, please send the following to: Flo — HRD 📱 08•• •••• •249 Please include: Portfolio link — your portfolio must include video work, not only static designs. One piece of work you personally created , together with 2–3 sentences explaining why and how you edited or created it . Applications without a portfolio link will not be reviewed. Follower counts will not tell us anything. Show us what your work did.

jobs.title: WORKSHOP DEVELOPMENT LEAD (WSL)
jobs.description: PT KORA PRIMA ABADI Penempatan: Sulawesi Tengah, Sulawasi Utara, Riau (North), Riau (South), Jawa Tengah, Jambi PT KORA PRIMA ABADI membuka kesempatan bagi kandidat yang berpengalaman dan memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan untuk bergabung sebagai Workshop Development Lead (WSL) . Posisi ini bertanggung jawab secara end-to-end dalam membangun, mengembangkan, dan memastikan Workshop KORA beroperasi secara penuh, stabil, serta mencapai target perusahaan , mulai dari pencarian lokasi, pengembangan supply, produksi, hingga penjualan. JOB DESCRIPTION Memimpin proses setup Workshop KORA dari awal hingga beroperasi penuh dan stabil . Mencari dan mengidentifikasi lokasi/lahan potensial untuk pembangunan workshop. Memastikan kelengkapan dokumen lahan dan dokumen pemilik tanah yang diperlukan dalam proses pembukaan workshop. Membangun dan mengembangkan jaringan supply bahan baku , termasuk petani, supplier kelapa, pengepul, dan sumber supply lainnya. Memastikan ketersediaan dan kontinuitas bahan baku sesuai kebutuhan dan target workshop. Bertanggung jawab terhadap produksi produk KORA , termasuk pencapaian target produksi dan kualitas. Bertanggung jawab terhadap penjualan produk KORA dan pencapaian target sales workshop. Membangun dan menjaga hubungan serta jaringan langsung dengan supplier dan buyer di wilayah penugasan. Memimpin dan mengawasi seluruh aktivitas operasional workshop di wilayah yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya. Menjalin dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan pemilik lahan, masyarakat, perangkat daerah, mitra, supplier, buyer, dan stakeholder terkait . Memastikan seluruh aspek workshop berjalan dengan baik sejak tahap setup hingga mencapai kondisi operasional yang stabil. Bertanggung jawab terhadap seluruh aset PT KORA PRIMA ABADI yang berada dalam workshop di bawah tanggung jawabnya. Memastikan seluruh aktivitas workshop dilaporkan kepada KORA Head Office (HO) secara akurat, transparan, jujur, dan tepat waktu . REQUIREMENTS Memiliki pengalaman di bidang operasional, business development, supply chain, procurement, sales, atau pengembangan bisnis/area . Pengalaman di bidang pengolahan kelapa dan/atau produk turunannya menjadi nilai tambah (advantage). Memiliki kemampuan dan pengalaman dalam membangun serta menjalankan operasional dari nol menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki networking langsung dengan petani, supplier, pengepul, trader, buyer, atau pelaku usaha komoditas , khususnya kelapa dan produk turunannya, menjadi nilai tambah utama. Memahami proses sourcing bahan baku, produksi, dan penjualan . Memiliki kemampuan leadership, problem solving, negosiasi, dan komunikasi yang baik. Terbiasa bekerja dengan target supply, produksi, dan sales . Mampu bekerja secara mandiri serta mengambil keputusan dan menyelesaikan permasalahan di lapangan. Memiliki integritas tinggi, jujur, bertanggung jawab, dan transparan dalam pelaporan . Mampu membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan masyarakat, supplier, buyer, mitra bisnis, serta stakeholder daerah. Memiliki pemahaman mengenai komoditas kelapa/kopra dan jaringan lokal menjadi nilai tambah. Bersedia bekerja secara mobile dan ditempatkan di wilayah Workshop KORA sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan. Website: koracoconut.com

jobs.title: Module Coordinator
jobs.description: The Module Coordinator will oversee the entire lifecycle of module fabrication projects, coordinating with clients and subcontractors. They will enforce HSE protocols, conduct audits, and engage with the workforce. This role requires strong leadership and organizational skills to manage project teams and ensure timely delivery while adhering to quality standards. Manage and coordinate EPCC module fabrication projects, ensuring compliance with contractual specifications and quality standards. Enforce HSE policies, conduct safety audits, and organize campaigns and drills to promote a safe work environment. Perform weekly HSE inspections, focusing on critical areas, and engage with on-site staff for continuous improvement. Liaise with clients and subcontractors, ensuring effective communication and smooth project execution. Review construction progress against project schedules, providing regular updates to the Project Management Team. Schedule and review work assignments, ensuring efficient and timely completion by the project team. Maintain an organized filing system for all project documentation, including drawings and reports. Oversee module fabrication and assembly, ensuring adherence to the integration scope of work. Identify and participate in constructability reviews to optimize project outcomes and identify potential risks. Prepare and issue meeting minutes, presentation materials, and reports to keep stakeholders informed. Diploma in Engineering or a related field, with a minimum of 10 years' experience in project coordination, engineering, or project management. Proven experience in EPCC module projects, especially in the Marine or Oil & Gas industry. Knowledge of topside modules fabrication, oil and gas processes, and construction practices is essential. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with strong presentation and reporting abilities. Leadership and supervisory skills to effectively manage and motivate a diverse project team. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, handle pressure, and meet tight project deadlines. Proactive approach, with good interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with various stakeholders. Adaptable to changing project requirements and a willingness to learn and grow. Proficiency in project management software and MS Office applications is a must. A strong understanding of HSE protocols and a commitment to safety in the workplace.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Design, develop, test, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple data sources. Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and data transformation logic. Build and maintain data integration workflows for data warehouses and data lakes. Perform data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading while ensuring data accuracy and consistency. Analyze source systems and create source-to-target mapping documentation. Monitor ETL jobs, troubleshoot failures, and optimize pipeline performance. Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and error-handling processes. Collaborate with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements. Document ETL processes, technical specifications, and data flows. Support deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of data integration solutions. Follow software development best practices, including version control, code reviews, and CI/CD where applicable.

jobs.title: live host/live streamer
jobs.description: . Tugas Selama Live Streaming Mulai dan akhiri live tepat waktu sesuai jadwal, penuhi durasi live yang ditentukan. Sebelum live, periksa perlengkapan: pencahayaan, suara, jaringan, sampel produk, tabel ukuran dan perlengkapan live lainnya. Tunjukkan produk dengan cara mencobanya langsung, jelaskan keunggulan pakaian dalam: efek push up/menyangkut payudara, bahan, model, ukuran, kenyamanan pakai, tunjukkan hasil pemakaian, jawab pertanyaan penonton secara real-time (tentang ukuran, bahan, pengiriman, layanan purna jual dll). Kendalikan ritme ruang live, ajak penonton tetap menonton, minta penonton tulis ukuran di kolom komentar, dorong pembelian, arahkan penonton klik keranjang kuning untuk checkout, tingkatkan GMV, rasio klik dan rasio konversi ruang live. Jaga suasana ruang live, tangani komentar negatif dengan baik; bekerja sama dengan tim operasional jelaskan kupon, promo dan hadiah, dukung operasi pop-up, buka stok dan lain-lain. Ikuti evaluasi setelah setiap sesi live, catat pertanyaan yang sering muncul dari penonton, perbaiki skrip bicara live.

jobs.title: Quality Analyst (Contract)
jobs.description: Job Responsibility: Perform all quality control testing activities for raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Conduct batch checks, incoming goods inspections, and outgoing goods inspections. Complete all quality records in accordance with standard specifications. Handle customer complaints and report them to the Quality Team Leader. Support the Quality Team Leader in preparing documents related to quality activities. Prepare documents such as Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and other related documents. Apply ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and Halal Assurance System requirements in daily activities. Apply continuous improvement principles and Total Productive Maintenance practices in daily activities Requirement: Diploma in Chemical Analysis or bachelor's degree in chemistry or related field with strong Chemistry component, with experience min. 1 year in a QA/QC chemical laboratory. Able to work on Quality Management in SAP. Having knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, good documentation practice, good laboratory practice, Halal Assurance System, TPM (kaizen, 5S, PQ Pillar). Able to work using RCA tools. Proactive and able to work under dynamic circumstances. Able to communicate in English. Willing to be place in Ecolab Cikarang Plant and Citeureup Plant

jobs.title: Revit Content Author
jobs.description: Revit Content Author We're looking for a Revit Content Author to create high-quality parametric BIM objects for manufacturers' products. This is a production-focused role where you'll be responsible for developing accurate, efficient, and well-structured Revit Families (RFA files) that meet company standards and support architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. If you enjoy creating clean, intelligent Revit content and have a passion for precision and technical excellence, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Do Create parametric Revit Families (RFA files) from manufacturers' product information. Develop BIM content that is accurate, lightweight, and easy for customers to use. Configure family parameters, formulas, constraints, and types to ensure correct functionality. Add and maintain product data and metadata within Revit families. Produce high-quality 2D and 3D representations in accordance with BIM standards. Perform quality assurance checks to ensure technical accuracy, performance, and consistency. Update and maintain existing BIM objects as manufacturers' products evolve. Collaborate with technical content teams to resolve product and modelling queries. Deliver BIM content within agreed production targets and project deadlines. What We're Looking For Essential Strong experience creating Revit Families from scratch . Excellent knowledge of Autodesk Revit and parametric family creation. Strong understanding of family parameters, formulas, nested families, and visibility controls. High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work. Ability to manage multiple tasks and consistently meet production deadlines. Good written and verbal communication skills. Nice to Have Experience creating manufacturer-specific BIM content. Experience developing architectural, MEP, or structural Revit families. Understanding of BIM standards, workflows, and industry best practices. Knowledge of IFC classification and product data standards. Experience using shared parameters, schedules, and BIM data management processes. Familiarity with BIM object publishing platforms and digital content libraries. What Success Looks Like In this role, you'll be successful by: Delivering high-quality Revit Families accurately and on schedule. Producing robust, efficient, and user-friendly BIM objects. Maintaining excellent quality standards with minimal QA revisions. Achieving strong productivity while ensuring technical precision and consistency. Why Join Us? Work on projects that support leading manufacturers across the global construction industry. Be part of a collaborative team focused on innovation and digital transformation. Develop your expertise in BIM content creation and industry best practices. Enjoy opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth. If you're passionate about creating exceptional BIM content and want to help shape the future of digital construction, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager (Jawa Tengah)
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan: Membuat sales pipeline dan sales forecast. Mengatur alokasi area dan pekerjaan retail sales. Memonitor aktivitas serta pencapaian target retail sales. Membina dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan distributor. Melakukan analisis terhadap potensi distributor baru, distributor existing, dan peluang pasar. Melakukan pendekatan kepada calon distributor baru untuk mendukung pengembangan jaringan distribusi. Berkoordinasi dengan AR Collection terkait proses dan tagihan distributor. Menyampaikan informasi mengenai program sales dan marketing yang sedang berlangsung kepada distributor. Melakukan review kinerja dan development kepada tim. Persyaratan Pekerjaan: Minimal pendidikan D3 dari semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 3 tahun di bidang retail sales (industri bahan bangunan diutamakan). Mampu mengelola dan membina tim sales serta melakukan monitoring terhadap pencapaian target. Memiliki kemampuan sales planning, sales forecasting, dan territory management. Mampu membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan distributor, toko, pelanggan, dan mitra bisnis. Mampu bekerja dengan target dan deadline serta memiliki orientasi pada hasil. Percaya diri, gigih, dan berinisiatif dalam menjalankan pekerjaan. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas dan kunjungan ke area/toko/distributor sesuai kebutuhan pekerjaan. Bersedia ditempatkan di area Jawa Tengah dan sekitarnya.

jobs.title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: About Hubexo At Hubexo, we connect the construction market to help the world build better. Our unique data, insights and software solutions help customers in the construction industry sell more, improve efficiency and build more sustainably. As we continue to transform our technology landscape, we are looking for a DevOps & Cloud Engineer to help build secure, scalable and reliable cloud platforms that support our global product portfolio. About the Role As a DevOps & Cloud Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing and improving the cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities that enable Hubexo's engineering teams to deliver software faster, safer and more consistently. This is more than a traditional infrastructure role. You'll work across cloud engineering, platform engineering, automation, CI/CD, observability, security and developer experience, while also helping establish the technical foundations for Hubexo's future AI-assisted and Agentic AI engineering workflows. You'll collaborate with engineering, architecture, security and delivery teams across our global organisation to build reliable platforms, reduce manual work and create scalable ways of working. What You'll Do Cloud & Platform Engineering Design, deploy and manage secure, scalable and highly available cloud infrastructure. Build and improve cloud environments across development, staging and production. Work with engineering teams to integrate cloud services into the software development lifecycle. Improve platform reliability, scalability, performance and maintainability. Establish reusable and standardised platform capabilities that can be adopted across products. Developer Experience & Engineering Enablement Build tools and platform capabilities that help developers move faster and work more efficiently. Develop self-service infrastructure patterns, reusable templates and standardised deployment practices. Reduce manual operational work through automation and platform standards. Partner with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, Delivery teams and the DevOps leadership team to improve engineering flow and operational readiness. Automation & CI/CD Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Ansible, CloudFormation or equivalent. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery. Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployments, monitoring and operational processes. Integrate cloud infrastructure, repositories, pipelines, secrets management and deployment workflows. Observability & Reliability Implement and improve monitoring, logging, alerting and observability across cloud platforms and services. Create visibility into system health, infrastructure usage, deployment performance and operational risks. Support incident investigation, root cause analysis and reliability improvements. Develop operational dashboards and metrics to help teams proactively identify issues. Security, Identity & Access Implement security controls across cloud infrastructure, including IAM, encryption, network security and secrets management. Establish secure access models for users, services, pipelines and AI agents. Work with Security and IT teams to ensure cloud platforms meet company security and governance standards. Support access reviews, security assessments and remediation activities. Agentic AI & AI Engineering Enablement Help build the technical foundations required for AI-assisted and Agentic AI workflows. Support the implementation of identity, access, observability and execution controls for AI agents. Work with Architecture, Security and Engineering teams to establish safe and scalable operating patterns for AI agents. Help develop practical guardrails covering access boundaries, data handling, auditability and operational accountability. Explore and support emerging AI engineering technologies and platforms. Cloud Cost & Performance Optimisation Monitor cloud usage and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilisation. Support FinOps practices, resource tagging and cloud cost visibility. Identify performance bottlenecks and infrastructure risks. Support capacity planning and recommend improvements to scalability, reliability and cost efficiency. What We're Looking For Essential Proven experience designing, deploying and managing production cloud infrastructure. Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure and/or AWS. Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Bicep, Ansible, CloudFormation or similar. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software deployment practices. Good understanding of cloud networking, including VNET/VPC, DNS, VPN, load balancing, firewalls, private endpoints and network security. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and observability. Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar. Experience improving developer experience through self-service infrastructure, reusable templates and automation. Strong understanding of cloud security, identity and access management. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to improving systems and processes. Good professional English communication skills. Nice to Have Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimisation and resource tagging. Experience with Kubernetes, containers or container orchestration. About Hubexo

At Hubexo, we connect the construction market to help the world build better. Our unique data, insights and software solutions help customers in the construction industry sell more, improve efficiency and build more sustainably.

As we continue to transform our technology landscape, we are looking for a DevOps & Cloud Engineer to help build secure, scalable and reliable cloud platforms that support our global product portfolio.

About the Role

As a DevOps & Cloud Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing and improving the cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities that enable Hubexo's engineering teams to deliver software faster, safer and more consistently.

This is more than a traditional infrastructure role. You'll work across cloud engineering, platform engineering, automation, CI/CD, observability, security and developer experience, while also helping establish the technical foundations for Hubexo's future AI-assisted and Agentic AI engineering workflows.

You'll collaborate with engineering, architecture, security and delivery teams across our global organisation to build reliable platforms, reduce manual work and create scalable ways of working.


What You'll Do

Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Design, deploy and manage secure, scalable and highly available cloud infrastructure.

  • Build and improve cloud environments across development, staging and production.

  • Work with engineering teams to integrate cloud services into the software development lifecycle.

  • Improve platform reliability, scalability, performance and maintainability.

  • Establish reusable and standardised platform capabilities that can be adopted across products.

Developer Experience & Engineering Enablement

  • Build tools and platform capabilities that help developers move faster and work more efficiently.

  • Develop self-service infrastructure patterns, reusable templates and standardised deployment practices.

  • Reduce manual operational work through automation and platform standards.

  • Partner with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, Delivery teams and the DevOps leadership team to improve engineering flow and operational readiness.

Automation & CI/CD

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Ansible, CloudFormation or equivalent.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery.

  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployments, monitoring and operational processes.

  • Integrate cloud infrastructure, repositories, pipelines, secrets management and deployment workflows.

Observability & Reliability

  • Implement and improve monitoring, logging, alerting and observability across cloud platforms and services.

  • Create visibility into system health, infrastructure usage, deployment performance and operational risks.

  • Support incident investigation, root cause analysis and reliability improvements.

  • Develop operational dashboards and metrics to help teams proactively identify issues.

Security, Identity & Access

  • Implement security controls across cloud infrastructure, including IAM, encryption, network security and secrets management.

  • Establish secure access models for users, services, pipelines and AI agents.

  • Work with Security and IT teams to ensure cloud platforms meet company security and governance standards.

  • Support access reviews, security assessments and remediation activities.

Agentic AI & AI Engineering Enablement

  • Help build the technical foundations required for AI-assisted and Agentic AI workflows.

  • Support the implementation of identity, access, observability and execution controls for AI agents.

  • Work with Architecture, Security and Engineering teams to establish safe and scalable operating patterns for AI agents.

  • Help develop practical guardrails covering access boundaries, data handling, auditability and operational accountability.

  • Explore and support emerging AI engineering technologies and platforms.

Cloud Cost & Performance Optimisation

  • Monitor cloud usage and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilisation.

  • Support FinOps practices, resource tagging and cloud cost visibility.

  • Identify performance bottlenecks and infrastructure risks.

  • Support capacity planning and recommend improvements to scalability, reliability and cost efficiency.


What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Proven experience designing, deploying and managing production cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Bicep, Ansible, CloudFormation or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software deployment practices.

  • Good understanding of cloud networking, including VNET/VPC, DNS, VPN, load balancing, firewalls, private endpoints and network security.

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and observability.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar.

  • Experience improving developer experience through self-service infrastructure, reusable templates and automation.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security, identity and access management.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to improving systems and processes.

  • Good professional English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimisation and resource tagging.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers or container orchestration.

  • Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms.

  • Experience supporting AI/Agentic AI engineering workflows.

  • Exposure to technologies such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel or similar AI engineering ecosystems.

  • Experience working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot.

  • Experience working in a global or multi-market technology organisation.

  • Experience establishing platform standards, engineering guardrails or developer self-service capabilities.


Why Join Hubexo?

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the evolution of a global technology organisation.

You will work at the intersection of cloud engineering, platform engineering, automation, developer experience and AI, with the opportunity to influence how Hubexo builds, deploys and operates technology at scale.

You'll have the opportunity to work on modern cloud infrastructure while helping establish the foundations for the next generation of AI-assisted engineering and Agentic AI workflows.

Dream Big – Embrace ambitious goals and strive to exceed expectations.
Thrive Together – Collaborate, communicate and celebrate success.
Own It – Take ownership and make a difference.
Do the Right Thing – Let integrity guide your actions.

jobs.title: Maintenance (Injection Molding)
jobs.description: Maintenance (Injection Molding) Deskripsi Pekerjaan Melaksanakan preventive maintenance dan corrective maintenance pada mesin Injection Molding beserta peralatan pendukung. Melakukan troubleshooting serta perbaikan kerusakan mesin secara cepat dan tepat untuk meminimalkan downtime produksi. Melakukan inspeksi rutin terhadap kondisi mesin, mould, chiller, compressor, hopper dryer, conveyor, dan utility lainnya. Melakukan penggantian spare part yang mengalami kerusakan atau keausan. Membuat laporan hasil perawatan, perbaikan, dan penggunaan spare part. Berkoordinasi dengan bagian Produksi, QC, dan Engineering untuk memastikan kelancaran proses produksi. Menjaga kebersihan area kerja serta menerapkan standar 5R/5S dan K3. Melaksanakan pekerjaan sesuai dengan SOP, WI, dan standar keselamatan kerja perusahaan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMK/D3 Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Teknik Mekatronika, Teknik Industri, atau jurusan yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Maintenance di perusahaan Plastic Injection Molding. Memahami sistem kerja mesin Injection Molding (Haitian, MayaJieli atau merek sejenis). Memahami sistem mekanik, hidrolik, pneumatik, dan kelistrikan mesin industri. Mampu melakukan preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, dan troubleshooting mesin produksi. Mampu membaca wiring diagram, mechanical drawing, dan pneumatic diagram. Memahami sistem utilitas pabrik seperti air compressor, chiller, cooling tower, hopper dryer, robot take-out, conveyor, dan peralatan pendukung lainnya menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai PLC, inverter (VFD), servo motor, sensor industri, serta sistem kontrol mesin menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami penerapan TPM (Total Productive Maintenance), 5S/5R, dan K3. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim, memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik, serta mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift apabila diperlukan. Memiliki pribadi yang jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, teliti, memiliki inisiatif tinggi, serta berkomitmen terhadap keselamatan kerja. Penempatan Bandara Mas, Kota Tangerang (Selapajang Jaya/Neglasari) Diutamakan kandidat yang memiliki kemampuan melakukan analisis akar penyebab kerusakan (Root Cause Analysis) dan mampu memberikan solusi untuk mencegah kerusakan berulang.

jobs.title: Staff Trainer
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Utama Merancang dan mengembangkan program pelatihan yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan organisasi dan kompetensi karyawan. Melaksanakan sesi pelatihan dengan metode pengajaran yang interaktif dan menarik untuk memastikan partisipasi aktif peserta. Mengevaluasi efektivitas program pelatihan melalui umpan balik peserta dan pengukuran pencapaian tujuan pembelajaran. Mengidentifikasi kebutuhan pelatihan melalui analisis kesenjangan kompetensi dan diskusi dengan departemen terkait. Menyiapkan materi pelatihan, modul pembelajaran, dan sumber daya pendukung dalam berbagai format. Memfasilitasi pengembangan keterampilan teknis dan soft skills bagi semua level karyawan. Memelihara dokumentasi pelatihan dan mengelola database peserta pelatihan. Berkolaborasi dengan manajemen untuk menyelaraskan program pelatihan dengan strategi pengembangan karyawan jangka panjang. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal Diploma atau Sarjana di bidang Sumber Daya Manusia, Pelatihan dan Pengembangan, Psikologi, Pendidikan, atau bidang terkait. Pengalaman minimal 1-5 tahun sebagai Trainer, Instruktur, atau posisi sejenis di industri retail atau manufaktur. Kemampuan presentasi dan komunikasi yang sangat baik untuk menyampaikan konten pelatihan secara efektif. Pengetahuan mendalam tentang metode dan teknik pembelajaran modern, termasuk pembelajaran digital dan e-learning. Keahlian dalam menggunakan platform Learning Management System (LMS) dan alat desain instruksional. Kemampuan analitis untuk mengevaluasi kebutuhan pelatihan dan mengukur hasil pembelajaran. Keterampilan manajemen proyek untuk menangani beberapa inisiatif pelatihan secara bersamaan. Pengalaman yang disukai dalam merancang program pelatihan untuk industri retail atau layanan pelanggan. jobs.title: Quality Assurance - HUB Sukaraja
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Melakukan pemeriksaan kualitas produk fresh, frozen, dan produk sejenis pada saat proses inbound maupun selama penyimpanan di hub. Melakukan pengecekan dan pencatatan suhu penyimpanan pada chiller, freezer, dan area ambient sesuai dengan jadwal serta prosedur yang berlaku. Memastikan produk disimpan sesuai kategori dan standar penyimpanan yang benar untuk menjaga kualitas produk. Mengumpulkan, mencatat, dan mendokumentasikan hasil pemeriksaan kualitas, suhu penyimpanan, serta kondisi stok sebagai bahan evaluasi. Menyusun dan menyampaikan laporan harian terkait hasil inspeksi kualitas produk, suhu penyimpanan, dan status stok kepada pihak terkait.

jobs.title: Order Management and Billing  (Contract)
jobs.description: JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Support CS Manager and current CS Supervisor to in the process Order to Cash process (O2C) in Indonesia, including receiving orders up to billing and collection, including order processing & deliveries, invoicing, cross division communication, handling routine and complex inquiries and complaints. Supporting CS Manager and other CS Supervisor managing CS associates who base in several locations across Indonesia (Bali, Cikarang, Citeureup and Surabaya) to serve 9 divisions in Indonesia (Manufacturing, Basic Industries, Mining, Downstream, Paper, Institutional, F&B, QSR and PEST). Coordinating and working closely with Finance (AR) Team as part of DSO continuous improvement project with highlight on reducing billing process lead time, reducing unbilled under ship & bill/contract service/project, reducing bad debt and collecting more from customers. Take charge of all monthly reporting related to CS operation (example: DIFOT, Freight Policy tracking, ZDI - CN report, Delivery Not Yet Invoice, monthly clean up OOR, etc) including working on sales report (accrual) with Finance Team. Work closely with Sales Team, Demand Planning and Supply Planning Team to ensure stock, order and forecast are aligned including attending Sales meeting & coordinating. Monitoring and following up POD (signed return DO) to the Distribution Team and Sales Team/Customer Provide data tracking of billing progress to related parties for all contract service, consignment, once off, equipment and milestone project billing. Send complete document including POD, completion report, PO / Contract and other supporting documents to CS Billing Team for the invoicing process. Work closely with 3PL warehouse Team. JOB REQUIREMENTS: Minimum Bachelor's Degree from any Major, an Accounting & Management major is preferred Minimum of 2 years' experience in order management & billing, sales, or administrative experience. Must have supervisory experience which includes the ability to work effectively and resolve customer and sales problems Having advanced Excel skills, other software skills such as Power BI, MS Access, etc will be plus Having hands-on experience in ERP especially SAP will be an advantage Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment Excellent negotiation skills with the ability to build strong relationships with internal stakeholders Proven ability to articulate complex concepts clearly, both in writing and presentations Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to improving supply performance Fluent in English (both verbal and written) Willing to be placed in Ecolab Cikarang Plant and Citeureup Plant

  • Send complete document including POD, completion report, PO / Contract and other supporting documents to CS Billing Team for the invoicing process.

  • Work closely with 3PL warehouse Team.

  • Minimum Bachelor's Degree from any Major, an Accounting & Management major is preferred

  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in order management & billing, sales, or administrative experience. Must have supervisory experience which includes the ability to work effectively and resolve customer and sales problems

  • Having advanced Excel skills, other software skills such as Power BI, MS Access, etc will be plus

  • Having hands-on experience in ERP especially SAP will be an advantage

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

  • Excellent negotiation skills with the ability to build strong relationships with internal stakeholders

  • Proven ability to articulate complex concepts clearly, both in writing and presentations

  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to improving supply performance

  • Fluent in English (both verbal and written)

  • Willing to be placed in Ecolab Cikarang Plant and Citeureup Plant

jobs.title: Inventory Control - Hub Sukaraja
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Memastikan kendaraan pengiriman dalam kondisi mesin mati saat proses inbound barang berlangsung. Melakukan proses bongkar muat barang sesuai dengan prosedur operasional. Memeriksa kesesuaian antara surat jalan dengan barang yang diterima secara fisik. Melakukan pengecekan dan pencatatan suhu freezer serta chiller secara berkala sesuai jadwal. Melakukan pengecekan stok fisik (Stock Opname) terhadap barang yang diterima pada saat proses inbound. Mendokumentasikan setiap ketidaksesuaian, seperti kelebihan barang, kekurangan barang, atau barang bad stock. Menginput jumlah barang yang diterima dan barang yang tidak diterima ke dalam sistem WMS (Warehouse Management System). Menata dan menyimpan barang sesuai dengan metode FEFO (First Expired, First Out) dan FIFO (First In, First Out). Melakukan pengukuran suhu sebanyak 2 kali setiap shift serta mencatat hasilnya pada formulir yang telah disediakan. Melakukan dokumentasi proses disposal (pemusnahan) untuk produk bad stock sesuai prosedur perusahaan.

jobs.title: Field Collection
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari profesional Field Collection yang berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim FIFGROUP di Semarang, Jawa Tengah. Sebagai Field Collection, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengelola dan mengumpulkan pembayaran dari pelanggan kami, memastikan kelancaran operasional finansial perusahaan. Posisi ini merupakan jabatan penuh waktu yang memerlukan dedikasi tinggi, integritas, dan kemampuan berinteraksi langsung dengan pelanggan di lapangan. Anda akan menjadi garis depan dalam mempertahankan hubungan baik dengan pelanggan sambil memastikan target koleksi tercapai. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan kunjungan lapangan secara rutin ke lokasi pelanggan untuk mengumpulkan pembayaran cicilan dan mencatat transaksi dengan akurat. Mengelola data pelanggan dan transaksi koleksi dengan teliti menggunakan sistem yang telah ditetapkan perusahaan. Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan profesional yang baik dengan pelanggan untuk meningkatkan kepuasan dan loyalitas. Menangani tunggakan pembayaran dengan pendekatan yang profesional dan empati terhadap kondisi pelanggan. Melaporkan hasil koleksi harian dan mengidentifikasi pelanggan dengan risiko default tinggi untuk tindakan lanjutan. Memverifikasi dokumen dan data pelanggan sesuai dengan prosedur perusahaan. Mencapai target koleksi bulanan yang telah ditetapkan oleh manajemen. Menjaga keamanan dana yang dikumpulkan dan memastikan laporan kas yang akurat. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara, dengan preferensi terhadap kandidat yang memiliki pendidikan formal di bidang akuntansi atau administrasi. Pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun dalam posisi koleksi, customer service, atau penjualan di industri retail atau consumer products. Keterampilan komunikasi yang sangat baik dan kemampuan untuk bernegosiasi dengan bijak dan profesional. Integritas tinggi, kejujuran, dan tanggung jawab dalam mengelola uang dan data pelanggan. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dengan fokus pada pencapaian target. Mobilitas tinggi dan kesediaan untuk bekerja di lapangan dalam berbagai kondisi cuaca. Penguasaan sistem komputasi dasar dan aplikasi mobile yang digunakan untuk pelaporan koleksi. Kemampuan analitis untuk mengidentifikasi pola pembayaran dan risiko default pelanggan. Bersikap profesional, jujur, dan mampu menangani situasi yang sulit dengan tenang. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dengan insentif koleksi berbasis performa untuk meningkatkan penghasilan Anda. Tunjangan transportasi dan operasional untuk mendukung aktivitas di lapangan. Asuransi kesehatan yang komprehensif mencakup Anda dan keluarga inti. Program keselamatan kerja yang komprehensif dan standar perlindungan untuk karyawan lapangan. Peluang pengembangan karier melalui program pelatihan internal dan sertifikasi profesional. Budaya kerja yang inklusif dengan kesempatan untuk berkembang bersama tim yang solid dan berpengalaman. Jaminan social security sesuai dengan regulasi pemerintah Indonesia. Lingkungan kerja yang menghargai kinerja dan memberikan pengakuan kepada karyawan berprestasi. Tentang FIFGROUP FIFGROUP adalah perusahaan terkemuka di industri retail dan consumer products Indonesia dengan reputasi yang solid dalam memberikan layanan terbaik kepada jutaan pelanggan. Sejak berdiri, FIFGROUP berkomitmen untuk menyediakan solusi finansial yang terjangkau dan inovatif bagi masyarakat Indonesia. Dengan jaringan yang luas dan tim profesional yang berdedikasi, FIFGROUP terus berkembang dan memperkuat posisinya di pasar. Perusahaan kami mengedepankan nilai-nilai integritas, profesionalisme, dan pelayanan pelanggan yang memuaskan. Kami percaya bahwa setiap karyawan memiliki kontribusi penting dalam mencapai visi perusahaan untuk menjadi mitra terpercaya bagi seluruh pelanggan kami. FIFGROUP menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang mendukung pertumbuhan profesional dan personal karyawan dengan memberikan kesempatan yang setara kepada semua individu tanpa memandang latar belakang. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki semangat tinggi, integritas yang kuat, dan ingin berkembang bersama FIFGROUP, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar posisi Field Collection ini. Kirimkan CV dan surat lamaran Anda melalui portal karir kami atau hubungi tim Human Resources kami segera. Kami menantikan kesempatan untuk berkenalan dengan Anda dan membahas bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi pada kesuksesan tim kami di Semarang.

jobs.title: DEMI PASTRY
jobs.description: LOWONGAN KERJA – DEMI PASTRY MDA Restaurants sedang membuka kesempatan untuk posisi Demi Pastry untuk penempatan di outlet kami yang berlokasi di Setiabudi, Jakarta Selatan. Tanggung Jawab: Menyiapkan dan memproduksi dessert, pastry, cake, dan mignardises sesuai standar restoran. Membantu Chef dalam menyiapkan dessert untuk menu Omakase dan à la carte . Melakukan preparation, baking, finishing, dan plating produk pastry. Memastikan rasa, tekstur, ukuran, dan tampilan dessert tetap konsisten. Menyiapkan dan mengolah bahan pastry dengan tepat sesuai recipe dan SOP . Membantu pengembangan Japanese-inspired dessert dan menu seasonal. Menjaga kebersihan area kerja, peralatan, serta menerapkan standar food hygiene & sanitation . Kualifikasi : Minimal 2–3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Demi Pastry atau posisi pastry sejenis, terutama di fine dining, hotel, atau restoran premium . Pendidikan minimal SMK/Diploma Tata Boga, Pastry, atau bidang terkait . Menguasai basic pastry, dessert, cake, baking, dan dessert plating . Memiliki pengalaman membuat mignardises, plated dessert, atau dessert untuk tasting/omakase menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami penggunaan bahan Japanese-inspired seperti matcha, hojicha, yuzu, sesame, dan red bean menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki attention to detail , kreativitas, serta mampu menjaga konsistensi kualitas produk. Mampu bekerja dalam tim, mengikuti arahan Chef, dan bekerja dengan sistem shift termasuk weekend/public holiday .

  5. Memahami penggunaan bahan Japanese-inspired seperti matcha, hojicha, yuzu, sesame, dan red bean menjadi nilai tambah.

  7. Mampu bekerja dalam tim, mengikuti arahan Chef, dan bekerja dengan sistem shift termasuk weekend/public holiday.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description: About Hubexo At Hubexo, we connect the construction market to help the world build better. Our unique data, insights and software solutions help customers in the construction industry sell more, improve efficiency and build more sustainably. As Hubexo continues to transform its global commercial organisation, we are looking for an experienced Revenue Operations Analyst to help strengthen how we use data, analytics and technology to drive commercial performance. About the Role The Revenue Operations Analyst will play a key role in Hubexo's commercial transformation, providing the analytical insight, commercial modelling and operational structure needed to support better revenue decisions across the business. This is a strategic and hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between data, commercial strategy and execution. You will work with complex and disparate data sources to develop revenue intelligence, identify commercial opportunities, improve forecasting and support pricing and customer-value decisions. Beyond analytics, you will help shape and scale AI-powered Revenue Operations processes, identifying opportunities to automate manual work and improve the speed, consistency and quality of commercial decision-making. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, challenging existing approaches and influencing senior stakeholders across a global organisation. Key Responsibilities Revenue Intelligence & Commercial Analytics Own and develop the analytical foundation supporting Revenue Operations and commercial decision-making. Analyse complex, fragmented data sources and establish reliable views of commercial performance. Develop and maintain revenue forecasts, commercial models and performance analysis. Analyse TAM, market penetration, customer value, LTV/CAC and other key commercial metrics to identify growth opportunities. Identify trends, risks, performance gaps and opportunities, and translate them into clear business recommendations. Develop frameworks and analytical approaches that enable consistent, data-driven commercial decisions. Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, robust and suitable for senior leadership decision-making. Pricing & Revenue Strategy Support pricing and revenue strategy through data-driven analysis and modelling. Evaluate commercial performance and identify opportunities to improve revenue growth, customer value and profitability. Provide analytical support for pricing decisions, commercial initiatives and strategic planning. Support the development and evaluation of sales commission and incentive structures. Challenge assumptions and provide an objective, data-led perspective on commercial decisions. Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management Act as a trusted analytical partner to Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Finance and Commercial leadership. Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations that senior stakeholders can understand and act upon. Prepare executive-level presentations, business cases and commercial insights. Work across functions and markets to ensure alignment on commercial metrics, definitions and performance. Proactively identify business questions that can be answered through better data and analysis rather than simply responding to reporting requests. AI, Automation & Process Improvement Lead the identification of opportunities to use AI and automation across Revenue Operations. Design and implement AI-powered workflows that reduce manual analytical work and improve output quality. Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and other emerging AI technologies to improve analytical productivity. Develop structured and repeatable processes for areas such as forecasting, commercial analysis, reporting and commission evaluation. Evaluate new AI capabilities and determine where they can create measurable business value. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and smarter ways of working across Revenue Operations. Commercial Transformation Contribute to broader initiatives designed to improve Hubexo's commercial operating model. Establish scalable processes, frameworks and analytical standards across Revenue Operations. Support the development of a more data-driven commercial culture across the organisation. Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects involving pricing, revenue, sales performance, customer value and commercial efficiency. Continuously assess existing processes and recommend improvements based on data, technology and business needs. What We're Looking For Essential Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Data Analytics or a related field. 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Revenue Operations, Commercial Analytics, Business Analysis, Commercial Strategy, Pricing, Finance, Management Consulting or a similar analytical/commercial function. Strong track record of using data and analysis to influence commercial or strategic business decisions. Advanced Excel skills with strong experience in financial and commercial modelling. Strong understanding of commercial performance metrics and business drivers. Ability to work with complex, incomplete and disparate datasets and turn them into reliable insights. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent professional English, written and spoken. Proven ability to work independently, take ownership and manage multiple priorities. Strong interest in AI, automation and technology-enabled business transformation. Desirable Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Pricing or Commercial Strategy within a SaaS, technology or subscription-based business. Strong understanding of SaaS metrics such as ARR, MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR and retention. Experience working in a global or multi-market organisation. Experience working with CRM, BI or commercial analytics platforms. Hands-on experience implementing AI-powered workflows or automation. Experience working with senior commercial leadership or executive stakeholders. Why Join Hubexo? This is an opportunity to make a real impact in a global commercial organisation and help shape how Hubexo uses data, technology and AI to drive better business decisions. You’ll work at the intersection of commercial strategy, revenue operations, analytics and AI , with the opportunity to influence how we manage revenue, improve processes and scale our commercial operations across markets. At Hubexo, we believe in: Dream Big – Set ambitious goals and strive to exceed expectations. Thrive Together – Collaborate, communicate and succeed as one team. Own It – Take ownership, make decisions and create impact. Do the Right Thing – Act with integrity and do what’s right.

About Hubexo

At Hubexo, we connect the construction market to help the world build better. Our unique data, insights and software solutions help customers in the construction industry sell more, improve efficiency and build more sustainably.

As Hubexo continues to transform its global commercial organisation, we are looking for an experienced Revenue Operations Analyst to help strengthen how we use data, analytics and technology to drive commercial performance.

About the Role

The Revenue Operations Analyst will play a key role in Hubexo's commercial transformation, providing the analytical insight, commercial modelling and operational structure needed to support better revenue decisions across the business. This is a strategic and hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between data, commercial strategy and execution.

You will work with complex and disparate data sources to develop revenue intelligence, identify commercial opportunities, improve forecasting and support pricing and customer-value decisions.

Beyond analytics, you will help shape and scale AI-powered Revenue Operations processes, identifying opportunities to automate manual work and improve the speed, consistency and quality of commercial decision-making.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, challenging existing approaches and influencing senior stakeholders across a global organisation.


Key Responsibilities

Revenue Intelligence & Commercial Analytics

  • Own and develop the analytical foundation supporting Revenue Operations and commercial decision-making.

  • Analyse complex, fragmented data sources and establish reliable views of commercial performance.

  • Develop and maintain revenue forecasts, commercial models and performance analysis.

  • Analyse TAM, market penetration, customer value, LTV/CAC and other key commercial metrics to identify growth opportunities.

  • Identify trends, risks, performance gaps and opportunities, and translate them into clear business recommendations.

  • Develop frameworks and analytical approaches that enable consistent, data-driven commercial decisions.

  • Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, robust and suitable for senior leadership decision-making.

Pricing & Revenue Strategy

  • Support pricing and revenue strategy through data-driven analysis and modelling.

  • Evaluate commercial performance and identify opportunities to improve revenue growth, customer value and profitability.

  • Provide analytical support for pricing decisions, commercial initiatives and strategic planning.

  • Support the development and evaluation of sales commission and incentive structures.

  • Challenge assumptions and provide an objective, data-led perspective on commercial decisions.

Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a trusted analytical partner to Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Finance and Commercial leadership.

  • Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations that senior stakeholders can understand and act upon.

  • Prepare executive-level presentations, business cases and commercial insights.

  • Work across functions and markets to ensure alignment on commercial metrics, definitions and performance.

  • Proactively identify business questions that can be answered through better data and analysis rather than simply responding to reporting requests.

AI, Automation & Process Improvement

  • Lead the identification of opportunities to use AI and automation across Revenue Operations.

  • Design and implement AI-powered workflows that reduce manual analytical work and improve output quality.

  • Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and other emerging AI technologies to improve analytical productivity.

  • Develop structured and repeatable processes for areas such as forecasting, commercial analysis, reporting and commission evaluation.

  • Evaluate new AI capabilities and determine where they can create measurable business value.

  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and smarter ways of working across Revenue Operations.

Commercial Transformation

  • Contribute to broader initiatives designed to improve Hubexo's commercial operating model.

  • Establish scalable processes, frameworks and analytical standards across Revenue Operations.

  • Support the development of a more data-driven commercial culture across the organisation.

  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects involving pricing, revenue, sales performance, customer value and commercial efficiency.

  • Continuously assess existing processes and recommend improvements based on data, technology and business needs.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Data Analytics or a related field.

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Revenue Operations, Commercial Analytics, Business Analysis, Commercial Strategy, Pricing, Finance, Management Consulting or a similar analytical/commercial function.

  • Strong track record of using data and analysis to influence commercial or strategic business decisions.

  • Advanced Excel skills with strong experience in financial and commercial modelling.

  • Strong understanding of commercial performance metrics and business drivers.

  • Ability to work with complex, incomplete and disparate datasets and turn them into reliable insights.

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Fluent professional English, written and spoken.

  • Proven ability to work independently, take ownership and manage multiple priorities.

  • Strong interest in AI, automation and technology-enabled business transformation.

Desirable

  • Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Pricing or Commercial Strategy within a SaaS, technology or subscription-based business.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics such as ARR, MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR and retention.

  • Experience working in a global or multi-market organisation.

  • Experience working with CRM, BI or commercial analytics platforms.

  • Hands-on experience implementing AI-powered workflows or automation.

  • Experience working with senior commercial leadership or executive stakeholders.

Why Join Hubexo?

This is an opportunity to make a real impact in a global commercial organisation and help shape how Hubexo uses data, technology and AI to drive better business decisions.

You’ll work at the intersection of commercial strategy, revenue operations, analytics and AI, with the opportunity to influence how we manage revenue, improve processes and scale our commercial operations across markets.

At Hubexo, we believe in:

Dream Big – Set ambitious goals and strive to exceed expectations.
Thrive Together – Collaborate, communicate and succeed as one team.

Do the Right Thing – Act with integrity and do what’s right.

jobs.title: Procurement Supervisor
jobs.description: About Us: PT Leon Boga Sentosa is a growing company in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) industry. We are seeking a proactive, analytical, and highly skilled Procurement Supervisor to lead our purchasing team. If you have a strong background in sourcing raw materials, managing international supply chains, and handling general office procurement, we want you on board! Responsibilities: Oversee and manage the end-to-end procurement process for both direct materials (raw materials, ingredients, packaging) and indirect materials. Actively source, evaluate, and build a strong network of local vendors for raw materials to ensure supply chain stability, agility, and cost efficiency. Manage and execute import purchasing operations, including coordinating with international suppliers, freight forwarders, and relevant agencies. Handle all purchasing activities for general office requirements, including office supplies, electronic equipment/IT assets, and sourcing reliable vendors for building renovations and facility maintenance . Monitor global and local market trends, as well as price fluctuations of food-grade raw materials , to develop cost-effective purchasing strategies. Handle all administrative and operational aspects of import shipments, ensuring full compliance with customs clearance procedures, import duties, and international trade laws. Lead negotiations for commercial terms, pricing, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with both direct (materials) and indirect (services/renovations) vendors to achieve targeted cost savings. Supervise, mentor, and evaluate the procurement staff to ensure daily operations run smoothly and align with company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Collaborate closely with PPIC, Production, R&D, and Quality Control to ensure all purchased raw materials meet exact technical specifications and food safety standards (BPOM, Halal, GMP). Qualifications: Bachelor's degree (S1) in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 3-5 years of proven experience in Procurement/Purchasing, with at least 1-2 years in a Supervisory or Team Lead role (Experience in the FMCG / Food & Beverage industry is highly preferred). Deep understanding of food-grade raw materials , including ingredients, additives, and packaging specifications. Extensive experience in handling import procurement , with a strong command of Incoterms, customs clearance processes, import taxes, and overseas shipping logistics. Proven ability to source and manage a wide range of suppliers, from local raw material producers to contractors/renovation vendors and electronic suppliers . Exceptional negotiation, persuasive communication, and analytical problem-solving skills. Proficient in using ERP systems (such as SAP, Oracle, or Odoo) and Microsoft Excel. High integrity, strong attention to detail, and solid leadership capabilities. Benefits: Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Health and Employment Insurance (BPJS). A dynamic work environment with clear career advancement opportunities.

jobs.title: BAKER
jobs.description: Baker – B3 Baker Butcher Barista (B3), PIK 1, Jakarta Utara Posisi Baker bertanggung jawab dalam menyiapkan dan memproduksi berbagai jenis roti, viennoiserie , dan pastry sesuai dengan standar yang telah ditetapkan. Posisi ini juga bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan konsistensi kualitas, rasa, tekstur, ukuran, dan tampilan produk sesuai dengan standar perusahaan. Tanggung Jawab Menyiapkan dan memproduksi berbagai jenis roti, viennoiserie , dan pastry sesuai dengan standar yang ditetapkan. Memproduksi berbagai jenis produk seperti croissant, Danish, bun , serta produk bakery lainnya. Memastikan kualitas, rasa, tekstur, ukuran, dan tampilan produk tetap konsisten. Melakukan persiapan bahan baku dan proses produksi sesuai dengan resep dan SOP yang berlaku. Menjaga kebersihan, kerapian, higienitas, serta penerapan standar sanitasi dan keamanan pangan di area kerja. Memastikan kebutuhan produksi harian dapat terpenuhi sesuai dengan target yang telah ditentukan. Kualifikasi Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun sebagai Baker/Pastry, khususnya di restoran, bakery, café, atau hotel. Memiliki pengalaman dalam pembuatan roti dan viennoiserie , terutama croissant, Danish, bun , dan berbagai jenis roti lainnya. Memahami proses mixing, kneading, proofing, shaping, dan baking . Memahami penggunaan dan pengolahan yeast, butter, flour , serta bahan-bahan bakery dan pastry lainnya. Mampu menjaga konsistensi rasa, tekstur, ukuran, dan tampilan produk. Memiliki pengalaman membuat pastry savory maupun sweet dengan berbagai jenis isian. Memahami standar higiene, sanitasi, dan keamanan pangan . Mampu mengikuti resep dan SOP serta bekerja dengan target produksi harian. Teliti, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja secara efektif dalam tim. Digital and print design, fresh talent welcome.", "content2": "

Graphic Designer (Marketing and Promotion)

Company: PT Satu Ritel Indo
Location: Jakarta Barat (on site)
Type: Full time

---

About us

We are a K beauty retail business in Indonesia, bringing Korean cosmetics brands to local customers through our own stores. We are building a strong visual presence across social media, ecommerce, and in store experiences, and we are looking for a designer to lead that work.

The role

You will create online and offline marketing content that drives brand awareness and sales. This covers everything from Instagram and TikTok assets to ecommerce banners and in store promotional materials. You will take our brand assets and bring them to life across every customer touchpoint.

What you will do

- Design digital content for social media (Instagram, TikTok) and ecommerce banners for Shopee, Tokopedia, and TikTok Shop
- Create offline promotional materials: in store POSM, banners, standees, and brochures
- Apply and adapt our brand guidelines consistently across every channel and campaign
- Work with the marketing team on product launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns
- Prepare files ready for print and coordinate with printing vendors
- Support short form video content (Reels, TikTok) when needed

What we are looking for

- A strong portfolio showing both digital and print work (required to apply)
- Experience in graphic design is a plus, ideally in beauty, retail, FMCG, or ecommerce; fresh graduates are welcome to apply
- Solid skills in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; Figma and Canva are a plus
- A good sense of layout, typography, and color, with an eye for beauty and lifestyle aesthetics
- Able to manage several projects at once and work at pace
- Video editing (CapCut, Premiere, After Effects) is a strong plus

Nice to have

- Experience with K beauty or Korean brands
- Familiarity with Indonesian social commerce trends and platforms
- Korean language skills

jobs.title: STAFF OUTBOUND WAREHOUSE - CIBITUNG 2
jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION – OUTBOUND WAREHOUSE Picker Melakukan pengambilan barang dari lokasi penyimpanan sesuai dengan picking list atau sales order. Memastikan barang yang diambil sesuai dengan SKU, jumlah, dan kualitas yang dibutuhkan. Melaporkan apabila ditemukan barang tidak sesuai, rusak, atau hilang selama proses picking. Menempatkan barang hasil picking pada area staging atau loading sesuai tujuan pengiriman. Memastikan penerapan metode FIFO atau FEFO dalam proses pengambilan barang. Checker Outbound Melakukan pemeriksaan barang hasil picking agar sesuai dengan picking list atau sales order. Memastikan kesesuaian SKU, jumlah, dan kondisi barang sebelum proses pengiriman. Melaporkan apabila ditemukan kesalahan SKU, selisih jumlah, atau kekurangan barang. Loader Melakukan proses pemuatan barang (loading) ke kendaraan untuk kebutuhan pengiriman outbound. Memastikan barang yang dimuat sesuai dengan dokumen pengiriman. Memastikan jumlah, jenis, dan kondisi barang sesuai dengan instruksi checker atau admin. Menyusun barang di dalam kendaraan agar aman, stabil, dan optimal dalam penggunaan ruang. Helper Membantu proses pemindahan barang dari area lift ke checking line sesuai alur operasional outbound. Memindahkan picking basket dari area spiral ke checking line untuk mendukung proses pengecekan. Melakukan penyortiran picking basket berdasarkan area tujuan pengiriman. Mengembalikan dan mendistribusikan picking basket kosong ke area operasional yang membutuhkan. Mengembalikan dan mendistribusikan pallet kosong sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Admin Outbound Melakukan pembagian dan pengaturan pekerjaan kepada tim picker sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Melakukan pencatatan absensi manpower secara manual dan memastikan data tercatat dengan benar. Mengelola proses pengiriman barang dari gudang, termasuk pembuatan dan pengelolaan dokumen surat jalan. Kualifikasi Bersedia ditempatkan di Gudang Cibitung 2, Kabupaten Bekasi. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift. Bersedia bekerja pada hari libur dan tanggal merah sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Memiliki ketelitian, kedisiplinan, dan tanggung jawab dalam menjalankan pekerjaan. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim.

  2. Memastikan barang yang dimuat sesuai dengan dokumen pengiriman.

  3. Memastikan jumlah, jenis, dan kondisi barang sesuai dengan instruksi checker atau admin.

  4. Menyusun barang di dalam kendaraan agar aman, stabil, dan optimal dalam penggunaan ruang.

Helper

  1. Membantu proses pemindahan barang dari area lift ke checking line sesuai alur operasional outbound.

  2. Memindahkan picking basket dari area spiral ke checking line untuk mendukung proses pengecekan.

  3. Melakukan penyortiran picking basket berdasarkan area tujuan pengiriman.

  4. Mengembalikan dan mendistribusikan picking basket kosong ke area operasional yang membutuhkan.

  5. Mengembalikan dan mendistribusikan pallet kosong sesuai kebutuhan operasional.

Admin Outbound

  1. Melakukan pembagian dan pengaturan pekerjaan kepada tim picker sesuai kebutuhan operasional.

  2. Melakukan pencatatan absensi manpower secara manual dan memastikan data tercatat dengan benar.

  3. Mengelola proses pengiriman barang dari gudang, termasuk pembuatan dan pengelolaan dokumen surat jalan.

Kualifikasi

  1. Bersedia ditempatkan di Gudang Cibitung 2, Kabupaten Bekasi.

  2. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.

  3. Bersedia bekerja pada hari libur dan tanggal merah sesuai kebutuhan operasional.

  4. Memiliki ketelitian, kedisiplinan, dan tanggung jawab dalam menjalankan pekerjaan.

  5. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim.
