jobs.title: Product Manager B2B / Product Consultant
jobs.description: About the role You carry a module from the client's business process all the way to acceptance, and it stays yours end to end. You map the process, find the real problem behind the stated ask, write the business rules and the numbered acceptance criteria engineers build against, and prove at UAT that the problem is solved. You carry two engagements at a time, and the record you keep is the one everyone downstream works from. Key responsibilities Map the client's current-state process, identify the bottlenecks in it, and name the real problem behind the stated ask. Write the business requirements and the business rules for your module. Write the numbered, testable acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then form that live in the specification appendix, so an engineer can build from them without coming back to ask. Explore the client's data, check it for quality, and map what each field means inside their process. Keep the traceability from requirement to implementation to test, so every build traces back to a need. Write UAT scenarios from the process map and the problem statement, then validate that the client's problem is solved rather than only that features function. Deliver the standard operating procedures and the training when your module ships. Join engineers' story kickoffs and walk them through the edge cases before they write code. Draft the weekly client report for the Senior Product Consultant to approve, carrying the client's operating reality up to the product layer. Keep the meeting notes, the decision log, and the change-request log as the record everyone works from. About you 2 to 4 years in product management, business analysis, or delivery consulting, or equivalent demonstrable skill. Ability to turn a messy client ask into a current-state process map that shows where the real problem sits. Ability to write numbered, testable acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then form that an engineer can build from directly. Comfortable in a client's data: checks it for quality, spots the empty, duplicated, and malformed, and maps what each field means in the business process. Ability to write UAT scenarios that test whether the client's problem is solved, and holds the pass or fail line on them. Ability to keep a clean record under pressure: decisions, changes, and the reasoning behind both. Ability to talk to engineers about trade-offs without oversimplifying the build, and recognizes excellent interface work from merely acceptable work well enough to spec for it. Works in Bahasa Indonesia and English with client stakeholders. Uses AI as leverage across the whole job and verifies its output before it reaches a client or an engineer. Work you can show: specifications, process maps, prototypes, or interfaces you shaped.

jobs.title: Sales Royal Dermatology & Aesthetic Centre
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari Sales profesional yang bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim Royal Dermatology & Aesthetic Centre di Royal Progress Hospital. Sebagai Sales Royal Dermatology & Aesthetic Centre, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mempromosikan dan menjual layanan dermatologi dan estetika berkualitas tinggi kepada klien baru dan yang sudah ada. Posisi ini memerlukan pemahaman mendalam tentang industri healthcare dan kemampuan untuk membangun hubungan yang kuat dengan pasien. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime yang berlokasi di Jakarta Utara, Jakarta Raya, di mana Anda akan bekerja langsung dengan pasien dan stakeholder untuk mencapai target penjualan yang ambisius. Deskripsi Pekerjaan : Mencapai target sales, revenue, treatment package, dan patient conversion. Mengubah consultation menjadi treatment booking secara efektif. Melakukan upselling dan cross-selling secara ethical dan patient-oriented. Menawarkan treatment/package yang relevan dengan kebutuhan pasien. Meningkatkan Average Revenue Per Patient (ARPP). Memaksimalkan conversion dari walk-in, digital leads, WhatsApp, social media, referral, corporate/community event, dan existing patient. Melakukan follow-up leads yang belum melakukan treatment. Mengidentifikasi peluang repeat treatment. Menawarkan membership, package, loyalty program, dan referral program. Aktif menawarkan program/promo yang sedang berjalan. Mendukung event, community gathering, corporate partnership, beauty class, skin consultation event, dan social media activation. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan min. D3/S1 semua jurusan dari Universitas Terkemuka Diutamakan Marketing, Sales, Business, Communication, Hospitality, Beauty/Aesthetic, atau Public Relations. Memiliki pengalaman 1-2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Sales, Beauty Advisor, Beauty Consultant, Medical Sales, Aesthetic Consultant, Customer Relationship Officer, atau Sales Consultant. Memiliki kemampuan bahasa Inggris yang baik Dapat bergabung segera Tentang Kami Royal Progress Hospital adalah institusi healthcare terkemuka di Jakarta yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan medis berkualitas tinggi dengan standar internasional. Royal Dermatology & Aesthetic Centre adalah salah satu divisi unggulan kami yang menyediakan solusi dermatologi dan treatment estetika terlengkap menggunakan teknologi terkini. Kami dipimpin oleh dokter-dokter spesialis berpengalaman dan didukung oleh tim profesional yang berdedikasi untuk kepuasan pasien. Misi kami adalah memberdayakan setiap individu untuk merasakan percaya diri melalui perawatan kulit dan estetika yang inovatif. Kami percaya bahwa kesehatan dan keindahan adalah hak setiap orang, dan kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, profesional, dan mendukung pertumbuhan karier jangka panjang bagi seluruh tim kami.

  • Memaksimalkan conversion dari walk-in, digital leads, WhatsApp, social media, referral, corporate/community event, dan existing patient.

  • Melakukan follow-up leads yang belum melakukan treatment.

  • Mengidentifikasi peluang repeat treatment.

  • Menawarkan membership, package, loyalty program, dan referral program.

  • Aktif menawarkan program/promo yang sedang berjalan.

  • Mendukung event, community gathering, corporate partnership, beauty class, skin consultation event, dan social media activation.


Kualifikasi :

  • Pendidikan min. D3/S1 semua jurusan dari Universitas Terkemuka

  • Diutamakan Marketing, Sales, Business, Communication, Hospitality, Beauty/Aesthetic, atau Public Relations.

  • Memiliki pengalaman 1-2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Sales, Beauty Advisor, Beauty Consultant, Medical Sales, Aesthetic Consultant, Customer Relationship Officer, atau Sales Consultant.

  • Memiliki kemampuan bahasa Inggris yang baik

  • Dapat bergabung segera


Tentang Kami
Royal Progress Hospital adalah institusi healthcare terkemuka di Jakarta yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan medis berkualitas tinggi dengan standar internasional. Royal Dermatology & Aesthetic Centre adalah salah satu divisi unggulan kami yang menyediakan solusi dermatologi dan treatment estetika terlengkap menggunakan teknologi terkini. Kami dipimpin oleh dokter-dokter spesialis berpengalaman dan didukung oleh tim profesional yang berdedikasi untuk kepuasan pasien. Misi kami adalah memberdayakan setiap individu untuk merasakan percaya diri melalui perawatan kulit dan estetika yang inovatif. Kami percaya bahwa kesehatan dan keindahan adalah hak setiap orang, dan kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, profesional, dan mendukung pertumbuhan karier jangka panjang bagi seluruh tim kami.

jobs.title: GENERAL AFFAIR
jobs.description: 1. Pengelolaan Fasilitas & Operasional Kantor Memastikan fasilitas kantor, toko, dan area kerja dalam kondisi baik dan siap digunakan. Mengatur kebutuhan operasional kantor seperti ATK, perlengkapan kerja, kebutuhan kebersihan, dan kebutuhan umum lainnya. Melakukan pengecekan serta pemeliharaan fasilitas dan inventaris perusahaan. Mengkoordinasikan perbaikan apabila terdapat kerusakan fasilitas. 2. Pengelolaan Inventaris & Aset Melakukan pendataan dan pencatatan aset/inventaris perusahaan. Memastikan penggunaan aset perusahaan sesuai dengan ketentuan. Melakukan monitoring kondisi aset dan melaporkan aset yang rusak, hilang, atau membutuhkan penggantian. Mengatur proses serah terima aset kepada karyawan. 3. Pengadaan Barang & Kebutuhan Operasional Mengidentifikasi kebutuhan barang dan perlengkapan operasional. Melakukan koordinasi dengan vendor/supplier. Membandingkan harga dan kualitas barang sebelum melakukan pembelian. Memastikan barang yang dibeli sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan standar perusahaan. 4. Koordinasi Vendor & Supplier Mengelola komunikasi dengan vendor terkait kebutuhan operasional. Memantau jadwal pekerjaan vendor seperti maintenance, kebersihan, perbaikan, dan jasa lainnya. Memastikan pekerjaan vendor dilakukan sesuai kesepakatan. Mengelola dokumen dan administrasi vendor. 5. Kebersihan & Keamanan Memastikan kebersihan dan kerapian lingkungan kantor/toko. Melakukan koordinasi dengan petugas cleaning service/security apabila tersedia. Memastikan penerapan standar keamanan dan kenyamanan lingkungan kerja. Melaporkan kondisi yang berpotensi mengganggu keamanan atau operasional. 6. Administrasi Umum Mengelola dokumen dan administrasi yang berkaitan dengan General Affair. Membuat laporan kebutuhan dan pengeluaran operasional. Menyimpan dan mengarsipkan dokumen pembelian, inventaris, vendor, dan fasilitas. Membantu kebutuhan administrasi perusahaan lainnya sesuai arahan atasan. 7. Dukungan Kegiatan Perusahaan Mendukung persiapan meeting, gathering, event, dan kegiatan perusahaan lainnya. Menyiapkan kebutuhan tempat, perlengkapan, konsumsi, dan fasilitas kegiatan. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen terkait untuk memastikan kegiatan berjalan lancar. 8. Tugas Lainnya Melaksanakan tugas lain yang diberikan oleh atasan sesuai dengan kebutuhan operasional perusahaan. Menjaga kerahasiaan data, dokumen, dan informasi perusahaan. Memastikan seluruh pekerjaan dilakukan secara bertanggung jawab, tepat waktu, dan sesuai dengan SOP perusahaan.

jobs.title: SPG TOKO
jobs.description: Kesempatan THE ORANGE' mengundang Anda untuk bergabung sebagai SPG Toko di lokasi kami di Denpasar Barat. Posisi ini adalah kesempatan untuk menjadi wajah brand kami dan memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang luar biasa. Sebagai SPG Toko, Anda akan berperan penting dalam mempromosikan produk, melayani pelanggan dengan profesional, dan menciptakan suasana yang menyenangkan di toko kami. Ini adalah posisi fulltime yang memungkinkan Anda untuk berkembang dalam industri Hospitality & Tourism dengan bekerja langsung bersama tim yang dinamis dan berdedikasi. Tanggung Jawab Utama Menyambut dan melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, profesional, dan responsif terhadap kebutuhan mereka Menjelaskan produk kepada pelanggan Memberikan rekomendasi produk yang sesuai berdasarkan kebutuhan pelanggan Mempertahankan penampilan toko yang rapi, bersih, dan terorganisir dengan baik Mengelola stok produk dan melaporkan kebutuhan pengisian ulang kepada manajemen Membangun hubungan jangka panjang dengan pelanggan untuk meningkatkan loyalitas brand Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara Pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun sebagai SPG atau dalam posisi retail/penjualan yang serupa Kemampuan komunikasi yang excellent dan terampil dalam presentasi produk Penampilan professional dengan attitude yang positif dan energik Kemampuan melayani pelanggan dengan empati dan kesabaran Keterampilan penjualan yang kuat Kemampuan bekerja dalam tim dan beradaptasi dengan cepat dalam lingkungan yang dinamis Fleksibilitas untuk bekerja sesuai dengan jadwal toko, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur jika diperlukan Tentang Kami THE ORANGE' adalah brand yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan pengalaman terbaik kepada pelanggan melalui produk berkualitas dan layanan exceptional. Berlokasi strategis di West Denpasar, Bali, kami melayani komunitas lokal dan wisatawan dengan dedikasi penuh. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim adalah ambassador brand yang penting dalam menciptakan kepuasan pelanggan. Di THE ORANGE', kami menghargai profesionalisme, integritas, dan semangat untuk terus berkembang. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari keluarga besar yang berkomitmen pada excellence dalam setiap aspek bisnis kami.

Ini adalah posisi fulltime yang memungkinkan Anda untuk berkembang dalam industri Hospitality & Tourism dengan bekerja langsung bersama tim yang dinamis dan berdedikasi.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  • Menyambut dan melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, profesional, dan responsif terhadap kebutuhan mereka

  • Mempertahankan penampilan toko yang rapi, bersih, dan terorganisir dengan baik

  • Mengelola stok produk dan melaporkan kebutuhan pengisian ulang kepada manajemen

  • Membangun hubungan jangka panjang dengan pelanggan untuk meningkatkan loyalitas brand


Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan

  • Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara

  • Pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun sebagai SPG atau dalam posisi retail/penjualan yang serupa

  • Kemampuan komunikasi yang excellent dan terampil dalam presentasi produk

  • Penampilan professional dengan attitude yang positif dan energik

  • Kemampuan melayani pelanggan dengan empati dan kesabaran

  • Keterampilan penjualan yang kuat

  • Kemampuan bekerja dalam tim dan beradaptasi dengan cepat dalam lingkungan yang dinamis

  • Fleksibilitas untuk bekerja sesuai dengan jadwal toko, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur jika diperlukan


Tentang Kami
THE ORANGE' adalah brand yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan pengalaman terbaik kepada pelanggan melalui produk berkualitas dan layanan exceptional. Berlokasi strategis di West Denpasar, Bali, kami melayani komunitas lokal dan wisatawan dengan dedikasi penuh. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim adalah ambassador brand yang penting dalam menciptakan kepuasan pelanggan. Di THE ORANGE', kami menghargai profesionalisme, integritas, dan semangat untuk terus berkembang. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari keluarga besar yang berkomitmen pada excellence dalam setiap aspek bisnis kami.

jobs.title: Channel Sales Specialist B2B – Network Products
jobs.description: Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced and driven B2B Channel Sales Specialist to join our team and expand our presence in the Indonesian network products market. The ideal candidate should have a solid background in selling networking equipment to corporate clients, system integrators, ISPs, or channel partners. You will play a critical role in driving revenue growth, building strong client relationships, and delivering tailored solutions to business customers. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute sales strategies to grow B2B customer accounts in Indonesia. Identify, approach, and manage relationships with corporate clients, system integrators, resellers, and ISPs. Present, promote, and sell a portfolio of networking products (routers, switches, access points, etc.) to meet client needs. Prepare and deliver professional sales proposals, quotations, and presentations. Work closely with technical and product teams to ensure client satisfaction and project delivery. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments in the Indonesian ICT sector. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets and report on key performance metrics. Attend trade shows, partner events, or business meetings as needed. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in network equipment or IT/telecom industry. Strong knowledge of networking products and solutions. Proven sales record with ability to generate leads, close deals, and manage post-sales follow-up. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Proficiency in English and Bahasa Indonesia. Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to work independently or with a team. Preferred Qualifications: Existing client base in the ICT / network solutions sector in Indonesia. Familiarity with key brands such as MikroTik, TP-Link, Ubiquiti, Huawei, H3C, or similar. Experience using CRM tools and reporting systems. To Apply: Please submit your CV and a short cover letter outlining your relevant experience and achievements.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Ops Associate
jobs.description: About us: FIT HUB is a venture-backed technology driven health and wellness startup based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Founded in 2020, FIT HUB’s mission is to democratize access to Health and Wellness for all Indonesians. We believe that everyone should have access to improving their health and wellness, so we’ve built FIT HUB from the ground up to make exercising friendly, affordable, and fun for new gym-goers and fitness-enthusiasts alike. The Opportunity: As a Talent Acquisition Ops Associate , you will be part of the People Experience Team, focusing on finding the best talent to help the organization grow. Identifying the most effective and efficient ways to find the candidates and fulfill the open positions with the right people. What You Will Do: Manage the entire recruitment process from job posting to offering. Plan interview and selection process, including screening calls, assessments, user interviews, and reference check. Source and identify the right candidates by utilizing the relevant recruitment channels such as job boards, LinkedIn, referral, social platforms, job fairs, walk-in interview, etc. Collaborate with the users to tackle potential challenges during the recruitment processes. Update weekly recruitment report and progress regularly. Kualifikasi What We Need: Bachelor degree, preferable Psychology, Management, or Human Resources is a plus. At least 1 year experience in end-to-end recruitment processes from job posting to offering (experience in mass hiring is preferred) Experience in Campus hiring is a plus Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Flexible and adaptable; self starter, able to work independently and in a team.

FIT HUB is a venture-backed technology driven health and wellness startup based in Jakarta, Indonesia. About the role

We are looking for a proactive, commercially driven, and relationship-oriented Sales & Leasing Development professional to join our team.   • Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Property Management, Real Estate, or a related field

  • Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills

  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written. Mandarin proficiency is an advantage

  • Target-oriented, proactive, self-driven, and demonstrates professionalism, integrity, and accountability

  • Willing to be placed in Bintan, Kepulauan Riau

jobs.title: Community Development
jobs.description: Qualifications: Min. 1 tahun pengalaman di bidang community management, event coordination, atau learning program operations. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan interpersonal yang baik. Terbiasa menggunakan WhatsApp, Google Workspace, Zoom, dan tools digital lainnya. Terorganisir, proaktif, mampu mengelola beberapa tugas sekaligus, dan nyaman bekerja dengan target. Memiliki kemampuan engagement yang baik serta tertarik pada community development dan grassroots engagement. Responsibilities: Melakukan akuisisi dan onboarding komunitas/agent aktif dengan target minimal 25 anggota per komunitas. Melakukan kunjungan ke komunitas potensial serta membangun dan menjaga hubungan dengan komunitas yang telah diakuisisi. Mengelola komunikasi dan engagement komunitas melalui WhatsApp, termasuk menyampaikan update, SOP, success story, serta menangani kendala atau konflik. Mengorganisir kegiatan komunitas seperti small-scale event dan gathering untuk meningkatkan engagement anggota. Mendorong agent untuk meningkatkan transaksi Digital Goods dan menjaga engagement komunitas secara berkelanjutan.

jobs.title: sales marketing
jobs.description: About the role Direktur Operasional – Persyaratan Pekerjaan Kualifikasi dasar Pendidikan/Jurusan: Kemahiran berbahasa Mandarin; gelar Sarjana (S1) atau lebih tinggi; diutamakan memiliki latar belakang di bidang Pemasaran, Administrasi Bisnis, E-commerce Produk Elektronik, atau bidang terkait. Pengalaman lebih dari 5 tahun terkait operasional, dengan minimal 3 tahun dalam manajemen tim; diutamakan memiliki pengalaman sebelumnya sebagai Direktur Operasional atau Kepala Operasional di industri yang sama (elektronik) atau di perusahaan skala menengah hingga besar. Keterampilan Manajemen: Kemampuan membangun dan memimpin tim operasional; bertanggung jawab atas rekrutmen, penilaian kinerja, pelatihan, penjabaran target, perencanaan operasional, serta membimbing tim untuk mencapai target bisnis. Usia: 25–45 tahun; komunikatif dan mampu menyampaikan gagasan dengan jelas; mahir menggunakan platform seperti Facebook dan TikTok, serta platform penjualan online seperti Shopee dan Tokopedia. Kompetensi Profesional Utama Bertanggung jawab penuh atas sistem operasional perusahaan secara keseluruhan; merumuskan strategi operasional dan rencana tahunan/kuartalan; bertanggung jawab atas hasil utama seperti pendapatan, basis pengguna, pertumbuhan, dan tingkat konversi. Memahami siklus hidup bisnis secara menyeluruh: operasional pengguna, operasional konten, operasional kampanye, operasional saluran (channel), operasional produk, dan operasional private traffic ; mampu menentukan prioritas area fokus berdasarkan kebutuhan bisnis. Kemampuan mendiagnosis masalah bisnis, mengidentifikasi hambatan operasional, mengoptimalkan proses, serta meningkatkan efisiensi dan kinerja. Kemahiran dalam menggunakan alat analisis data dan pemahaman terhadap metrik utama: GMV, tingkat konversi, tingkat pembelian ulang, CAC (*Customer Acquisition Cost*), LTV (*Lifetime Value*), dll. Menyesuaikan strategi operasional berdasarkan tinjauan data, bukan sekadar mengambil keputusan berdasarkan intuisi atau pengalaman masa lalu. Integrasi Saluran & Sumber Daya serta Kolaborasi antar Departemen: Memahami berbagai saluran lalu lintas (*traffic channels*): lalu lintas publik/privat online, platform e-commerce, media baru, iklan berbayar, dll.; kemampuan memperluas sumber daya kemitraan dan mengevaluasi ROI saluran. Kemampuan merencanakan kampanye pemasaran berskala besar dan mengelola seluruh proses mulai dari penyusunan proposal dan eksekusi hingga evaluasi pasca-kampanye. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen produk, penjualan, pemasaran, teknis, dan keuangan untuk mendorong pelaksanaan proyek; mengelola sumber daya dan mengatasi hambatan operasional. Melaporkan data operasional, perkembangan bisnis, risiko, dan solusi kepada manajemen senior. Kompensasi: Gaji pokok + komisi.

jobs.title: Technical Admin
jobs.description: PT Megaroyal IT Comindo was first established in 1986 as one of the first pioneers who introduced modern IT Technologies into Indonesia well-known companies. We currently hold the authorized distributor status for Legrand Data Center Infrastructure and Sunbird Data Center Infrastructure Management Software. Data center infrastructure we supply such as: rack, containment, PDU (power distribution unit), KVM (keyboard video monitor), EMS (environmental monitoring system), electric power distribution (low voltage electric panel, busbar), etc. With the massive development of data centers in Indonesia, we are focused on taking part and providing the best data center solutions. Qualifications Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Office Administration, Management, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 1–2 years of experience as a Project Administrator, Site Administrator, or other administrative roles within a project environment. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply if they possess strong organizational and communication skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), email, and project administration systems. Understanding of project administration processes and technical document workflows is an advantage. Able to prepare neat, well-structured, and systematic reports. Strong communication and coordination skills. Responsibilities Provide administrative support for project needs, including document filing, data entry, and document distribution to related parties. Prepare and manage daily, weekly, and monthly project reports, such as progress reports, workforce attendance, material usage, and site activities. Assist the Project Manager and technical team in preparing documents such as correspondence, meeting minutes (MOM), and contract documents. Coordinate with internal and external project stakeholders, including vendors, contractors, and clients. Manage project financial administration documents, including petty cash, expense reports, and payment submissions. Maintain order and organization of project documents (both hardcopy and softcopy) in accordance with company standards. Schedule and manage project logistics, including delivery schedules, meeting schedules, and project team accommodation needs. Ensure all project documents comply with company formats and procedures. Assist in collecting data for project audits or final project reports. Manage project permits and legal documentation when required, in coordination with the legal department or relevant authorities.

jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION – INBOUND WAREHOUSE Admin Inbound Melakukan pengecekan Purchase Order (PO) dari supplier untuk memastikan kesesuaian data penerimaan barang. Memastikan proses penerimaan dan pengeluaran barang dari Hub berjalan sesuai dengan prosedur operasional. Melakukan administrasi dokumen inbound serta memastikan data tercatat dengan akurat. Checker Inbound Melakukan pemeriksaan jumlah barang yang diterima agar sesuai dengan dokumen pengiriman dari supplier. Melakukan pengecekan kondisi fisik barang untuk memastikan tidak terdapat kerusakan, Defect , atau kekurangan. Membandingkan hasil pengecekan fisik barang dengan dokumen penerimaan. Melaporkan setiap ketidaksesuaian seperti selisih barang (shortage), kelebihan barang (over), atau kerusakan (damage) kepada Admin Inbound atau Supervisor. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Receiving, Operator, dan Admin Inbound untuk memastikan proses penerimaan berjalan lancar. Labeling Inbound Melakukan pemeriksaan produk inbound yang belum memiliki label, identifier, atau barcode dari supplier. Melakukan pencetakan label atau barcode berdasarkan data sistem seperti SKU, batch, tanggal kedaluwarsa, dan kode produk. Melakukan pemasangan label secara rapi, tepat, dan sesuai dengan standar operasional. Memastikan setiap produk memiliki label yang dapat terbaca oleh sistem scanning. Melaporkan kepada Supervisor atau Admin apabila terdapat barang yang tidak dapat dilakukan proses relabeling. Kualifikasi Bersedia ditempatkan di Gudang Cibitung 2, Kabupaten Bekasi. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift. Bersedia bekerja pada hari libur dan tanggal merah sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Memiliki ketelitian, kedisiplinan, dan tanggung jawab dalam menjalankan pekerjaan. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim.

jobs.title: Distributor Sales Executive (for Telco Industry)
jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTIONS: Mengelola distribusi, pengaturan tampilan produk (display), memastikan ketersediaan stok, serta menjaga stabilitas harga di pasar. Melakukan kunjungan rutin ke setiap outlet sesuai dengan jadwal yang ditentukan. Memberikan edukasi dan melakukan aktivitas promosi kepada Frontliner outlet guna meningkatkan pemahaman produk. Memantau dan menganalisis kondisi pasar di area target, yang meliputi: Ketersediaan produk seluler dan saldo MOBO untuk semua operator. Pemantauan harga pasar yang berlaku. Pemetaan dan pembaruan data outlet. Pengawasan kinerja jaringan (BTS) di wilayah tersebut. jobs.title: NOC Controller Intern
jobs.description: About us At Viasat, we're on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We're looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team. About the role This is an internship position in the Network Operations Center (NOC). You will work onsite at a Viasat office location for the duration of your internship, familiarizing yourself with network monitoring tools, service alarms, and dashboards under supervision to ensure smooth and efficient network operation monitoring. Key responsibilities Familiarize yourself with network monitoring tools/NMS, service alarms, and dashboards under supervision to ensure smooth and efficient network operation monitoring Assist NOC Controllers in: incident/change management handling process, call out management, ticker tape/service notification Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) for: incident handling / change request mechanism, escalation processes, network operational reporting and closure Assist NOC Controller to perform basic health checks and monitoring validation Document incidents, actions taken, and lessons learned Participate in shift handover updates and daily operational briefings What you'll Need Education: Recent graduate with a Bachelor’s degree or higher in Telecommunications, IT, Electronics or a related field Citizenship: This position requires a Valid Work Permit or Visa for the country you would be located and working from Basic understanding of: Network monitoring concepts and system operations, Troubleshooting methodologies Analytical thinking and problem-solving capability Ability to communicate effectively in English (written & verbal) Good interpersonal and teamwork skills Willingness to learn in a structured NOC environment Discipline in following processes and procedures Strong sense of accountability and ownership What Will Help You on the Job Familiarity with: ITIL best practices, Operating systems (Linux, Unix, Windows, Script, etc), Scripting skills Exposure to: Network monitoring tools, Telecom or satellite operations or language/web programming Certification or academic exposure: English certification Ability to: Work under pressure during incidents, Prioritize tasks in a live operational environment, Adapt to shift-based or structured working routines You must be eligible to work in this location advertised. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic.

jobs.title: Quality Supervisor
jobs.description: Quality Supervisor Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree (S1) or Diploma in a relevant field. Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Quality Supervisor, Quality Officer, or in a similar role. Experience in implementing and maintaining ISO 9001 and API Q1 Quality Management Systems (QMS). Experience in supervising and performing day-to-day Quality activities, including inspection, calibration, document control, NDT control, and third-party inspection/coordination. Certification in NDT and/or Welding Inspection will be an advantage. Knowledge of Six Sigma and/or Lean Manufacturing principles and methodologies will be an advantage. Knowledge of pipe-related industry standards will be an advantage. Excellent communication skills and ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels. Able to conduct presentations and training sessions. Computer literate with good proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively under pressure. Able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Self-motivated, well-organized, and able to manage priorities effectively. Ensure that all applicable quality requirements are met and oversee the day-to-day implementation of Quality activities within the facility’s operations. Certification in NDT and/or Welding Inspection will be an advantage. Knowledge of Six Sigma and/or Lean Manufacturing principles and methodologies will be an advantage. Knowledge of pipe-related industry standards will be an advantage.

jobs.title: TRAINER (HR GENERALIST)
jobs.description: Kesempatan Ocean Space Group mencari seorang Trainer (HR Generalist) yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PIK Jakarta Utara. Sebagai Trainer HR Generalist, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengembangkan dan meningkatkan kapabilitas sumber daya manusia di seluruh organisasi. Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk merancang, mengembangkan, dan melaksanakan program pelatihan komprehensif yang mencakup berbagai aspek manajemen sumber daya manusia, termasuk pengembangan karyawan, kebijakan HR, dan praktik terbaik industri. Posisi ini memerlukan individu yang memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang HR, kemampuan komunikasi yang kuat, dan passion untuk mengembangkan talenta. Ini adalah posisi fulltime yang berbasis di lokasi kami di PIK Jakarta Utara, Jakarta. Tanggung Jawab Utama Merancang dan mengembangkan program pelatihan HR yang komprehensif dan disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi, mencakup onboarding, pengembangan kepemimpinan, manajemen kinerja, dan hubungan karyawan. Melaksanakan session pelatihan dan workshop kepada karyawan di berbagai tingkatan organisasi dengan metode pembelajaran yang interaktif dan menarik. Mengevaluasi kebutuhan pelatihan melalui analisis gap dan survei karyawan untuk memastikan program relevan dan berdampak. Mengembangkan materi pelatihan dan modul pembelajaran, termasuk presentasi, video, dan dokumentasi pendukung lainnya. Berkolaborasi dengan departemen HR dan manajemen untuk mengidentifikasi prioritas pelatihan dan memastikan alignment dengan tujuan bisnis perusahaan. Mengelola dan memperbarui perpustakaan sumber daya HR, termasuk kebijakan, prosedur, dan panduan best practices. Melakukan assessment terhadap efektivitas program pelatihan melalui feedback peserta dan metrik pembelajaran untuk continuous improvement. Mendokumentasikan dan melaporkan progress pelatihan serta memberikan rekomendasi untuk pengembangan program ke depan. Membantu dalam implementasi inisiatif HR strategis dan perubahan organisasi melalui pelatihan dan komunikasi yang efektif. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal S1 (Sarjana) dalam bidang Human Resources, Pendidikan, Psikologi, Komunikasi, atau bidang terkait lainnya. Minimal 1-2 tahun pengalaman profesional di bidang HR, pelatihan, atau pengembangan organisasi. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang fungsi HR generalist, termasuk recruitment, compensation & benefits, employee relations, dan performance management (lebih diutamakan) Memiliki sertifikasi HR atau pelatihan yang relevan, seperti Certified HR Professional (CHRP) atau equivalent akan menjadi nilai tambah. Kemampuan komunikasi dan presentasi yang excellent dengan skill public speaking yang kuat. Keterampilan instruksional yang terbukti dengan pengalaman merancang dan melaksanakan program pelatihan. Penguasaan software learning management system (LMS) dan tools presentation modern. Kemampuan analytical yang baik untuk mengukur efektivitas pelatihan dan ROI. Kemampuan interpersonal yang kuat dengan emotional intelligence yang tinggi. Fleksibilitas, adaptabilitas, dan kemampuan untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan yang dinamis. Memiliki pemahaman tentang current HR trends dan best practices dalam industri. Mengikuti perkembangan AI Tentang Ocean Space Group Ocean Space Group adalah perusahaan terkemuka yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi bisnis inovatif dan layanan berkualitas tinggi kepada klien kami. Dengan tim yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi, kami terus berkembang dan beradaptasi dengan perubahan pasar global. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami bergantung pada kualitas talenta dan budaya kerja yang kuat. Ocean Space Group menghargai keberagaman, kolaborasi, dan continuous learning. Kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang memberdayakan setiap individu untuk mencapai potensi maksimal mereka dan berkontribusi pada kesuksesan organisasi. Nilai-nilai inti kami adalah integritas, excellence, dan customer-centric approach yang menjadi fondasi dalam setiap keputusan bisnis kami.

jobs.title: Construction Supervisor
jobs.description: About the role HAP Indonesia is seeking an experienced Construction Supervisor to join our team on a contract basis in Kepulauan Riau. This is a pivotal leadership position responsible for overseeing construction projects from inception through completion. As Construction Supervisor, you will play a critical role in ensuring that all construction activities meet our high standards for quality, safety, and efficiency. You will be the on-site leader who bridges communication between senior management and the construction team, whilst maintaining strict adherence to project timelines, budgets, and regulatory requirements. This role is essential to the successful delivery of our construction projects and the safety and wellbeing of all site personnel. Key responsibilities Having more than 8 years of proven experience in planning, execution, and supervision of construction work on projects related to oil & gas facilities, petrochemical plants, mining, geothermal, and power plants. Oversee the execution of construction activities on-site. Ensure compliance with project specifications, safety standards, and timelines. Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and clients to ensure smooth project progress. Strong knowledge of construction processes, project planning, and field supervision also experience working on large-scale construction or industrial projects is a plus. Proficient in driving a manual car and possessing a valid, relevant driver's license. Have good leadership, problem solving & communication skills as well as being hardworking, disciplined, reliable and teamwork. Good English with minimum Bachelor Degree in any Engineering disciplines. Apply now To apply for the Construction Supervisor position at HAP Indonesia, please submit your CV, a cover letter detailing your relevant experience, and any professional certifications. We look forward to hearing from you and discussing how your expertise can contribute to our continued success in Kepulauan Riau.

Our pieces are designed with the modern traveller in mind. We are committed to creating thoughtfully produced, socially responsible garments and aim to minimise our environmental footprint and maximise our positive social impact. Faithfull is committed to creating thoughtfully produced, socially responsible garments. From our manufacturing choices and commercial practices to our organisational culture, community investment, environmental footprint and social impact, we ensure that each step is positive one and one that falls in line with our brand’s value’s. Faithfull has been proudly B-Corp Certified since 2021 and was recertified at the end of 2024. About the Role: The position of Fabric Sourcing and Merchandiser has become available at our Bali head office. Working within the production & development department and reporting to the Fabric Sourcing and Merchandiser Manager. This position plays a vital role in the Production & Development Fabric Department and requires an experienced skill as a Fabric Sourcing & Merchandiser. Key Responsibilities: Assist & Report to Fabric Sourcing & Merchandiser Manager Follow up the hand loom / strike off to be ready as per deadline (local & import) – Production & Development Follow up fabric purchase order, fabric delivery & fabric payment. Create & Manage Fabric Order Report. Create, manage and provide fabric payment schedule to Finance every week (to be updated) based on Purchase Order made during pivot Arrange fabric shipment from fabric suppliers and Bali Warehouse to garment suppliers Create a local fabric tracker for FTB Bali Warehouse (in & out) Create fabric order recap for every season (include: season, PO number, qty, ordered qty, shipped qty, purchased amount & paid amount) Provide production fabric swatches for each garment suppliers before PPM. Create fabric library for all approved fabric in Production. Maintain and manage fabric inventory levels. Input, update and manage fabric data for production and development Monitor & follow up dyeing fabric process Control & follow up fabric order progress Manage fabric administration / fabric payment for production & development Tracking & Verification for fabric invoices Collect and manage data for actual margin costing Analysis data for incoming leftover fabric date from garment vendor to FTB Bali Skills Proficiency in fabric sourcing, quality assessment, supplier management, ERP systems, and Microsoft Excel for data analysis. Strong communication skills, negotiation abilities, attention to detail, adaptability to fabric trends. Working knowledge and understanding of the product creation, production & development process, especially in fabrics. Extensive fabric mill contacts list Understand certified fabrics and ethical sourcing. Strong analytical and numerical skill to work out pivot sales in excel. Pro-active & detail oriented, especially with colours Requirements: At least 5 years related working experience in fabrics Merchandiser Garment industry (Fabric sourcing and Purchasing) Bachelor's degree in Textile engineering or other textile fabrication field preferred Competent in English (written and verbal) Good technical knowledge of fabrics- especially woven, knit Jersey, and knitwear. Working knowledge and understanding of the product creation, production & development process, especially in fabrics. Good personality, honest, independent, and able to work as a team. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Google Drive, PowerPoint, and Excel. Be willing to work at our Bali office.

Established in 2014, Faithfull is an International Fashion label, which fuses Scandinavian simplicity with Australian laid-back spirit, created within the island life ambience of Bali. About the Role:

The position of Fabric Sourcing and Merchandiser has become available at our Bali head office.

Working within the production & development department and reporting to the Fabric Sourcing and Merchandiser Manager. This position plays a vital role in the Production & Development Fabric Department and requires an experienced skill as a Fabric Sourcing & Merchandiser.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist & Report to Fabric Sourcing & Merchandiser Manager

  • Follow up the hand loom / strike off to be ready as per deadline (local & import) – Production & Development

  • Follow up fabric purchase order, fabric delivery & fabric payment.

  • Create & Manage Fabric Order Report.

  • Create, manage and provide fabric payment schedule to Finance every week (to be updated) based on Purchase Order made during pivot

  • Arrange fabric shipment from fabric suppliers and Bali Warehouse to garment suppliers

  • Create a local fabric tracker for FTB Bali Warehouse (in & out)

  • Create fabric order recap for every season (include: season, PO number, qty, ordered qty, shipped qty, purchased amount & paid amount)

  • Provide production fabric swatches for each garment suppliers before PPM.

  • Create fabric library for all approved fabric in Production.

  • Maintain and manage fabric inventory levels.

  • Input, update and manage fabric data for production and development

  • Monitor & follow up dyeing fabric process

  • Control & follow up fabric order progress

  • Manage fabric administration / fabric payment for production & development

  • Tracking & Verification for fabric invoices

  • Collect and manage data for actual margin costing

  • Analysis data for incoming leftover fabric date from garment vendor to FTB Bali

Skills

  • Proficiency in fabric sourcing, quality assessment, supplier management, ERP systems, and Microsoft Excel for data analysis.

  • Strong communication skills, negotiation abilities, attention to detail, adaptability to fabric trends.

  • Working knowledge and understanding of the product creation, production & development process, especially in fabrics.

  • Extensive fabric mill contacts list

  • Understand certified fabrics and ethical sourcing.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skill to work out pivot sales in excel.

  • Pro-active & detail oriented, especially with colours

Requirements:

  • At least 5 years related working experience in fabrics Merchandiser Garment industry (Fabric sourcing and Purchasing)

  • Bachelor's degree in Textile engineering or other textile fabrication field preferred

  • Competent in English (written and verbal)

  • Good technical knowledge of fabrics- especially woven, knit Jersey, and knitwear.

  • Working knowledge and understanding of the product creation, production & development process, especially in fabrics.

  • Good personality, honest, independent, and able to work as a team.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Google Drive, PowerPoint, and Excel.

  • Be willing to work at our Bali office.

jobs.title: Host Live Streaming
jobs.description: About the role Host daily live streaming sessions on platforms such as TikTok and Shopee to drive product awareness and hit sales targets. Present, demonstrate, and pitch products while executing real-time promotional campaigns, flash sales, and exclusive deals. Responsibilities : - Host daily live streaming sessions on platforms such as TikTok and Shopee to drive product awareness and hit sales targets. - Present, demonstrate, and pitch products while executing real-time promotional campaigns, flash sales, and exclusive deals. - Interact dynamically with viewers by answering product inquiries, addressing comments, and building a strong, interactive community during streams. - Ensure proper equipment setup (lighting, audio, visual presentation) and maintain product display aesthetics before and during streams. - Increase the number of live streaming viewers, conversion rate and also handle related data. Qualifications : - Minimum of 1 year of experience as Live Streaming Host - Prior experience in the fashion or apparel e-commerce industry is a plus. - Possesses strong public speaking, high energy, persuasive sales and communication skills - Strong understanding of the TikTok and Shopee Live ecosystems. - Capable and accustomed to conducting live streams, managing live flow, and executing sales campaigns. - Work From Office from Monday-Saturday Location: Pantai Indah Kapuk, North Jakarta

jobs.title: Customer Relation Officer
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Sarana Tripancamitra Solusindo membuka peluang karir untuk posisi Customer Relation Officer yang akan bergabung dengan tim kami di Surabaya, Jawa Timur. Sebagai Customer Relation Officer, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam membangun dan memelihara hubungan jangka panjang yang kuat dengan pelanggan kami. Posisi ini bertanggung jawab atas kepuasan pelanggan, komunikasi dua arah yang efektif, dan implementasi strategi pemasaran dagang yang berfokus pada pelanggan. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime yang memungkinkan Anda untuk berkontribusi secara langsung terhadap pertumbuhan bisnis dan kesuksesan pelanggan kami. Tanggung Jawab Membangun dan memelihara hubungan profesional yang kuat dengan pelanggan melalui komunikasi yang konsisten dan responsif. Menangani pertanyaan, keluhan, dan kebutuhan pelanggan dengan profesional dan memberikan solusi yang efektif. Melakukan koordinasi antara departemen internal untuk memastikan kepuasan pelanggan dan penyelesaian masalah yang tepat waktu. Meningkatkan nilai transaksi dan loyalitas pelanggan. Melakukan follow-up berkala dengan pelanggan untuk memastikan kepuasan dan mengumpulkan feedback untuk perbaikan berkelanjutan. Mendokumentasikan semua interaksi pelanggan dan mengelola database informasi pelanggan dengan akurat dan rapi. Memberikan laporan berkala mengenai metrik kepuasan pelanggan, tren, dan rekomendasi untuk strategi yang lebih baik. Berpartisipasi dalam kegiatan promosi dan event dagang untuk memperkuat kehadiran brand di pasar. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK yang menyukai bidang pemasaran, komunikasi, dan kelistrikan. Kemampuan komunikasi yang excellent, baik lisan maupun tertulis. Keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat dengan kemampuan membangun rapport dengan berbagai tipe pelanggan. Kemampuan problem-solving yang baik untuk mengatasi kebutuhan pelanggan. Keahlian dalam menggunakan software Microsoft Office dan tools komunikasi digital. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dan kemampuan bekerja dalam tim. Orientasi pada hasil dengan fokus pada pencapaian target dan kepuasan pelanggan. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif disesuaikan dengan pengalaman dan performa Anda. Tunjangan kesehatan BPJS Ketenagakerja. Tunjangan hari raya dan bonus performa berdasarkan pencapaian target. Tanggal merah dan hari raya libur. Tentang Kami PT Sarana Tripancamitra Solusindo adalah perusahaan bergerak khusus dalam bidang sistem otomasi industri di Indonesia. Kami berkomitmen memberikan pelayanan dengan kualitas terbaik serta selalu meningkatkan dalam memenuhi kebutuhan untuk perusahaan besar, sedang dan kecil tanpa terkecuali. Tingginya komitmen untuk selalu memberikan kualitas produk dan pelayanan terbaik serta memberikan kepuasan maksimal pada semua pelanggan telah menjadi sumber perhatian utama bagi kami.

jobs.title: Construction Manager
jobs.description: About the role HAP Indonesia is seeking an experienced Construction Manager to join our team on a contract basis . This is a pivotal position based in the Riau Islands , where you will oversee the planning, execution, and completion of construction projects from inception through handover. As Construction Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. This role is essential to our operations, bridging the gap between strategic project objectives and on-site execution, whilst managing teams, resources, and stakeholder relationships across multiple project phases. Key responsibilities Having more than 12 years of comprehensive experience in Construction Management across various sectors, with a minimum of 8 years in projects or facilities related to oil & gas, petrochemicals, mining, geothermal energy, or power plants. Proven experience as a Construction Manager for EPC/EPCI projects or as the principal construction representative in projects for multinational oil & gas or petrochemical companies, civil engineering, mining, geothermal, or power generation, with contract values of at least IDR 200 billion, managing no less than 200 contractor personnel, including subcontractors. Extensive knowledge of construction aspects, including construction techniques, HSE (K3L) applications on-site, constructability reviews, quality standards, progress measurement methods, pre-commissioning, and commissioning processes. Demonstrated strong leadership in HSE, capable of enforcing safety protocols and promoting a safety conscious work environment. Proficiency in business administration processes and a solid understanding of contract principles and legal frameworks. Strong managerial skills with the ability to facilitate coordination, mentorship, coaching, and effective networking. Ability to prepare and deliver motivational presentations and innovative proposals (in both Bahasa Indonesia and English) as part of the selection and interview process. Proficient in driving a manual car and possessing a valid, relevant driver's license. Good English with minimum bachelor's degree in any Engineering disciplines.

jobs.title: HVAC Sales Engineer
jobs.description: HVAC (Chiller) Sales Engineer (Full-time) Company PT Investasi Hijau Selaras (HIJAU) — a renewable energy company developing Cooling-as-a-Service (CaaS) solutions for commercial and industrial buildings. Our focus is on energy efficiency, high reliability, and emissions reduction . Location & Work Arrangement South Jakarta ( on-site ). 40–60% mobility/travel to client sites across Indonesia. Why Join Us New product development: Be part of the pioneering team developing and scaling CaaS solutions in Indonesia. Tangible impact: Help reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions from chiller systems. Professional development: Access to training and professional certifications related to general professional skills and cooling/HVAC systems . Key Responsibilities Develop commercial and industrial client opportunities by identifying cooling requirements and energy-efficiency potential. Present the CaaS business model and communicate its technical, financial, and environmental benefits . Prepare technical and commercial proposals . Conduct site surveys and collect cooling-system performance data. Support technical and commercial negotiations through contract signing. Develop internal processes and systems to support business scalability. Required Qualifications Strong interest in energy efficiency and sustainability . Proactive and solution-oriented , with the ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and in an easy-to-understand manner. Bachelor’s Degree (S1) or Diploma (D3) in Engineering . Comfortable working in a startup-style environment with evolving systems and responsibilities. Willing to travel frequently and conduct site visits across Indonesia . Preferred Qualifications Graduated with a GPA above 3.2 from a reputable university . Experience in HVAC, MEP, and/or chiller systems . Experience in technical sales and/or project-based solution selling . Working proficiency in both Bahasa Indonesia and English . Compensation & Benefits (after complete the probation period) Competitive base salary, based on experience. BPJS, business-trip meal and transportation allowance, travel allowance, and company laptop. Professional development, training, and certification budget after successful completion of probation. Private health insurance through CAR Life after successful completion of probation. Retirement fund program through Manulife DPLK after successful completion of probation. Job Summary Join HIJAU as an HVAC (Chiller) Sales Engineer , where your role will cover client engagement, site assessments, engineering solution development, and the commercialization of cooling systems. You will be part of a new and growing business unit , where your ideas can be translated into real implementation, your professional development is supported through training, and the impact of your work can be directly measured through lower energy costs and reduced carbon emissions .

HVAC (Chiller) Sales Engineer (Full-time)

Company

PT Investasi Hijau Selaras (HIJAU) — a renewable energy company developing Cooling-as-a-Service (CaaS) solutions for commercial and industrial buildings. Our focus is on energy efficiency, high reliability, and emissions reduction.

Location & Work Arrangement

South Jakarta (on-site). 40–60% mobility/travel to client sites across Indonesia.

  • New product development: Be part of the pioneering team developing and scaling CaaS solutions in Indonesia.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and in an easy-to-understand manner.

  • Comfortable working in a startup-style environment with evolving systems and responsibilities.

  • Willing to travel frequently and conduct site visits across Indonesia.

Good understanding of retail KPIs, including sales, margin, inventory, shrinkage, manpower, and operating costs. Willing to travel between stores within the assigned area.

jobs.title: Product Planner (E-Commerce)
jobs.description: Job Descriptions: Responsible for controlling stock levels, forecasting sales per SKU, and executing replenishment plans based on historical data, seasonality, and campaign trends. Develop inventory allocation plans across channels and fulfillment warehouses to maximize product availability and minimize out-of-stock risks. Analyze sales performance, days of inventory, sell-through, and aging stock to optimize product turnover and recommend solutions for slow-moving or overstock items. Conduct inventory data analysis using dashboards and reporting tables to support strategic business decisions. Lead inventory readiness and safety stock planning for major e-commerce mega campaigns (e.g., 9.9, 11.11, Payday campaigns) and promotional events. Collaborate with Merchandising, Marketing, Warehouse, and Marketplace Operations to align stock strategies with commercial goals. Requirements: Min. education of a Bachelor's Degree from any major (preferably Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Business). Minimum 1–2 years of experience as an Inventory Planner, Demand Planner, or Merchandiser in E-commerce or Retail. Proficient in Microsoft Excel (advanced formulas, Pivot Tables) and MS Office; familiarity with ERP, WMS, or OMS systems is preferred. Clear logical thinking, strong numerical sensitivity, and sharp analytical skills with high attention to detail. Excellent communication and cross-departmental collaboration skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.

Berpartisipasi dalam meeting dengan klien atau mitra, serta koordinasi tim internal (marketing/sales). Membuat laporan mingguan tentang progress leads, analisis deal (win/lost), dan strategi revenue Memberikan ide kreatif untuk campaign ataupun event webinar yang berhubungan dengan trend marketing update. Requirements: Minimal lulusan SMA/SMK semua jurusan, atau mahasiswa D3/S1 (semester 5 ke atas) dari jurusan Bisnis, Marketing, Komunikasi, atau terkait. Memiliki minat dan prioritas pada di digital marketing dan sales. Mahir Ms. Office (Excel, PowerPoint) untuk riset dan presentasi; kemampuan dasar Linkedin Antusias belajar tren digital marketing, analisis pasar, dan teamwork di agency dinamis. jobs.title: LOGISTIC ASSISTANT
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Logistic Assistant yang berdedikasi dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim PT Sasco Indonesia. Sebagai Logistic Assistant, Anda akan menjadi bagian integral dari operasi logistik kami, mendukung efisiensi di berbagai fungsi warehousing, storage, dan distribution. Posisi ini memerlukan individu yang telah memiliki pemahaman tentang operasi logistik, dengan kemampuan untuk menangani tugas-tugas administratif dan operasional secara bersamaan. Jabatan ini bersifat full-time dan berlokasi di South Jakarta, Jakarta. Tanggung Jawab Utama Membantu mengelola penerimaan, penyimpanan, dan pengiriman barang dengan memastikan akurasi data dan dokumentasi yang lengkap. Melakukan pengecekan inventory secara berkala dan melaporkan status stock kepada supervisor untuk memastikan ketersediaan barang yang optimal. Mendukung proses import dan logistic barang Mempersiapkan dokumen pengiriman, invoice, dan referensi label dengan teliti dan sesuai prosedur perusahaan. Melakukan input data ke sistem logistik dan memastikan semua informasi tercatat dengan akurat dan tepat waktu. Melakukan komunikasi dengan internal teams, dan vendor terkait status pengiriman dan kebutuhan logistik. Mendukung tim dalam penyelesaian masalah atau ketidaksesuaian dalam proses distribusi dengan cepat dan profesional. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal lulus S1, lebih baik jika memiliki pendidikan di bidang Import dan Logistik. Pengalaman 1-2 tahun di bidang import dan logistik adalah nilai tambah yang signifikan. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik tentang operasi import dan proses logistik secara umum. Terampil dalam penggunaan sistem komputer dasar dan aplikasi office (Microsoft Excel, Word) serta software logistik jika ada. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis, dalam bahasa Indonesia dan lebih baik jika berbahasa Inggris. Memiliki disiplin kerja yang tinggi, teliti, dan detail-oriented dalam mengelola data dan dokumentasi. Kemampuan untuk bekerja dalam tim, responsif terhadap instruksi, dan siap belajar hal-hal baru. Memiliki kemampuan problem-solving yang baik dan dapat beradaptasi dengan lingkungan kerja yang dinamis. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji dan tunjangan yang kompetitif sesuai dengan standar industri logistik dan warehouse. Asuransi kesehatan yang comprehensive untuk melindungi kesejahteraan karyawan. Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan internal untuk meningkatkan keterampilan logistik dan kepemimpinan. Lingkungan kerja yang aman dengan standar keselamatan kerja yang ketat dan perlengkapan safety yang memadai. Cuti tahunan. Ajakan untuk Melamar Jika Anda memiliki semangat dalam dunia logistik, kemampuan organisasi yang baik, dan siap untuk berkontribusi dalam tim yang dinamis, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang . Bergabunglah dengan PT Sasco Indonesia dan mulai karir Anda dalam industri logistik yang berkembang pesat. Kirimkan CV dan surat lamaran Anda untuk memulai perjalanan profesional bersama kami.

jobs.title: Accounting & Tax Supervisor
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari seorang Accounting & Tax Supervisor yang berpengalaman dan profesional untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Vizta Internasional Indonesia. Sebagai Accounting & Tax Supervisor, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengelola fungsi akuntansi dan perpajakan perusahaan, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap regulasi perpajakan Indonesia, dan memberikan supervisi kepada tim akuntansi. Posisi ini memerlukan pemahaman mendalam tentang standar akuntansi internasional, peraturan perpajakan lokal, dan praktik bisnis terbaik. Jabatan ini adalah posisi full-time yang berbasis di Jakarta Utara, Jakarta , dan menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkembang dalam lingkungan perusahaan internasional yang dinamis. Tanggung Jawab Mengelola dan mengawasi semua aktivitas akuntansi harian, termasuk pembukuan, rekonsiliasi akun, dan persiapan laporan keuangan yang akurat. Memastikan kepatuhan penuh terhadap peraturan perpajakan Indonesia, termasuk penyiapan dan pengajuan SPT (Surat Pemberitahuan Tahunan) dan laporan pajak periodik lainnya. Mengidentifikasi peluang optimasi perpajakan dan memberikan rekomendasi strategis untuk meminimalkan beban pajak perusahaan secara legal. Mengkoordinir aktifitas stock opname Melakukan audit internal berkala terhadap catatan keuangan dan proses akuntansi untuk memastikan keakuratan dan efisiensi. Berinteraksi dengan otoritas perpajakan, kantor akuntan publik, dan pihak terkait lainnya dalam hal masalah pajak dan audit keuangan. Mengecek mutasi bank dan rekonsiliasi bank Membuat laporan perpajakan (PPN, PPh 21, 23, 4(2) dan SPT) Persyaratan Pendidikan minimal Diploma atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Akuntansi, Perpajakan, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman kerja di bidang akuntansi dan perpajakan, dengan pengalaman supervisory atau leadership yang relevan. Pengetahuan mendalam tentang peraturan perpajakan Indonesia, termasuk PPN, PPh, dan peraturan pajak lainnya. Terbiasa dengan sistem akuntansi komputer dan perangkat lunak perpajakan modern (seperti Aplikasi Pajak Elektronik (Coretex), dan Software Akuntansi). Pemahaman yang kuat tentang Standar Akuntansi Keuangan Indonesia (SAK) Kemampuan analitik yang excellent dan perhatian terhadap detail dalam menangani data keuangan dan perpajakan yang kompleks. Sertifikasi Akuntan atau Brevet Pajak akan menjadi nilai tambah yang signifikan. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis Integritas tinggi dan kemampuan leadership yang baik Manfaat Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kualifikasi Anda. BPJS Ketenagakerjaan & BPJS Kesehatan Tunjangan hari raya (THR) Cuti tahunan yang generous dan cuti bersama sesuai dengan hari libur nasional. Lingkungan kerja yang positif dan mendukung pertumbuhan profesional Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan tim yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi dalam industri akuntansi dan perpajakan. Tentang Kami PT. Vizta Internasional Indonesia adalah perusahaan Family KTV yang mengelola brand karaoke keluarga Inul Vizta. Dengan tim profesional yang berdedikasi, kami terus berinovasi dan berkembang untuk menjadikan perusahaan sebagai pengelola bisni karaoke keluarga yang kompetitif dan inovatif. Perusahaan kami menghargai integritas, profesionalisme, dan komitmen terhadap pelayanan customer. Kami percaya pada penciptaan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif dan mendukung, di mana setiap anggota tim memiliki kesempatan untuk berkembang dan mencapai potensi penuh mereka. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi persyaratan di atas dan tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami, kami mengundang Anda untuk segera melamar. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portofolio atau referensi profesional Anda kepada tim Human Resources kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih baik dan melihat bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi pada kesuksesan PT Vizta Internasional Indonesia.

  • BPJS Ketenagakerjaan & BPJS Kesehatan

  • Tunjangan hari raya (THR)

  • Cuti tahunan yang generous dan cuti bersama sesuai dengan hari libur nasional.

  • Lingkungan kerja yang positif dan mendukung pertumbuhan profesional

  • Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan tim yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi dalam industri akuntansi dan perpajakan.

Tentang Kami
PT. Vizta Internasional Indonesia adalah perusahaan Family KTV yang mengelola brand karaoke keluarga Inul Vizta. Dengan tim profesional yang berdedikasi, kami terus berinovasi dan berkembang untuk menjadikan perusahaan sebagai pengelola bisni karaoke keluarga yang kompetitif dan inovatif. Perusahaan kami menghargai integritas, profesionalisme, dan komitmen terhadap pelayanan customer. Kami percaya pada penciptaan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif dan mendukung, di mana setiap anggota tim memiliki kesempatan untuk berkembang dan mencapai potensi penuh mereka.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda memenuhi persyaratan di atas dan tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami, kami mengundang Anda untuk segera melamar. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portofolio atau referensi profesional Anda kepada tim Human Resources kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih baik dan melihat bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi pada kesuksesan PT Vizta Internasional Indonesia.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence
jobs.description: Responsible for transforming data into meaningful insights, dashboards, and reports to support business decision-making and improve business performance. Job Description Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports to support business and operational decision-making. Conduct data analysis to identify trends, patterns, insights, and business opportunities. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and define relevant metrics, KPIs, and data requirements. Translate business requirements into effective data solutions and meaningful visualizations. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and integrity across systems and reports. Monitor data quality and investigate discrepancies or anomalies to ensure reliable reporting. Develop and maintain data processes to improve the efficiency and reliability of data-driven workflows. Implement and utilize BI tools and technologies to improve data accessibility and support data-driven processes. Communicate analytical findings and insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactively identify opportunities where data and analytics can improve business processes and decision-making. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. Minimum of 1 year of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Reporting, or a related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. Proficiency in Python and experience working with relational databases. Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar tools. Good understanding of data modeling, reporting, and data analysis concepts. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality. Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with different stakeholders. Proactive, curious, and willing to learn new tools, technologies, and business processes. Able to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment Plus points Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases. Experience working with large datasets and complex data structures. Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines. Experience with cloud databases or data warehouses. Understanding of business metrics, KPI development, and performance analysis. Experience working in a technology, SaaS, CRM, or digital product company. Experience translating business requirements into dashboards, reports, or analytical solutions. Strong business acumen and ability to connect data insights with business objectives. We Are Looking For Someone Who Takes ownership and is willing to go the extra mile to achieve the best outcome. Is proactive, hardworking, and committed to continuous learning and self-improvement. Is humble and open-minded, willing to learn from people regardless of their role, seniority, or background. Is a strong team player who actively supports teammates and contributes beyond their own responsibilities when needed. Believes that great products are built through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed.

Familiar with basic website structure and HTML. Proactive, detail-oriented, and willing to continuously learn. Good communication and collaboration skills. Plus points Experience with technical SEO and website audits. Familiarity with Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking. Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript. jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Staff
jobs.description: Responsible for supporting Stamps' day-to-day financial operations, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately, financial documents are properly maintained, and financial reporting processes run smoothly. Job Description Record and process daily financial transactions, including cash inflows and outflows, petty cash, and employee reimbursements. Perform bank and petty cash reconciliations and maintain proper financial document filing and archiving. Input, monitor, and control financial transactions in the company's systems and spreadsheets. Support the preparation of monthly financial reports, Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) aging reports, and daily cash flow tracking. Assist the Finance team with basic tax administration and documentation, including PPN, PPh, and Coretax. Prepare financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Prepare sales invoices and follow up on payment collection. Operate internet banking platforms for multi-currency transactions. Coordinate and provide supporting data to external tax consultants for tax-related matters. Collaborate with the HRGA team to support finance-related administrative needs and ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 1 year of experience in Finance, Accounting, or a related role. Good understanding of basic accounting principles and financial administration. Familiar with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial data and documents. Good organizational and time management skills. Proactive, responsible, and able to work independently as well as in a team. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Able to work with deadlines and handle confidential financial information. Plus points Experience with accounting or financial management software. Familiarity with PPN, PPh, Coretax, and basic Indonesian tax administration. Experience handling AR/AP, bank reconciliation, petty cash, and cash flow monitoring. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. Having a Brevet AB Tax Certification is an advantage. Experience working in a technology, SaaS, or fast-paced company environment. We Are Looking For Someone Who Takes ownership and is willing to go the extra mile to achieve the best outcome. Is proactive, hardworking, and committed to continuous learning and self-improvement. Is humble and open-minded, willing to learn from people regardless of their role, seniority, or background. Is a strong team player who actively supports teammates and contributes beyond their own responsibilities when needed. Believes that great products are built through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed.

Responsible for ensuring the smooth operation, support, and continuous improvement of systems, applications, websites, and other products developed by Stamps.

Job Description
  • Ensure the smooth operation of systems, applications, websites, and other products developed by the company.
  • Provide system training, technical support, and assistance to clients to ensure effective product usage.
  • Monitor, analyze, and process data or content to support the smooth operation and performance of company systems.
  • Coordinate with clients regarding system development, content updates, and project requirements while ensuring deadlines are met.
  • Perform troubleshooting and identify the root cause of system or application issues.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve technical issues and ensure timely solutions.
  • Respond proactively and promptly to client requests, issues, and operational needs.
  • Assist in system integration activities and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure successful implementation.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in IT Project Operations, IT Operations, Technical Support, or a related field.
  • Familiar with IT products, web applications, and system operations.
  • Good understanding of troubleshooting and problem-solving processes.
  • Proactive and responsive, with the ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with clients and internal teams.
  • Able to work under pressure and manage priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • Mature, responsible, and detail-oriented personality.
  • Willing to learn and adapt to new technologies and business requirements.
Plus points
  • Experience in IT Project Operations, IT Project Management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with system or API integrations.
  • Familiarity with API documentation and tools such as Postman.
  • Basic understanding of REST API, JSON, and data flow between systems.
  • Experience handling client-facing technical support or project coordination.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience working in a technology company, SaaS environment, or software development company.
We Are Looking For Someone Who
  • Takes ownership and is willing to go the extra mile to achieve the best outcome.
  • Is proactive, hardworking, and committed to continuous learning and self-improvement.
  • Is humble and open-minded, willing to learn from people regardless of their role, seniority, or background.
  • Is a strong team player who actively supports teammates and contributes beyond their own responsibilities when needed.
  • Believes that great products are built through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed.

jobs.title: Software Quality Assurance
jobs.description: Responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software products through thorough testing and validation Job Description: Ensure the quality, reliability, and stability of applications throughout the development lifecycle. Perform functional, regression, and API testing to ensure applications meet requirements and perform as expected. Conduct API testing and validation using Postman. Perform continuous testing to maintain the quality of applications before release. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including preparing test scenarios, coordinating testing activities, and ensuring test cases are properly executed before delivery to clients. Collaborate closely with the Product team to understand business requirements, objectives, and expected outcomes. Identify, document, and track bugs with clear descriptions, reproduction steps, and supporting evidence. Work closely with developers to analyze reported issues, validate fixes, and ensure problems are resolved effectively. Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, workflows, and overall product quality. Requirements Minimum 1 year of experience in Software Quality Assurance or a related role. Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset. Good verbal and written communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia. Familiarity with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and software testing methodologies. Experience with functional testing, regression testing, and UAT. Familiarity with API testing and tools such as Postman. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with Product and Development teams. Plus points Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools. Experience testing web and mobile applications. Familiarity with API documentation, REST API, and JSON. Experience working in a SaaS, CRM, POS, or technology environment. Experience working with Agile development teams. Familiarity with bug tracking and project management tools. We Are Looking For Someone Who Takes ownership and is willing to go the extra mile to achieve the best outcome. Is proactive, hardworking, and committed to continuous learning and self-improvement. Is humble and open-minded, willing to learn from people regardless of their role, seniority, or background. Is a strong team player who actively supports teammates and contributes beyond their own responsibilities when needed. Believes that great products are built through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed.
