Job Description Area Tanggung Jawab Production Management : Mengatur seluruh proses produksi central kitchen sesuai forecast dan kebutuhan outlet. Production Planning : Menyusun production plan berdasarkan sales forecast, par stock, order outlet, dan kapasitas produksi. Raw Material Management : Memastikan ketersediaan bahan baku, kualitas bahan, quantity, dan spesifikasi sesuai standar. Inventory Management : Mengontrol stock bahan baku dan produk jadi, termasuk FIFO/FEFO dan stock accuracy. Quality Control : Memastikan konsistensi rasa, ukuran, kualitas, yield, dan standar produk sebelum dikirim ke outlet . Food Safety & Hygiene : Memastikan penerapan GMP, HACCP/food safety, hygiene, sanitasi, temperature control, dan SOP. Cost Control : Mengontrol food cost, production cost, waste, yield, overtime, utilities, dan manpower cost. Distribution : Memastikan produk dikirim ke outlet sesuai quantity, quality, temperature, dan delivery schedule. SOP & Standardization Membuat, menjalankan, mengevaluasi, dan memperbaiki SOP produksi central kitchen. Manpower Management : Mengatur manpower, shift, productivity, attendance, performance, dan development team. Equipment Management : Memastikan equipment produksi berfungsi dengan baik dan berkoordinasi dengan Engineering untuk maintenance. Waste Management : Mengidentifikasi dan mengurangi waste akibat overproduction, expired, production defect, dan handling error. Outlet Coordination : Berkoordinasi dengan Operations/Outlet mengenai kebutuhan produk, complaint, forecast, dan perubahan demand. R&D Coordination : Berkolaborasi dengan R&D dalam trial, scale-up recipe, standardisasi proses, dan implementasi produk baru. Problem Solving : Menangani production issue, shortage, quality issue, equipment breakdown, dan keterlambatan distribusi. Reporting : Membuat laporan production, inventory, waste, productivity, cost, quality, dan delivery performance. Continuous Improvement : Mengembangkan improvement untuk meningkatkan kapasitas, produktivitas, kualitas, dan efisiensi biaya. 3. Alur Tanggung Jawab Central Kitchen Forecast Outlet ↓ Production Planning ↓ Material Planning ↓ Receiving & QC Raw Material ↓ Preparation ↓ Production / Cooking ↓ Cooling / Packing ↓ QC & Food Safety Check ↓ Storage ↓ Distribution to Outlet ↓ Monitoring & Evaluation 4. Kualifikasi Pendidikan Minimal D3/S1 Food Technology, Food Science, Culinary, Hospitality, Management, Industrial Engineering, atau bidang terkait. Pendidikan Culinary/Food Technology menjadi nilai tambah. Pengalaman Minimal 5–7 tahun pengalaman di F&B, Central Kitchen, Catering, Food Manufacturing, atau Restaurant Chain . Minimal 2–3 tahun pada posisi Manager/Supervisor Central Kitchen/Production Manager/Kitchen Manager/Executive Chef . Berpengalaman mengelola high-volume production dan multiple outlets. Pengalaman mengelola central kitchen untuk multi-outlet menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki pengalaman dalam opening outlet/new product launch menjadi nilai tambah. Technical Skills Wajib memahami: Production planning & scheduling Food production management Food costing & cost control Inventory management FIFO & FEFO Yield & portion control Waste management Food safety & hygiene GMP, HACCP, SSOP Quality control Recipe & product standardization Manpower planning Productivity management Supply chain & distribution Basic P&L/COGS Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets HRIS/ERP/POS atau production system menjadi nilai tambah 5. Leadership Competency Central Kitchen Manager idealnya memiliki kemampuan: Leadership & People Management Planning & Organizing Problem Solving Analytical Thinking Decision Making Cost Consciousness Quality Orientation Time Management Communication Cross-functional Collaboration Continuous Improvement Attention to Detail

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Modern Trade (MT)
jobs.description: About us PT Lock & Lock Indonesia is a leading provider of innovative kitchenware and home storage solutions. We are committed to delivering premium quality products that enhance everyday living for families across Indonesia. Our brand is built on principles of durability, innovation and customer satisfaction. We pride ourselves on our strong distribution network and our ability to meet the evolving needs of modern consumers. We are an ambitious, growth-focused organisation that values excellence, teamwork and continuous improvement. About the role We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales Manager – Modern Trade (MT) to join PT Lock & Lock Indonesia. This position is based in South Jakarta . As Sales Manager for Modern Trade, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and market penetration across modern retail channels, including hypermarkets, supermarkets, and department stores. This role is critical to our commercial strategy, as modern trade represents a significant distribution channel for our premium kitchenware and home products. You will lead a dedicated team, develop strategic partnerships with key retail accounts, and ensure optimal product visibility and sales performance across all modern trade outlets. Job Description Develop and manage the company's Modern Trade (MT) sales channel . Manage sales activities and maintain strong relationships with Modern Trade and discount store customers . Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve sales targets and business growth . Manage sales orders, product availability, and stock levels across MT channels. Monitor and manage inventory and stock movement to ensure optimal product availability. Coordinate with Warehouse, Supply Chain, and related departments to ensure smooth order fulfillment and inventory management. Monitor sales performance, inventory levels, sell-in/sell-out, and other key sales indicators. Prepare regular sales and inventory reports for management. Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify business opportunities. Manage promotions, sales programs, and product activities within MT channels. Conduct regular store and customer visits to monitor product display, stock availability, and sales performance. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field . Minimum 8 years of experience in Sales , with strong experience in Modern Trade / Retail / FMCG / Consumer Goods industries. Proven experience managing Modern Trade or discount store channels . Strong inventory and stock management experience is required. Good understanding of sales planning, inventory management, and order fulfillment . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in analyzing sales and inventory data . Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills. Proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving business growth. Strong leadership and team management skills. Good coordination skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams. Good command of English , both written and verbal. Korean language proficiency is a plus.

jobs.title: KOL & AFFILIATE SPECIALIST
jobs.description: Responsibilities : Mengelola aktivitas Live Commerce Menyusun jadwal dan kalender Live Streaming. Mempersiapkan kebutuhan Live, termasuk konsep, produk, promo, script, dan briefing host. Memantau dan mengevaluasi performa Live berdasarkan viewer, engagement, conversion, GMV, dan sales. Mengelola KOL & Influencer Melakukan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan koordinasi dengan KOL/Influencer. Menyusun brief dan memastikan KOL/Influencer memahami campaign yang dijalankan. Melakukan evaluasi performa KOL berdasarkan reach, engagement, traffic, conversion, dan sales contribution. Mengembangkan Program Affiliate Menjalankan program dan campaign Affiliate untuk meningkatkan penjualan E-Commerce. Menjaga hubungan dan komunikasi dengan Affiliate agar tetap aktif dan produktif. Memantau performa Affiliate berdasarkan GMV, orders, conversion, revenue, dan ROI. Requirements : Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 dari semua jurusan, diutamakan Marketing, Komunikasi, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun di bidang E-Commerce, Digital Marketing, KOL/Influencer Management, Affiliate Marketing, atau Live Commerce. Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengelola KOL, influencer, dan affiliate, mulai dari pencarian talent, komunikasi, negosiasi, briefing, pelaksanaan campaign, hingga evaluasi performa. Memahami Live Commerce/Live Streaming, khususnya melalui TikTok Shop, Shopee, Tokopedia, atau platform sejenis. Mampu mencari dan mengembangkan KOL, Creator, dan Affiliate yang sesuai dengan target audience dan karakter brand. Memahami metrik performa E-Commerce dan Affiliate seperti GMV, Revenue, Conversion Rate, CTR, Engagement Rate, ROAS/ROI, Commission, dan Cost per Order. Mampu melakukan analisis performa Social Media dan E-Commerce serta memberikan rekomendasi berdasarkan data. Memahami tren media sosial, tren konten, dan perilaku audiens, terutama TikTok dan Instagram. Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets untuk pengolahan dan analisis data. Mampu secara mandiri mengembangkan dan menjalankan aktivitas konten Social Media dan Social Commerce ketika aktivitas KOL dan Affiliate sedang Low. Penempatan di Batu Ceper , Kota Tangerang Jika anda adalah seorang yang kreatif & inovatif terhadap perkembangan jaman khususnya social media dan ingin membangun karir di Perusahaan Lighting & Electrical Products Terbesar dan Tersebar di Asia Tenggara PT. Mitra Amertha Sejahtera adalah perusahaan Principle dari merek MEVAL, a Regional Brand for Quality Lighting and Electrical Products: 1. Sebagai Exclusive Distributor dari produk Electrical Lighting dengan kualitas dan merek Global 2. Berkantor pusat di Singapore dengan wilayah operasional di Philiphines, Indonesia dan Vietnam 3. Memiliki Visi : We light up more worlds by providing more affordable durable lighting power solutions 4. Memiliki Value: Customer Satisfaction, Integrity, Continuous Improvement, Flexibility dan Commitment Benefits : Career Development Tunjangan Kesehatan Annual Bonus : berdasarkan kinerja perusahaan dan pribadi Opportunity to grow.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Utama Membangun dan memelihara pipeline ETL/ELT dari sistem sumber yang disetujui lengkap dengan pemantauan. Merancang model data, struktur staging, dan data mart serta pemeriksaan kualitas data sejak data masuk. Mengotomatiskan penyiapan laporan berulang yang saat ini masih dirakit manual. Mengatur lineage, metadata, retensi dan hak akses data bersama fungsi IT Governance, Risk & Compliance. Mendampingi pengguna bisnis dengan data terdokumentasi dan menanggapi pertanyaan kualitas data. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal S1 dalam Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Informatika, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman sebagai Data Engineer atau posisi sejenis di industri teknologi atau perusahaan dengan skala data besar. Memiliki keahlian dalam bahasa mendalam pemrograman seperti Python, Java, atau Scala untuk kebutuhan data engineering. Memiliki kemampuan SQL yang kuat termasuk window function dan optimasi query, perancangan dan pembangunan ETL/ELT. Memahami pemodelan data dimensional dan memiliki kemampuan minimal satu bahasa scripting (diutamakan Python) serta memahami penggunaan version control. Menguasai minimal 1 perangkat BI (Power BI/Tableau/Looker Studio) untuk mendukung pembuatan laporan dan visualisasi data. Memiliki kemampuan untuk mengklarifikasi dan mendokumentasikan defisimi definisi metrik tertulis sebelum melakukan otomatisasi pipeline. Memahami pengaturan hak akses data, retensi serta penanganan data pribadi sesuai dengan (UU No. 27/2022).

jobs.title: Inventory Control Manager
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Lead and manage Inventory Control activities across multiple operational sites . Develop and implement inventory control strategies, policies, and procedures to ensure effective and consistent inventory management. Monitor and maintain optimal minimum/maximum stock levels, safety stock, and replenishment levels . Ensure product and material availability to support daily catering and camp facility operations. Monitor and control stock-outs, overstock, slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory . Analyze inventory movement and improve inventory turnover and working capital efficiency . Monitor inventory accuracy through regular stock reconciliation, stock taking, cycle counting, and inventory audits . Coordinate with Warehouse/Store teams to ensure accurate receiving, storage, issuance, transfer, and movement of inventory. Coordinate with Procurement to ensure timely replenishment and availability of required materials and supplies. Develop inventory requirements based on operational demand, historical consumption, occupancy/headcount, menu requirements, and business forecasts . Monitor and control inventory value, carrying costs, waste, expiry, and inventory losses . Utilize ERP and BI tools for inventory monitoring, analysis, reporting, and decision-making. Establish and monitor key Inventory KPIs , including stock accuracy, inventory turnover, inventory aging, stock availability, stock variance, inventory value, waste, expiry, and slow/non-moving inventory. Identify inventory risks and implement appropriate mitigation and corrective actions. Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve inventory accuracy, efficiency, cost effectiveness, and operational performance. Lead, develop, and evaluate the performance of the Inventory Control team. Work closely with Operations, Warehouse/Store, Procurement, Finance, and Project Teams to ensure effective inventory management. Prepare regular inventory performance reports and provide analysis and recommendations to management. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration , or a related field. Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Inventory Control, Inventory Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related functions. Proven experience in a Supervisor or Managerial role , with strong team leadership experience. Strong experience in multi-site operations , preferably within catering, camp facility, hospitality, food service , or similar industries. Hands-on experience managing inventory such as food ingredients, dry goods, fresh/chilled/frozen items, beverages, consumables, cleaning supplies, and general supplies . Good understanding of inventory management in remote site/camp operations , including replenishment, inter-site transfers, stock accuracy, inventory optimization, waste, and expiry control. Experience in mining camp, remote camp, or project-based camp operations will be highly advantageous. Strong knowledge and experience in inventory optimization and inventory control systems . Experience with ERP system implementation, enhancement, or process improvement , particularly in inventory and warehouse management. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and/or BI tools for inventory analysis and reporting. Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and leadership skills . Strong commercial awareness with a focus on inventory accuracy, cost efficiency, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement .

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage Inventory Control activities across multiple operational sites.

  • Develop and implement inventory control strategies, policies, and procedures to ensure effective and consistent inventory management.

  • Monitor and maintain optimal minimum/maximum stock levels, safety stock, and replenishment levels.

  • Ensure product and material availability to support daily catering and camp facility operations.

  • Monitor and control stock-outs, overstock, slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory.

  • Analyze inventory movement and improve inventory turnover and working capital efficiency.

  • Monitor inventory accuracy through regular stock reconciliation, stock taking, cycle counting, and inventory audits.

  • Coordinate with Warehouse/Store teams to ensure accurate receiving, storage, issuance, transfer, and movement of inventory.

  • Coordinate with Procurement to ensure timely replenishment and availability of required materials and supplies.

  • Develop inventory requirements based on operational demand, historical consumption, occupancy/headcount, menu requirements, and business forecasts.

  • Monitor and control inventory value, carrying costs, waste, expiry, and inventory losses.

  • Utilize ERP and BI tools for inventory monitoring, analysis, reporting, and decision-making.

  • Establish and monitor key Inventory KPIs, including stock accuracy, inventory turnover, inventory aging, stock availability, stock variance, inventory value, waste, expiry, and slow/non-moving inventory.

  • Identify inventory risks and implement appropriate mitigation and corrective actions.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve inventory accuracy, efficiency, cost effectiveness, and operational performance.

  • Lead, develop, and evaluate the performance of the Inventory Control team.

  • Work closely with Operations, Warehouse/Store, Procurement, Finance, and Project Teams to ensure effective inventory management.

  • Prepare regular inventory performance reports and provide analysis and recommendations to management.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Inventory Control, Inventory Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related functions.

  • Proven experience in a Supervisor or Managerial role, with strong team leadership experience.

  • Strong experience in multi-site operations, preferably within catering, camp facility, hospitality, food service, or similar industries.

  • Hands-on experience managing inventory such as food ingredients, dry goods, fresh/chilled/frozen items, beverages, consumables, cleaning supplies, and general supplies.

  • Good understanding of inventory management in remote site/camp operations, including replenishment, inter-site transfers, stock accuracy, inventory optimization, waste, and expiry control.

  • Experience in mining camp, remote camp, or project-based camp operations will be highly advantageous.

  • Strong knowledge and experience in inventory optimization and inventory control systems.

  • Experience with ERP system implementation, enhancement, or process improvement, particularly in inventory and warehouse management.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and/or BI tools for inventory analysis and reporting.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and leadership skills.

  • Strong commercial awareness with a focus on inventory accuracy, cost efficiency, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Data Center Network Engineer
jobs.description: Data Center Network Engineer Role Overview We are looking for a Data Center Network Engineer to support the operation, health, and performance of a high-performance data center network environment. The role will focus on network fabric operations, connectivity, troubleshooting, and performance stability across server, switch, and storage environments. Key Responsibilities Monitor and maintain the health, connectivity, and performance of the data center network fabric. Troubleshoot end-to-end connectivity across server, switch, and storage environments. Perform network health checks, link validation, and performance troubleshooting. Identify and troubleshoot issues related to optics, cabling, ports, VLANs, routing, and network policies. Support switch provisioning, configuration, firmware upgrades, and day-2 network operations. Monitor network traffic, congestion, and overall fabric performance. Perform troubleshooting across Dell, NVIDIA, and third-party network components. Support network performance validation and operational readiness activities. Technical Requirements Strong knowledge of data center Ethernet networking and switching. Experience with large-scale data center network environments. Experience with high-throughput and/or low-latency networking environments. Understanding of network traffic behavior, congestion, and performance tuning. Understanding of lossless Ethernet concepts is preferred. Experience with switch provisioning, firmware lifecycle management, and network monitoring/telemetry. Strong troubleshooting skills across network infrastructure components. Good understanding of server-to-switch and switch-to-storage connectivity. Ideal Background Experience in data center networking . Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC networking environments is preferred. Experience with high-performance Ethernet environments is a plus. Experience working with multi-vendor network infrastructure is preferred.

  • Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC networking environments is preferred.

  • Experience with high-performance Ethernet environments is a plus.

  • Experience working with multi-vendor network infrastructure is preferred.

Proficient with Microsoft Project & Primavera Shall be a team player with excellent interpersonal skill. Placement: Bintaro (South Tangerang)

jobs.title: IT Governance, Risk & Compliance Expert
jobs.description: Job Purpose Manage and ensure that systems, services and infrastructure work in accordance with good information technology (IT) governance. Job Responsibility & Authority 1. Advise the board and senior management to ensure best practice IT in internal controls, SOP, governance, incorporating risk, and audit 2. Conduct internal audits to ensure organizational and program compliance with best practice, regulatory, including Data Protection and contract requirements 3. Perform security and compliance assessments on new and existing systems, processes, technology. 4. Collaborate to define IT security standards and develop supporting organizational policies. 5. Work with various business units or department to ensure controls are adequate, appropriate, and effective 6. Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity planning including backup system 7. Perform business impact analysis and assist with development of IT risk register 8. Stay up to date and informed on developing regulatory concerns and changing IT and information security trends. 9. Design, consult on, gain management approval for, implement, and change management for corporate compliance and risk processes to ensure governance & compliance are in place & well implemented Job Requirement Min. Education: IT/Computing Studies/Information System Min. Experience: 2-3 years Competencies: A. Technical - Strong understanding of fundamental information security concepts and technology (IT Knowledge) - Experience with IT Governance, risk, and compliance management in a large environment - Experience in IT Governance, Risk & Compliance for SOP design, creation, seeking approval, implementation, and change management process - Have certification in IT security will be a plus B. Softskills - Problem Solving - Building Relationship - Team Collaboration - Achieving Goals - Trustworthiness - Written and oral communication

jobs.title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager (Bakery)
jobs.description: We're not just looking for a marketer. We're looking for a Strong brand builder Responsibilities • Mengembangkan dan mengeksekusi strategi brand untuk meningkatkan brand awareness, customer engagement, dan penjualan. • Memimpin perencanaan serta pelaksanaan marketing campaign , termasuk product launch, seasonal campaign, grand opening, dan promotional campaign. • Menjaga konsistensi identitas dan positioning brand Maison Féerie di seluruh channel online maupun offline. • Mengembangkan dan mengelola strategi Digital Marketing , Social Media, Content Marketing, Influencer/KOL Collaboration, serta Paid Advertising. • Berkolaborasi dengan tim R&D, Operations, Sales, dan Production dalam peluncuran produk baru serta aktivitas pemasaran. • Menganalisis tren pasar, perilaku konsumen, dan aktivitas kompetitor untuk menyusun strategi marketing yang efektif. • Mengelola marketing budget serta mengevaluasi efektivitas campaign berdasarkan KPI dan ROI. • Memimpin, mengembangkan, dan melakukan coaching kepada tim Brand Marketing & Creative. • Menjalin kerja sama strategis dengan media, influencer, komunitas, dan partner bisnis. Qualifications • Minimal S1 Marketing, Business Management, Communication, atau bidang terkait. • Minimal 7 tahun pengalaman di bidang Brand Marketing, dengan minimal 3 tahun sebagai Brand Marketing Manager atau Senior Brand Marketing Manager. • Wajib memiliki pengalaman di industri Bakery (Bakery Chain, Artisan Bakery, Patisserie, Café Bakery, atau Premium Bakery). • Berpengalaman dalam menyusun dan mengeksekusi Brand Strategy, Marketing Campaign, Product Launch, dan Digital Marketing. • Memiliki pengalaman memimpin dan mengembangkan tim Marketing & Creative. • Memiliki kemampuan leadership, komunikasi, analisis, dan project management yang baik. • Berpengalaman mengelola marketing budget serta mengevaluasi performa campaign. • Mampu bekerja di lingkungan yang dinamis, cepat, dan berorientasi pada hasil. Penempatan : Tangerang, Pondok Kacang

jobs.title: Asisten GM Mandarin
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami dari PT Hongsheng International Trading, perusahaan manufaktur multinasional yang berbasis di Semarang, Jawa Tengah, saat ini sedang mencari Asisten GM Mandarin yang berdedikasi dan terampil untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Dalam peran ini, Anda akan bertindak sebagai mitra inti Assisten GM kami, memberikan dukungan administratif dan komunikasi yang cakap dalam bahasa Mandarin. Tanggung Jawab Utama Bertanggung jawab atas tugas-tugas administrasi harian, seperti pengaturan jadwal, perjalanan, dan komunikasi untuk Manajer Umum. Menyiapkan dan menerjemahkan dokumen, presentasi, dan korespondensi berbahasa Mandarin. Mengkoordinasikan rapat, konferensi, dan acara di tingkat manajemen. Memberikan dukungan logistik untuk kebutuhan kantor dan perjalanan Manajer Umum. Menjadi penghubung utama antara manajemen senior dan pemangku kepentingan internal maupun eksternal. Membantu mengelola proyek-proyek khusus yang ditetapkan oleh Manajer Umum. Keterampilan dan Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan Minimal Diploma atau setara di bidang Administrasi Bisnis, Administrasi Perkantoran, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki setidaknya 3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Asisten Eksekutif atau peran administrasi senior serupa. Sangat fasih dalam berbahasa Mandarin, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis. Terampil dalam menggunakan paket Microsoft Office dan alat produktivitas kantor. Memiliki kemampuan organisasi dan manajemen waktu yang sangat baik. Mampu bekerja dengan cekatan di bawah tekanan dan memenuhi tenggat waktu. Memiliki ketertarikan pada bisnis internasional dan wilayah Asia Timur. Manfaat Gaji kompetitif dan tunjangan menarik Kesempatan berkembang dalam lingkungan bisnis global yang dinamis Budaya kerja yang mendukung dan menjunjung keberagaman Tentang Kami PT Hongsheng International Trading adalah perusahaan manufaktur multinasional yang berfokus pada industri garment dan alas kaki. Kami telah menjadi pemain utama di pasar Asia Tenggara dengan reputasi yang kuat dalam kualitas dan inovasi produk. Kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang beragam, inklusif, dan mendukung pertumbuhan profesional karyawan. Bergabung dengan kami berarti menjadi bagian dari tim yang dinamis dan berdedikasi, yang didorong oleh semangat untuk menjadi yang terbaik dalam industri kami. Tertarik untuk bergabung dengan PT Hongsheng International? Lamar posisi Asisten GM Mandarin kami sekarang!

  • Bertanggung jawab atas tugas-tugas administrasi harian, seperti pengaturan jadwal, perjalanan, dan komunikasi untuk Manajer Umum.

  • Menyiapkan dan menerjemahkan dokumen, presentasi, dan korespondensi berbahasa Mandarin.

  • Mengkoordinasikan rapat, konferensi, dan acara di tingkat manajemen.

  • Memberikan dukungan logistik untuk kebutuhan kantor dan perjalanan Manajer Umum.

  • Menjadi penghubung utama antara manajemen senior dan pemangku kepentingan internal maupun eksternal.

  • Membantu mengelola proyek-proyek khusus yang ditetapkan oleh Manajer Umum.

Keterampilan dan Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan

  • Minimal Diploma atau setara di bidang Administrasi Bisnis, Administrasi Perkantoran, atau bidang terkait.

  • Memiliki setidaknya 3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Asisten Eksekutif atau peran administrasi senior serupa.

  • Sangat fasih dalam berbahasa Mandarin, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis.

  • Terampil dalam menggunakan paket Microsoft Office dan alat produktivitas kantor.

  • Memiliki kemampuan organisasi dan manajemen waktu yang sangat baik.

  • Mampu bekerja dengan cekatan di bawah tekanan dan memenuhi tenggat waktu.

  • Memiliki ketertarikan pada bisnis internasional dan wilayah Asia Timur.

Manfaat

  • Gaji kompetitif dan tunjangan menarik

  • Kesempatan berkembang dalam lingkungan bisnis global yang dinamis

  • Budaya kerja yang mendukung dan menjunjung keberagaman

Tentang Kami
PT Hongsheng International Trading adalah perusahaan manufaktur multinasional yang berfokus pada industri garment dan alas kaki. Kami telah menjadi pemain utama di pasar Asia Tenggara dengan reputasi yang kuat dalam kualitas dan inovasi produk. Kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang beragam, inklusif, dan mendukung pertumbuhan profesional karyawan. Bergabung dengan kami berarti menjadi bagian dari tim yang dinamis dan berdedikasi, yang didorong oleh semangat untuk menjadi yang terbaik dalam industri kami.


Tertarik untuk bergabung dengan PT Hongsheng International? Lamar posisi Asisten GM Mandarin kami sekarang!

jobs.title: Marketing & Bussines Development
jobs.description: Our group spans four distinct businesses, with more to come. We are building a structured, results-driven marketing function to bring our brands together, strengthen their presence, and unlock new opportunities for growth. Lifestyle Capital Club is our premium lifestyle and business hub, featuring padel, a golf simulator, VIP rooms, and premium lounge and dining. Integras is our B2B one-stop printing and packaging business, delivering end-to-end solutions across digital and offset printing — from packaging and paper bags to promotional and commercial materials. We serve businesses across F&B, retail, cosmetics, e-commerce, FMCG, and more. Garage Café operates in F&B, while SLT Autoboutique is our automotive retail arm. Each business has its own audience, character, and commercial opportunity. As part of our Marketing & Business Development team, you'll play a hands-on role in building our brands, creating meaningful market opportunities, developing partnerships, and turning marketing activities into measurable business results. This is a role for someone who enjoys building, executing, testing, and improving — not just making plans. WHAT YOU'LL DO Brand & Positioning • Shape how each brand is positioned and presented across every customer touchpoint. • Maintain consistency in brand identity, messaging, and overall customer experience. Marketing & Communications • Develop and execute marketing campaigns, promotional materials, and brand communications across multiple businesses. • Support partnership proposals, pitch decks, and materials for new business opportunities. Digital Marketing & Content • Manage social media, content, digital campaigns, paid advertising, and other digital channels. • Monitor performance, test ideas, and continuously optimize based on data and results. Business Development & Partnerships • Identify potential business opportunities, partnerships, collaborations, and new customer segments. • Support outreach and relationship-building initiatives that can generate commercial value for the group. Offline Marketing & Activations • Plan and execute events, activations, campaigns, and on-ground initiatives. • Work closely with our internal teams and leverage Integras' in-house production capabilities to bring campaigns to life. Strategic Alignment • Work closely with top management and business-unit teams to ensure marketing activities are aligned with commercial priorities and the group's direction. Performance & Reporting • Set clear objectives and measurable targets for marketing initiatives. • Track performance, analyze results, and provide structured reporting and actionable recommendations to management. WHAT YOU'LL NEED • 2–4 years of hands-on marketing experience, with a proven track record of executing campaigns and initiatives directly. • Comfortable working across digital, offline, content, events, and activations — you're a marketer who enjoys wearing multiple hats. • Strong interest in business development, partnerships, and commercial growth, not just brand awareness. • Experience managing multiple brands, products, or business units is a strong advantage. Agency, startup, or multi-business experience is a plus. • Highly organized and disciplined — you can manage priorities, meet deadlines, and keep reporting structured and consistent. • Builder mindset: excited to create systems, processes, and initiatives from the ground up rather than simply maintaining what already exists. • Able to balance big-picture thinking with hands-on execution and attention to detail. • Comfortable using AI tools, MS Office, and Google Workspace to work smarter and move faster. • Willing to be hands-on and frequently in the field across our different business locations. • Most importantly, we value proven results, ownership, and initiative over formal credentials. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do. Someone who can look at a business, understand the opportunity, come up with an idea, execute it, measure the result, and make it better. If you enjoy working across different industries, building brands from the ground up, developing new opportunities, and seeing your work directly contribute to business growth — we'd like to hear from you.

Willing to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays when required.

Support the child in following classroom routines and participating appropriately in the Montessori environment. Observe the child's needs, behaviour, engagement, and progress, and communicate relevant observations to the classroom teachers. Encourage the child to develop independence rather than becoming overly dependent on adult assistance. Assist the child in accessing and participating in learning activities under the direction of the classroom teacher. Support positive social interactions and communication with peers. jobs.title: Software Developer Lead
jobs.description: Lead and manage the software development team for Syspex automation and technology projects. Lead software development, integration and deployment for AI Camera, machine vision, robotics, AMR, automation and smart factory solutions. Understand customer requirements and translate automation requirements into software/system solutions. Lead integration between machines, robots, AMR, AI cameras, PLC, sensors, MES/WMS/ERP and other systems. Develop or supervise development of AI Camera applications, including camera integration, AI detection, data processing, monitoring and dashboard applications. Lead software architecture, database, API, communication protocols and system integration. Review software design, coding standards, testing, troubleshooting and deployment. Work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Design & Engineering, Project Management and Technical teams. Provide technical direction and mentoring to software team members. Lead PoC, prototype and new technology development for Syspex's automation solutions. Maintain software documentation, source code, system architecture and development standards. Continuously evaluate new technologies in AI, computer vision, IoT, robotics, AMR and industrial software. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, Automation, Electrical Engineering or related field. Minimum 5–8 years of software development experience, with experience leading a software/development team. Proven experience in software architecture, system integration and project delivery. Strong programming knowledge in one or more of: Python, C#, C++, JavaScript/TypeScript. Good understanding of API, REST, database, TCP/IP, MQTT, OPC UA and industrial communication. Understanding of AI, Computer Vision, Machine Vision and AI Camera development/integration. Experience with OpenCV, AI/ML frameworks or edge AI is an advantage. Understanding of PLC, robotics, AMR, IoT and industrial automation. Experience integrating software with robots, AMR, cameras, PLCs, sensors, MES/WMS/ERP or other industrial systems. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Able to review and manage software source code and development practices. Strong leadership, communication and project management skills. Able to work hands-on when required, not only manage the team.

jobs.title: Content Creator
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal D3/Sederajat, terbuka untuk Fresh Graduate. Usia Maks 28 tahun Aktif mengikuti dan memahami tren media sosial terkini, khususnya Instagram dan TikTok, termasuk Reels, TikTok, trending audio, viral format, hook, dan content trends. Percaya diri tampil di depan kamera, komunikatif, ekspresif, dan tidak canggung saat on-camera. Kreatif, inovatif, memiliki ide out-of-the-box, serta berani mencoba format dan konsep konten baru. Terbiasa menggunakan Instagram & TikTok, termasuk membuat dan mengunggah konten, memahami basic Insight/Analytics, serta melakukan scheduling/posting. Memahami dasar content planning, storytelling, copywriting, caption, hook, dan CTA menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu melakukan basic video editing menggunakan CapCut, Adobe Premiere, VN, atau aplikasi sejenis. Memiliki kemampuan dasar dalam pengambilan foto/video menggunakan smartphone menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, rapi, dan terorganisir dalam mengelola content calendar, jadwal posting, caption, serta data/performance report. Memiliki inisiatif tinggi, cepat belajar, adaptif terhadap tren, dan mampu bekerja dengan target serta deadline. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim dengan komunikasi yang baik. Memiliki portfolio konten, akun media sosial aktif, atau contoh hasil karya menjadi nilai tambah. Penempatan di Pluit, Jakarta Utara Job Desc : Content Planning: Menyusun ide dan content calendar IG & TikTok, melakukan riset tren, serta mengembangkan konsep konten kreatif dan inovatif. Content Production: Tampil sebagai talent/host, membantu proses shooting, serta melakukan basic editing video menjadi nilai plus. Social Media Management: Mengunggah dan menjadwalkan konten, mengelola komentar/DM, serta memastikan konsistensi caption, hashtag, dan branding. Reporting & Analysis: Membuat laporan performa konten, menganalisis insight IG & TikTok, serta memberikan rekomendasi berdasarkan hasil data.

jobs.description: 1. Assessment & Konsultasi Awal PT melakukan analisis kondisi klien seperti berat badan, komposisi tubuh, riwayat cedera, hingga tujuan (fat loss, muscle gain, dll). 2. Membimbing Saat Latihan Mendampingi klien saat workout untuk memastikan teknik benar, menghindari cedera, dan menjaga efektivitas latihan. 4. Memberikan Motivasi & Support Menjadi penyemangat agar klien tetap konsisten dan tidak mudah menyerah. 5. Monitoring & Evaluasi Progress Melacak perkembangan seperti penurunan berat badan, peningkatan kekuatan, atau perubahan bentuk tubuh. 6. Edukasi Pola Hidup Sehat Memberikan arahan dasar tentang nutrisi, istirahat, dan gaya hidup sehat (meskipun bukan ahli gizi). 7. Menjaga Keamanan & Keselamatan Memastikan semua latihan dilakukan dengan aman sesuai kemampuan klien. 8. 1. Assessment & Konsultasi Awal
PT melakukan analisis kondisi klien seperti berat badan, komposisi tubuh, riwayat cedera, hingga tujuan (fat loss, muscle gain, dll).

Membuat program workout yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan klien, termasuk jenis latihan, intensitas, durasi, dan progres mingguan.

Mendampingi klien saat workout untuk memastikan teknik benar, menghindari cedera, dan menjaga efektivitas latihan.

Memastikan semua latihan dilakukan dengan aman sesuai kemampuan klien.

Mengatur jadwal sesi latihan, mencatat progress klien, dan mengelola data.

Membangun hubungan yang baik agar klien merasa nyaman dan loyal.

jobs.title: Travel & Personal Assistant (Private Household, Travel-Led)
jobs.description: We are hiring a Travel and Personal Assistant to support 1–2 principals and their family. Around half the role is travel: not booking a flight and a hotel, but designing and running complex multi-destination trips, redeeming miles and points to pay for them, and rebuilding them when plans change. The remainder is running the personal side of the household — calendar, residence, entertaining, and gifting — largely by coordination. This is an onsite role, with travel to Singapore approximately twice a month, and more often when a project or event requires it. Flights and accommodation for these visits are covered. The Position There will be 6 to 8 travel times per year mixed with personal and work purposes: 3 to 4 long-haul and 3 to 4 short-haul trips. Long-haul trips include one trip up to a month across 4 to 5 destinations. Across the year, the family is away for roughly [60 to 85 days]. The candidate is expected to plan for these trips, but will not be required to travel together on the trips. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of travel planning, including researching destinations, booking accommodations, and creating detailed itineraries. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the travel industry. Indicative split of the workload: Travel: planning, award redemption, contingency design, in-trip changes [50%] Calendar, correspondence, entertaining, and events [20%] Residence, vendors, improvement projects, household coordination [15%] Shopping, gifting, groceries, errands [15%] Responsibilities Travel design and destination knowledge Design multi-destination itineraries of up to a month across continents. Bring real destination knowledge. Know which neighbourhood to stay in, which season to avoid, which restaurants need booking months ahead, and which guide is worth the money. Where you do not know a destination, research it properly and source local expertise rather than relying on aggregator rankings. Source and vet guides, drivers, villa agents, and destination management companies. Verify them before the trip, not after a problem. Build the itinerary around the realities of a long trip: laundry, luggage logistics between cities, working with the medical team to get medication supply for the full duration, connectivity and local mobile data, currency, and rest days. Miles, points, and award redemption Manage the family's frequent flyer and hotel loyalty accounts: balances, expiry dates, status qualification, and transfer partner options across [programmes]. Book award travel as the default where it delivers value. Find saver-level availability, understand which partner space is not visible online and must be booked by phone, and know the routing, stopover, and open-jaw rules of each programme. Calculate value per point before redeeming, factoring in fuel and carrier surcharges, and be able to justify why an award booking beats paying cash, or the reverse. Understand cancellation, redeposit, and change rules on award tickets, which differ by programme and are materially less forgiving than cash fares. Know the cost of changing an award booking before making it. Contingency design and in-trip changes Hold the only authoritative version of every itinerary. When something changes, update the master document and reissue it so the client is never working from a superseded version. Produce a contingency pack for every trip. Each itinerary must be self-supporting: 24-hour direct lines for every airline, hotel, and supplier; the travel insurance assistance number; local emergency numbers. Reconfirm each onward flight, hotel, transfer, and reservation at least 24 hours ahead, during working hours. Handle changes end to end. When one leg moves, hotels, transfers, guides, restaurants, and subsequent flights all need rebuilding. Be available for genuine emergencies outside working hours. Maintain a live travel profile for each family member: passport numbers and expiry, visa status by country, loyalty numbers and tier, seat and room preferences, dietary requirements, medical notes, and insurance details. Manage visas across multi-country itineraries. Track passport validity against six-month entry rules, sequence consular appointments so nothing clashes with a departure date, and escalate early anything that will not clear in time. Arrange travel insurance and know what each policy covers before departure rather than after a claim. Coordinate the Singapore end while the family is away with the helper onsite: pet care, mail, deliveries, contractor access, and household cover. Debrief in writing after each trip: which suppliers underperformed, actual cost against estimate, and what should change next time. Calendar, correspondence, and entertaining Manage the principal's calendar, including time-zone coordination. Act as the first point of contact for vendors, service providers, and the family's professional advisers. Arrange gatherings at the apartment: menu, ordering, staffing, and set-up. Brief the helper on the plan and attend in person for larger events. Arrange larger events through external vendors: caterers, florists, staffing, equipment hire, and venue coordination. Obtain and compare quotations and manage against the agreed budget. This will be a maximum of twice a year. Arrange boat charters and day trips: vessel booking, catering, guest lists, marina transfers, and weather contingency. Manage restaurant reservations, tickets, and guest arrangements at the residence. Residence, vendors, and household coordination Liaise with interior designers, contractors, and suppliers on maintenance and improvement projects. Obtain quotations, schedule access, and check work against specification before approving payment. Attend site walk-throughs and handovers. Manage recurring maintenance: air-conditioning servicing, appliance repairs, pest control, plumbing and electrical, condominium management liaison, and warranty claims. Arrange payments for household maintenance and bills. Health, wellbeing, and pets Liaise with the family's medical team on prescriptions, supplements, and dosing schedules, and ensure the helper has clear, current, written instructions on what is prepared and when. Arrange dog grooming, veterinary appointments, vaccinations, and pet documentation, including pet travel where required. Manage gifting end to end: occasion tracking, sourcing, wrapping, cards, and delivery timing. Maintain a gift log so items are not repeated. Maintain organized digital records: contracts, warranties, insurance policies, service histories, receipts, and travel documents. Manage renewals: memberships, subscriptions, licenses, and vehicle servicing. Handle all personal, financial, and family information with complete discretion. Requirements Proven experience in travel planning, ideally within a luxury or corporate environment. A bachelor's degree in hospitality, Travel Management, or a related field is preferred but not required. In-depth knowledge of global travel destinations, logistics, and industry trends. Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask effectively. Excellent communication and customer service skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and travel planning software. Ability to work independently, make decisions under pressure, and adapt to last-minute changes. Availability to accommodate urgent travel needs and work outside of standard business hours as required.

jobs.title: Senior UX Researcher
jobs.description: About this Position: We're looking for a Senior UX Researcher with strong research expertise, sharp product thinking, and a passion for turning user insights into meaningful product and business impact. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working across qualitative and quantitative methods, and influencing product decisions through research, we'd love to meet you. Why this role is interesting At Astro, research lives close to real decisions. The problems are fast-moving and often shaped by user behavior, business needs and operational realities. In this role, you will help teams untangle complexity and turn them into a clear product direction. You will have the space to challenge assumptions, bring clarity to ambiguity, and make research useful beyond the final deck. Job Description: As our Astronaut, your missions are: Own and lead end-to-end UX research projects, from problem framing and research planning to execution, synthesis, and actionable recommendations. Partner with Product Managers, Designers, Data teams, Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and prioritize high-impact research opportunities. Translate ambiguous product and business problems into clear research objectives, hypotheses, and research questions. Design and conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including user interviews, usability testing, surveys, journey mapping, segmentation, and behavioral research. Analyze and synthesize findings across multiple data sources to uncover meaningful user behaviors, needs, pain points, and opportunities. Translate research findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy, design decisions, prioritization, and business outcomes. Communicate research findings through compelling storytelling and presentations tailored to different audiences, including senior stakeholders. Use product metrics and behavioral data to complement user research and build a holistic understanding of users. Proactively identify opportunities where research can create meaningful impact, while challenging assumptions and ensuring we are solving the right problems.

jobs.title: Business Development Officer
jobs.description: Responsibilities : Membangun hubungan strategis dengan business owner dan decision maker di industri reklame, tekstil, dan industri kreatif lainnya, bukan sekadar transaksi jual-beli. Memahami tantangan usaha klien secara mendalam: target market, kapasitas produksi, dan pola pembelian, untuk memberikan solusi yang relevan. Aktif mencari peluang baru melalui riset market dan kunjungan lapangan/kanvas ke calon klien potensial. Menyampaikan value dari solusi Laysander (bukan sekadar fitur produk) sesuai kebutuhan nyata klien, termasuk konsultasi bisnis, audit kebutuhan, dan after-sales service. Mengelola dan membina lead melalui sistem Laysander, memastikan setiap prospect ditindaklanjuti secara konsisten sampai closing dan retensi jangka panjang. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal (marketing, teknis, engineer) maupun mitra eksternal untuk memastikan setiap komitmen ke klien terpenuhi. Menjadi trusted advisor bagi klien, membantu mereka bertumbuh, bukan hanya menjual produk. Jika Anda tidak hanya mencari pekerjaan, tetapi juga ingin bertumbuh bersama perusahaan dan dalam hidup, kirimkan CV terbaru Anda sekarang. Semua CV akan diperlakukan secara rahasia, dan hanya kandidat yang lolos seleksi awal yang akan dihubungi.

jobs.title: FIELD COLLECTION - ADIRA FINANCE (CAB. TEBET & KELAPA GADING)
jobs.description: Collection Adira Finance adalah bagian divisi di PT Adira Dinamika Multifinance, Tbk yang bertugas mengelola, menagih, dan mengamankan angsuran atau unit objek pembiayaan (mobil/motor) dari nasabah yang mengalami keterlambatan pembayaran (overdue). Mereka berfungsi sebagai penagih lapangan (field collection) atau via telepon (desk collection) untuk memastikan target penagihan tercapai. Prosple Indonesia Prosple Indonesia. Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Collection Adira Finance: Penagihan (Collection): Menghubungi nasabah yang menunggak melalui telepon atau kunjungan langsung (field visit) untuk melakukan penagihan angsuran. Penarikan Unit: Melakukan penarikan unit objek pembiayaan jika nasabah tidak mampu melunasi tunggakan setelah diberikan surat peringatan (somasi). Negosiasi & Solusi: Menawarkan program restrukturisasi atau penstrukturan kembali kredit (Rehab) kepada nasabah yang mengalami kesulitan pembayaran. Administrasi: Membuat laporan harian kunjungan, melakukan survei, dan menyerahkan uang hasil penagihan atau unit tarikan ke pihak warehouse. Jenis Collection: Field Collection: Petugas lapangan yang melakukan kunjungan langsung ke rumah atau kantor nasabah. Desk Collection: Petugas yang mengingatkan nasabah via telepon atau media komunikasi lainnya sebelum jatuh tempo atau saat overdue. Posisi ini biasanya diisi oleh karyawan yang memiliki kemampuan negosiasi, komunikasi yang baik, serta memahami area kerja.

They want recommendations that build from one month to the next, and numbers that explain what happened. This role is for someone who holds that level of strategy and keeps the daily execution clean. Benefits Full employment contract (PKWTT), 2-month probation, BPJS after probation Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 Bali time, one hour lunch break Monthly one-on-one with the director and a career path written down from month one A team where content arrives ready, so account managers focus on clients and ideas

About the role

Nuances Agency runs social media and content for hospitality, wellness, beauty and lifestyle brands in Bali, France and beyond. We are looking for an Account Manager who owns their accounts end to end, from the editorial thinking to the client call. Our clients expect a point of view.   • Manage client relationships as the main contact on your accounts, including monthly calls, follow-ups, timely deliverables, and clear answers to client questions

  • Comfortable on client calls, camera on, with something to bring to the conversation

  • Available beginning of October, full-time

About us

Nuances Agency runs social media and content for hospitality, wellness, beauty and lifestyle brands in Bali, France and beyond.

Benefits

  • Full employment contract (PKWTT), 2-month probation, BPJS after probation

  • Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 Bali time, one hour lunch break

  • Monthly one-on-one with the director and a career path written down from month one

  • A team where content arrives ready, so account managers focus on clients and ideas

jobs.title: Production & Quality Staff - Electronic Product
jobs.description: About the role We are looking for a Production & Quality to be stationed at our manufacturing facility and responsible for monitoring and coordinating factory operations for Washing Machine (WM) and Air Conditioner (AC) products. This role will work closely with the Production, Warehouse, Quality, Engineering, and related teams to ensure smooth production, material availability, order completion, and continuous factory improvement. Key responsibilities Monitor material receiving and ensure material availability to support production requirements. Coordinate and monitor daily production plans and schedules to ensure production runs according to target. Follow up production orders from start to completion and resolve delays or pending orders. Monitor factory inventory, including stock checking, material classification, inventory levels, and stock optimization. Identify and minimize risks of material shortage, overstock, and slow-moving inventory. Lead the implementation of New Product Introduction (NPI), including production SOP preparation and production tools, jigs, and fixtures readiness. Monitor the overall production process and respond to production issues, process abnormalities, quality defects, and operational bottlenecks. Conduct root cause analysis and coordinate corrective actions to ensure issues are properly resolved and closed. Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency, productivity, process capability, and product quality. Develop and implement factory improvement initiatives to improve production capacity and operational performance. About you Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 2–3 years of experience in manufacturing, production, process engineering, quality, or factory operations. Strong understanding of manufacturing and production processes. Experience in production planning, material/inventory control, NPI, or factory improvement is an advantage. Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills. Good communication and cross-functional coordination skills. Able to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. Proficient in English; Mandarin is an advantage. Willing to be stationed at the factory and work closely with factory operations.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description: Mengelola akun media sosial perusahaan di Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, dan platform lainnya. Membuat dan mengembangkan ide konten kreatif yang selaras dengan tren media sosial serta target audiens. Membangun dan mengelola hubungan dengan KOL, influencer, afiliator, dan mitra endorsement. Mendukung kampanye pemasaran, peluncuran produk, acara, dan kegiatan promosi melalui saluran media sosial. Tanggung jawab utama : Mengelola akun media sosial perusahaan, seperti Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, dan platform lainnya . Membuat dan menyusun content plan secara rutin sesuai dengan target dan kebutuhan perusahaan. Mencari dan mengembangkan ide konten yang kreatif, menarik, dan sesuai dengan tren media sosial. Membuat jadwal posting serta memastikan konten dipublikasikan secara konsisten sesuai timeline. Membuat caption, copywriting, hashtag , dan materi pendukung lainnya untuk setiap konten. Mengelola dan mengembangkan KOL, influencer, affiliate, dan endorsement , mulai dari mencari kandidat, menghubungi, melakukan negosiasi, memberikan brief, hingga melakukan monitoring hasil kerja sama. Melakukan koordinasi dengan KOL/influencer dan pihak eksternal terkait kebutuhan konten dan kerja sama promosi. Memantau tren, topik, hashtag, dan konten yang sedang berkembang untuk dijadikan referensi dalam pembuatan konten. Membantu pelaksanaan campaign, promo, launching produk, event, dan aktivitas marketing melalui media sosial. Melaksanakan tugas lain yang masih berkaitan dengan posisi Social Media Specialist sesuai kebutuhan dan arahan atasan. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal SMA/S1 Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Social Media Specialist, Social Media Admin, Content Creator, atau posisi sejenis minimal 1 tahun Aktif dan memahami penggunaan Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, dan platform media sosial lainnya. Mampu mengelola kolaborasi, affiliate, endorsement, dan KOL (Key Opinion Leader). Memahami tren media sosial, content trend, hashtag, dan algoritma dasar masing-masing platform Mampu membuat content plan dan menyusun jadwal posting Menguasai Canva dan Adobe Photoshop untuk kebutuhan desain konten. Kreatif dan mampu menghasilkan ide konten yang menarik serta sesuai dengan target audience.

jobs.title: Content & Social Media Officer
jobs.description: Merancang dan membuat konten digital yang menarik secara visual, termasuk foto, video, infografis, dan artikel yang disesuaikan dengan identitas merek Dokgi Dental Clinic dan meningkatkan engagement di semua platform media sosial. Mengelola dan memperbarui semua akun media sosial perusahaan, termasuk Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, dan platform digital lainnya dengan konsistensi dan relevansi tinggi. Merencanakan dan mengeksekusi strategi konten media sosial yang inovatif untuk meningkatkan jangkauan, awareness, dan loyalitas pelanggan terhadap layanan kesehatan gigi kami. Berkolaborasi dengan tim klinis dan manajemen untuk memahami kebutuhan komunikasi dan mengubahnya menjadi kampanye konten yang efektif dan berbasis data. Memantau tren industri kesehatan digital dan media sosial untuk memastikan konten kami tetap relevan, modern, dan mematuhi standar profesional kesehatan. Menganalisis metrik dan performa konten menggunakan tools analytics untuk mengoptimalkan strategi dan meningkatkan ROI kampanye media sosial. Mengelola interaksi dengan followers, merespons pertanyaan, dan membangun komunitas online yang engaged dan suportif. Mengkoordinasikan kampanye promosi khusus, event, dan penawaran khusus melalui konten media sosial yang menarik dan tepat waktu.

jobs.title: Human Resources Coordinator
jobs.description: Job Description: The HR Coordinator is responsible for supporting the daily operations of the Human Resources Department and ensuring that HR administration, employee records, recruitment coordination, employee relations, attendance, training administration, and HR-related activities are managed accurately and efficiently. The position serves as one of the key administrative points of contact between the Human Resources Department, hotel management, department heads, and employees, while ensuring compliance with company policies, hotel standards, and applicable employment regulations. Key Responsibilities: Manage daily HR administration and employee records. Coordinate recruitment, selection, and employee onboarding. Monitor attendance, leave, and employee data. Support payroll preparation and HR reporting. Coordinate employee training and development activities. Support employee engagement and welfare programs. Assist in handling employee relations and HR inquiries. Ensure compliance with hotel policies and HR procedures. Maintain confidentiality of employee information. Support the HR Manager in daily HR operations and projects.

jobs.title: Pijat Tradisional Bali
jobs.company: Febris Hotel And Spa (Green Bali Hotels Group)
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung dengan tim Febris Hotel and Spa (Green Bali Hotels Group) sebagai Pijat Tradisional Bali . Posisi ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk memberikan layanan spa berkualitas tinggi kepada tamu kami dari seluruh dunia di lokasi strategis di Kuta, Bali. Sebagai terapis pijat tradisional, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam menciptakan pengalaman relaksasi dan penyembuhan yang tak terlupakan bagi setiap tamu. Pekerjaan ini adalah posisi waktu penuh yang memungkinkan Anda untuk menerapkan keahlian dan dedikasi Anda terhadap seni pijat tradisional Bali dalam lingkungan yang profesional dan mendukung. Tanggung Jawab Utama Memberikan layanan pijat tradisional Bali yang berkualitas tinggi sesuai dengan standar kesehatan dan keselamatan internasional serta kepuasan tamu yang optimal. Melakukan konsultasi dengan tamu untuk memahami kebutuhan, preferensi, dan kondisi kesehatan mereka sebelum sesi pijat. Memastikan area spa dan ruang pijat tetap bersih, nyaman, dan terorganisir dengan baik setiap waktu. Menjaga kerahasiaan dan privasi tamu selama proses layanan. Berkolaborasi dengan tim spa lainnya untuk memastikan pengalaman tamu yang seamless dan memuaskan. Mengikuti protokol keselamatan dan kebersihan yang ketat serta mematuhi semua prosedur dan peraturan hotel. Menjaga profesionalisme dan etika kerja yang tinggi dalam setiap interaksi dengan tamu dan rekan kerja. Memberikan rekomendasi layanan spa tambahan yang relevan kepada tamu untuk meningkatkan pengalaman mereka. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pelatihan profesional dalam pijat tradisional Bali, Hot Stone Massage, dan facial tradisional. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman kerja sebagai terapis pijat dalam industri hospitality atau spa resort. jobs.title: Sales Supervisor
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Auto Maju Sentosa membuka kesempatan untuk bergabung sebagai Sales Supervisor di Tangerang, Banten. Posisi ini merupakan peran strategis yang memimpin tim penjualan untuk mencapai target pertumbuhan penjualan dan kepuasan pelanggan. Sebagai Sales Supervisor, Anda akan bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan tim, peningkatan performa penjualan, dan implementasi strategi penjualan yang efektif. Jabatan ini bersifat penuh waktu (Full-Time) dan memerlukan kehadiran di lokasi kerja di Tangerang, Banten. Tanggung Jawab Utama Memimpin, membimbing, dan mengelola tim penjualan untuk memastikan pencapaian target penjualan bulanan, kuartalan, dan tahunan. Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan strategi penjualan yang meningkatkan penetrasi pasar dan loyalitas pelanggan. Melakukan pengawasan harian terhadap aktivitas penjualan tim, termasuk monitoring progress penjualan dan follow-up dengan klien. Merekrut, melatih, dan mengembangkan anggota tim penjualan untuk meningkatkan kompetensi dan produktivitas mereka. Menganalisis data penjualan dan membuat laporan performa untuk manajemen senior. Collaborate with shared functions (e.g., SITAC, QC, OE) to support smooth project delivery and business targets. Identify project risks, plan mitigation strategies, and manage scope changes. Ensure deliverables meet defined quality standards and company requirements. Prepare regular progress reports and provide analysis of on-site and overall project performance. jobs.title: CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE LEADER (CREW LEADER) - BATAM
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari seorang Customer Experience Leader (Crew Leader) yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Mitra Bali Sukses (Mie Gacoan) di Batam, Kepulauan Riau. Sebagai Crew Leader, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam memimpin dan mengembangkan tim customer service kami untuk memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang luar biasa. Posisi ini memerlukan pemimpin yang visioner, mampu menginspirasi tim, dan memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang standar layanan pelanggan yang excellent. Anda akan bekerja dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan bergerak cepat, dengan tanggung jawab untuk memastikan kepuasan pelanggan dan kinerja operasional yang optimal. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi kontrak yang menawarkan kesempatan untuk mengembangkan kepemimpinan dan berkontribusi langsung pada kesuksesan bisnis kami di Batam. Tanggung Jawab Utama Memimpin, mengawasi, dan memberikan motivasi kepada tim customer service untuk mencapai target layanan pelanggan yang telah ditetapkan dengan konsistensi dan profesionalisme. Mengelola operasional daily call center, memastikan semua proses berjalan sesuai dengan standar kualitas dan prosedur yang telah ditetapkan oleh perusahaan. Melakukan monitoring terhadap performa tim secara real-time, mengidentifikasi area improvement, dan mengambil tindakan korektif yang diperlukan untuk meningkatkan kualitas layanan. Melatih, mengembangkan, dan membimbing anggota tim dalam peningkatan skills customer service, product knowledge, dan soft skills yang relevan. Menangani escalation dan customer complaints yang kompleks dengan profesional, memastikan penyelesaian yang memuaskan bagi pelanggan. Menganalisis data performa tim, membuat laporan berkala, dan memberikan insights untuk optimasi proses operasional. Membangun kultur tim yang positif, kolaboratif, dan berorientasi pada hasil dengan fokus pada kepuasan pelanggan. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen lain untuk memastikan konsistensi dalam delivery dan implementasi kebijakan perusahaan. Melakukan rekrutmen, onboarding, dan performance management untuk anggota tim sesuai kebutuhan organisasi. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan: Minimal Diploma (D3) dari institusi terkemuka, preferensi untuk lulusan dengan latar belakang Management atau Business Administration. Pengalaman: Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman dalam customer service atau call center environment, dengan minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai team leader. Kepemimpinan: Kemampuan proven dalam memimpin, memotivasi, dan mengembangkan tim dengan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang positif dan produktif. Kemampuan Komunikasi: Excellent verbal dan written communication skills, mampu berkomunikasi dengan jelas kepada tim, pelanggan, dan stakeholder internal. Problem Solving: Kemampuan analytical dan critical thinking untuk mengidentifikasi masalah, mengembangkan solusi, dan membuat keputusan yang tepat secara cepat. Manajemen Waktu: Excellent time management dan organizational skills dengan kemampuan untuk mengelola multiple priorities dalam lingkungan yang fast-paced. Product Knowledge: Pengetahuan yang kuat tentang produk dan layanan kami, atau kemampuan untuk cepat belajar dan mengadaptasi terhadap informasi produk baru. Customer Focus: Passion yang genuine terhadap customer satisfaction dan komitmen untuk memberikan service excellence. Proficiency Teknologi: Comfortable dengan penggunaan tools teknologi, software CRM, dan sistem reporting yang relevan dengan industri call center. Soft Skills Tambahan: Kemampuan conflict resolution, emotional intelligence, dan resilience dalam menghadapi tekanan kerja yang tinggi. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan standar industri customer service dan leadership experience Anda. Tunjangan kesehatan yang comprehensive mencakup asuransi kesehatan untuk Anda dan keluarga. Kesempatan pengembangan karir yang jelas dengan peluang advancement ke posisi management yang lebih tinggi. Program training dan development berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan skills leadership dan technical competencies. Lingkungan kerja yang supportive dan collaborative dengan tim yang bersemangat dan dedicated. Kesempatan untuk berkontribusi pada kesuksesan bisnis yang sedang berkembang pesat di region Batam. Work-life balance yang sehat dengan kebijakan jam kerja yang fleksibel dan reasonable. Bonus dan incentive program yang tied dengan performa dan achievement perusahaan. Kesempatan networking dan exposure dengan industry professionals melalui berbagai program internal. Tentang Kami PT Mitra Bali Sukses, yang mengelola brand Mie Gacoan, adalah perusahaan yang berkembang pesat dalam industri food and beverage dengan fokus pada kualitas produk dan layanan pelanggan yang exceptional. Kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan pengalaman terbaik kepada setiap pelanggan melalui inovasi berkelanjutan, product excellence, dan customer-centric approach. Dengan kehadiran yang kuat di berbagai lokasi strategis termasuk Batam, kami terus berkembang dan mencari talent-talent terbaik yang dapat berkontribusi pada misi kami. Budaya perusahaan kami mengedepankan integritas, kerja sama tim, continuous improvement, dan passion terhadap excellence. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim memiliki peran penting dalam kesuksesan perusahaan, dan kami invest dalam pengembangan dan kesejahteraan karyawan kami untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inspiring dan rewarding. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda adalah seorang leader yang passionate dalam memberikan exceptional customer experience dan siap untuk mengembangkan karir di perusahaan yang dinamis, kami mengundang Anda untuk segera melamar posisi ini. Bergabunglah dengan tim kami di Batam dan jadilah bagian dari perjalanan kesuksesan PT Mitra Bali Sukses!

jobs.title: Social Media & Content Specialist – Multi-Brand
jobs.description: Sejati Group mengelola beberapa bisnis dengan karakter dan target pelanggan yang berbeda, termasuk Lifestyle Capital Club di bidang sport dan lifestyle, Integras di bidang B2B printing dan packaging, Garage Café di bidang F&B, serta SLT Autoboutique di bidang otomotif. Portofolio brand dan bisnis kami dapat terus berkembang ke depannya. Kami mencari Social Media & Content Specialist yang akan bertanggung jawab menjaga komunikasi social media brand-brand Sejati Group tetap aktif, konsisten, relevan, dan sesuai identitas masing-masing—baik untuk brand yang ada saat ini maupun brand baru yang dikembangkan ke depannya. Posisi ini melapor kepada Marketing Executive dan bekerja bersama Video Editor & Graphic Designer. Peran ini bukan hanya menjalankan posting atau membuat desain, tetapi mengembangkan ide, konsep, caption, dan script hingga konten terpublikasi dan dievaluasi. Kandidat juga diharapkan mampu membuat konten sederhana secara mandiri serta membantu kebutuhan komunikasi dan marketing lainnya sesuai perkembangan prioritas bisnis. TANGGUNG JAWAB UTAMA 1. Mengelola komunikasi social media berbagai brand secara harian. 2. Menyusun content pillars, kalender, dan prioritas konten. 3. Mengembangkan ide, angle, konsep, caption, dan script. 4. Menyiapkan brief untuk Video Editor dan Graphic Designer. 5. Bekerja sama membuat konten foto, video, atau desain. 6. Menjaga konsistensi identitas dan tone komunikasi setiap brand. 7. Memantau performa konten, tren, komentar, dan respons audiens. 8. Mendukung kebutuhan komunikasi, campaign, aktivasi, serta inisiatif marketing lainnya sesuai prioritas bisnis. KUALIFIKASI WAJIB 1. Pendidikan minimal D3 atau memiliki pengalaman relevan yang setara. 2. Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun mengelola social media atau content marketing. 3. Memiliki portofolio ide, script, caption, dan konten yang pernah dipublikasikan. 4. Mampu menulis dan menyampaikan cerita dengan baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia. 5. Mampu membuat konten foto, video, atau desain sederhana secara mandiri. 6. Mampu mengelola beberapa brand, kalender, brief, revisi, dan tenggat waktu. LOKASI DAN PENGATURAN KERJA Lokasi: Jakarta Tipe pekerjaan: Full-time, onsite Hari kerja: Senin–Sabtu

jobs.description: Education Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA (preferred but not always required). Experience & Qualification 5+ years of experience in finance or accounting. At least 2–3 years in a supervisory or management role. Experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and cash flow management. Experience working with accounting software and ERP systems. Experience is local and international transactions. Based in Bali, and willing to commute to seminyak. Technical Skills Financial reporting and analysis. Budget preparation and financial forecasting. Cash flow management. Leadership Skills Team management and staff development. Decision-making and problem-solving. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks. Reports to the company director.

Indonesia", "Gree Electric Appliances Indonesia adalah perusahaan pembuat pendingin udara internasional yang memadukan riset dan pengembangan, pemasaran, serta layanan terpadu. Gree Indonesia masuk ke Indonesia pada bulan Juli, 2015 dan berkantor pusat di Jakarta.", "Gree Indonesia memiliki 12 cabang yang tersebar di Pulau Jawa, Bali, Sumatera dengan kantor cabang di Jakarta, Tangerang, Bekasi, Bandung, Semarang, Yogyakarta, Surabaya, Bali, Medan, Pekanbaru, Palembang, Lampung dan terus berkembang di beberapa kota besar di Indonesia.", "Gree merupakan merek industri pendingin udara asal China yang dinobatkan menjadi \"World Brand\" (merek dunia) dan satu-satunya perusahaan pendingin udara yang masuk ke dalam \"China Top 100 Listed Company\" oleh majalah Fortune selama 12 tahun berturut-turut.", "Pada Mei 2020, Gree Electric Appliances masuk dalam daftar Forbes yang menempati urutan ke-246 dalam daftar 2.000 perusahaan terbesar dunia dan merupakan produsen AC terbesar di dunia.", "Memiliki total 14 pabrik yang tersebar di China, Brazil dan Pakistan, Gree telah mendapatkan kepercayaan konsumen atas kualitas produknya dengan tetap menjadi pilihan 400 juta pengguna global di 160 negara.", "Berbagai kategori produk yang dimiliki oleh Gree antara lain RAC (Residential Air Conditioner), LCAC (Light Commercial Air Conditioner), CAC (Commercial Air Conditioner), HA (Home Appliances). jobs.title: Teknisi (Freelance)
jobs.description: KUALIFIKASI: Pendidikan: Minimal SMA/SMK, dengan prioritas pada jurusan teknik seperti TKJ, Elektro, atau Telekomunikasi. Pengalaman & Pengetahuan: Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang yang sama, memahami dasar jaringan fiber optik (FTTH) , serta familiar dengan pekerjaan penyambungan atau relokasi fiber optik. Keahlian Alat: Mampu menggunakan peralatan teknis seperti Fusion Splicer, OTDR, dan OPM(Power Meter). Kondisi Fisik & Sikap: Sehat jasmani, tidak takut bekerja di ketinggian (naik tiang), memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik , serta bersedia bekerja dengan target harian. Ketentuan Kerja: Siap bekerja 6 hari dalam seminggu (7 jam per hari) , bersedia ditempatkan di berbagai area cakupan perusahaan , dan bersedia untuk stand by on call (7 x 24 jam) jika terjadi gangguan darurat. Dokumen: Memiliki SIM C aktif dan kendaraan pribadi. Domisili: Daerah Jambi TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB: Instalasi & Aktivasi: Melakukan instalasi internet dari ODP ke rumah pelanggan dengan menarik kabel drop core melalui jalur udara atau tembok. Melakukan pemasangan serta konfigurasi perangkat ONT/Modem dan WiFi (SSID & Password) hingga internet aktif. Melakukan aktivitas aktivasi layanan secara keseluruhan untuk memastikan pelanggan dapat menggunakan layanan tanpa kendala. Pemeliharaan & Perbaikan (Maintenance & Troubleshooting): Melakukan kunjungan rutin ke Site atau POP untuk mengecek kondisi fisik jaringan, kebersihan perangkat, suhu ruangan, hingga kondisi baterai dan Kwh meter. Mengecek instalasi luar (OSP) seperti tiang, kabel, splitter, dan aksesori lainnya. Menangani gangguan teknis seperti kabel putus, LOS, atau sinyal lemah melalui tindakan splicing atau penggantian konektor. Melakukan troubleshooting jaringan dari level Uplink Switch hingga ke FAT. Pelayanan & Administrasi: Memberikan dukungan teknis dan edukasi dasar kepada pelanggan mengenai penggunaan WiFi/Modem. Memastikan pelanggan memahami kendala teknis maupun non-teknis yang sedang terjadi. Melakukan dokumentasi hasil kerja melalui foto dan memperbarui status pekerjaan pada sistem atau aplikasi teknisi. Dalam beberapa skema kerja, teknisi juga melakukan fungsi sales IKR seperti mencari calon pelanggan, menjelaskan paket harga, dan menginput data order ke sistem.
