Misi kami adalah menyediakan teknologi pembayaran dan manajemen bisnis yang mudah digunakan, sehingga setiap merchant dapat fokus pada pertumbuhan bisnis mereka. BukuWarung mengedukasi inovasi, kolaborasi, dan integritas dalam setiap aspek operasional. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan pelanggan adalah kesuksesan kami, dan kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan terbaik serta dukungan berkelanjutan kepada setiap mitra bisnis kami.

Jika Anda adalah profesional penjualan yang bersemangat, memiliki track record yang terbukti dalam mencapai target, dan tertarik untuk menjadi bagian dari revolusi digital pembayaran di Indonesia, kami mengundang Anda untuk segera melamar. Bergabunglah dengan BukuWarung dan jadilah agen perubahan dalam mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis lokal di Blora dan sekitarnya. Lamar sekarang melalui portal karir kami atau hubungi tim Talent Acquisition kami untuk informasi lebih lanjut.

jobs.title: PLANNER MAINTENANCE
jobs.description: Some of your duties will include: The Planner Maintenance will responsible on planning, scheduling, and coordinating maintenance activities to minimize downtime, optimize equipment availability, and enhance operational safety and efficiency. Plan and oversee maintenance activities for a fleet of mobile equipment (e.g., haul trucks, excavators, loaders) and cranes. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to align maintenance schedules with operational needs. Support the development and execution of capital projects related to equipment upgrades and overhauls. Provide technical expertise and troubleshooting support for complex maintenance issues. Ensure the effective use of CMMS to enhance maintenance planning and record-keeping Maintenance Planning and Scheduling: Develop, implement, and maintain detailed maintenance plans for mobile equipment and cranes; Create and manage preventive,; predictive, and corrective maintenance schedules; Coordinate with operations and maintenance teams to minimize equipment downtime. Resource Coordination: Identify and allocate required resources, including manpower, materials, tools, and equipment; Collaborate with procurement to ensure timely availability of spare parts and consumables. Work Order Management: Generate, prioritize, and track work orders using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS); Ensure timely closure and proper documentation of all maintenance activities. Data Analysis and Reporting: Monitor and analyze maintenance performance metrics, including equipment availability, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and Mean Time to Repair (MTTR); Provide regular reports to management on maintenance activities and trends. Safety and Compliance: ensure all maintenance activities comply with safety standards, regulations, and company policies. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve maintenance processes and equipment reliability; Implement best practices and innovative solutions for enhanced operational efficiency. What skills and experience do you need? Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Relevant certifications in maintenance planning or reliability engineering are a plus. Minimum 8 years of experience in maintenance planning management as Planner Maintenance; Preferably in the mining industry or a heavy equipment environment. Proven track record of working with mobile equipment and cranes in a high-demand setting. Familiar and have extensive working years experiences for maintenance and servicing of the truck fleet and motor vehicle fleet LV (light vehicle; medium vehicle: truck, lube truck, crane, manlift, crane truck, mobile crane; crane operation; welding machine; tyre operation; genset; lighting power; compressor, etc Proficiency in CMMS software (e.g., SAP, or similar). Have strong understanding of maintenance strategies, including preventive and predictive maintenance; Knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems for mobile equipment and cranes. Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities; Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate across departments; Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively. Excellent communication skills in English both verbal and written and Advanced computer skills;

jobs.title: National Sales Manager - FMCG Company
jobs.description: Merencanakan implementasi strategi sales perusahaan secara tepat baik traditional market maupun modern market sesuai strategi bisnis perusahaan. Mengevaluasi dan menganalisa pasar secara periodik untuk memberikan masukan dalam penyusunan strategi penjualan yang tepat dan efektif. Melakukan komunikasi dengan pihak distributor untuk mengetahui perkembangan penjualan produk secara nasional. Melakukan riset dan survey terhadap pasar serta analisa produk untuk pengembangan produk, kepuasan konsumen dan penentuan harga. Berkoordinasi dengan divisi lain guna tercapainya kinerja yang maksimal. Memberi laporan kepada Managemant atas hasil penjualan dan perkembangan sales secara periodik Memaksimalkan kinerja Team Sales dalam meningkatkan penjualan. Menyusun dan mengusulkan anggaran Divisi Sales dan menjaga agar kegiatan operasional dapat berjalan dengan efisien dan efektif sesuai anggaran yang telah dialokasikan. Berkoordinasi dengan seluruh bagian terkait agar tidak terjadi over stock maupun kekosongan stock. Melakukan pengontrolan stock barang jadi di gudang dan melakukan evalusi penjualan bersama Team Sales. Mencari ekspedisi yang akan digunakan untuk pengiriman barang ke pembeli di luar kota yang tidak dapat dilaksanakan sendiri oleh perusahaan. Persyaratan: Bertanggung jawab terhadap target penjualan dan pencapaian distribution level produk sesuai dengan target yang ditetapkan oleh management baik traditional maupun modern market. Bertanggung jawab atas seluruh anggaran yang terjadi di ruang lingkup tugasnya, baik yang bersangkutan untuk kebutuhan sales dan promosi produk maupun limit kredit dan tempo pembayaran terhadap distributor, agen, penyalur, institusi maupun pemakai langsung. Bertanggung jawab terhadap sosialisasi seluruh kebijakan, peraturan dan lainnya yang berhubungan dengan penjualan produk. Bertanggung jawab terhadap nama baik perusahaan dalam hubungan dengan Distributor, Agen, penyalur serta institusi dan pemakai langsung. Memastikan SOP dapat berjalan dengan baik ( Internal & Eksternal ). Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal S1. Pengalaman sebagai National Sales Manager minimal 3 tahun. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, analisa dan problem solving yang baik. Dapat melakukan presentasi dengan baik. Memiliki motivasi dan keinginan yang kuat untuk berkembang dan mencapai hasil terbaik. Menguasai Ms. Office. Memiliki leadership yang baik.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager Modern Trade Padang - Home Based Padang
jobs.description: To develop the company’s business in the Local Key Accounts in his/her sales territory and ensure implementation of effective customer management practices Join Frisian Flag Indonesia as a Area Sales Manager Modern Trade within our dynamic Asia Business Group, where you will play a vital role in driving the growth and success of our key retail accounts. This position offers a unique opportunity to collaborate closely with our sales and marketing teams to develop and execute strategic business plans tailored to customer needs and market trends. Key Responsibilities: Develop comprehensive Customer Business Plans for assigned accounts, ensuring alignment with company goals and securing approval from the Area Sales Manager or Regional Account Manager. Drive effective implementation of promotional activities within the agreed Customer Business Plans, monitoring progress and making necessary adjustments to maximise impact and return on investment. Coordinate and support the rollout of the national promotional calendar for National Key Accounts as outlined by the National Key Account Manager, providing timely feedback and insights to enhance future campaigns. Prepare accurate and timely sales forecasts to guarantee supply continuity for your customers, collaborating with supply chain and production teams to meet demand efficiently. Conduct detailed monthly analyses of sales performance and promotion effectiveness, identifying trends, opportunities, and challenges. Provide actionable recommendations to improve sales outcomes and customer satisfaction. Monitor service levels and account performance rigorously, proposing corrective actions when necessary to maintain high standards of customer service and operational excellence. Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with key customer stakeholders, understanding their business environments, challenges, and growth strategies to position Frisian Flag Indonesia as a trusted partner. Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, supply chain, finance, and other internal departments to ensure seamless execution of account plans and to support business objectives. jobs.title: Content creator
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami perusahaan syariah mencari Talent Content Creator yang berbakat dan kreatif untuk bergabung dengan tim Marketing & Communications kami di taat.co.id. Sebagai Talent Content Creator, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam membangun peran dan memperkuat identitas merek kami melalui konten visual dan naratif yang menarik di berbagai platform digital. Posisi ini memerlukan kemampuan untuk menerjemahkan visi merek menjadi konten yang engaging, relevan, dan sejalan dengan target audiens kami. Jabatan ini merupakan pekerjaan penuh waktu berbasis di Tangerang, Banten, dengan peluang untuk berkembang dalam industri Marketing & Communications yang dinamis. Tanggung Jawab Utama Menjadi Talent di depan layar sosial media. Mengembangkan dan memproduksi konten original berkualitas tinggi yang mencakup grafis, video, copywriting, dan visual storytelling yang selaras dengan pedoman merek dan strategi komunikasi perusahaan. Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan konten di berbagai platform digital termasuk media sosial, website, dan saluran komunikasi lainnya untuk memaksimalkan jangkauan dan engagement. Berkolaborasi dengan tim Marketing, Brand Management, dan departemen lainnya untuk memahami kebutuhan kampanye dan menghadirkan solusi konten yang inovatif. Melakukan riset tren konten, audience behavior, dan best practices untuk memastikan konten tetap relevan dan kompetitif di pasar. Mengelola kalender editorial dan jadwal publikasi konten untuk memastikan konsistensi dan ketepatan waktu dalam distribusi konten. Mengukur dan menganalisis performa konten melalui metrics dan KPI untuk terus meningkatkan efektivitas strategi konten. Berpartisipasi dalam brainstorming dan pengembangan konsep kreatif untuk kampanye pemasaran dan brand awareness. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Priamuslim Berpenampilan menarik/ good looking Ekstrovert Keturunan Arab nilai Plus Penampilan Syariah nilai Plus Bisa terjun ke lapangan, karena project ada di sekitar Jabodetabek Mengetahui properti nilai plus Diploma atau Gelar sarjana dalam Desain Grafis, Komunikasi, Media Digital, Marketing, Periklanan, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Content Creator, Social Media Manager, atau posisi serupa dalam industri Marketing & Communications. Portofolio yang kuat yang menampilkan beragam jenis konten (video, grafis, copywriting) dan campaign yang telah dilakukan. Mahir dalam menggunakan tools desain seperti Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) atau Canva. Penguasaan teknik video editing dan photography untuk konten multimedia. Pemahaman mendalam tentang platform media sosial (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook) dan algoritma konten. Kemampuan copywriting yang kuat dengan pemahaman tentang tone of voice dan brand messaging. Kreativitas tinggi, inovasi, dan kemampuan berpikir out-of-the-box dalam mengembangkan konsep konten. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dengan kemampuan mengelola multiple projects secara simultan. Perhatian detail yang tinggi dan komitmen terhadap kualitas konten. Pengalaman dengan analytics tools dan social media management tools merupakan nilai tambah. Solat 5 waktu Tidak Meroko Manfaat Utama Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kontribusi Anda. Lingkungan Islami Tunjangan kinerja dan bonus berdasarkan pencapaian target. Kesempatan pengembangan karir melalui training, workshop, dan program mentoring. Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung kreativitas dan inovasi. Fleksibilitas dalam bekerja dengan sistem kerja yang seimbang antara produktivitas dan kesejahteraan karyawan. Cuti tahunan, cuti sakit, dan hari libur nasional yang sesuai dengan peraturan ketenagakerjaan Indonesia. Kesempatan untuk berkolaborasi dengan brand-brand ternama dan berkembang dalam industri yang dinamis. Tentang Kami taat.co.id adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi inovatif dalam industri Marketing & Communications. Dengan fokus pada Brand Management, kami membantu berbagai perusahaan membangun identitas merek yang kuat dan engagement yang bermakna dengan audiens mereka. Kami percaya pada kekuatan kreativitas, inovasi, dan kolaborasi dalam menciptakan kampanye yang impactful. Tim kami terdiri dari profesional berbakat yang passionate dalam menciptakan konten berkualitas tinggi dan strategi komunikasi yang efektif. Kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, mendukung pertumbuhan profesional, dan menghargai setiap kontribusi dari anggota tim. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan menjadi bagian dari perjalanan menciptakan brand storytelling yang luar biasa. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda merasa tertarik dan memenuhi kualifikasi di atas, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar posisi Content Creator ini. Kirimkan CV, portfolio konten Anda, dan surat motivasi ke tim Human Resources kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda dan kemampuan kreatif yang Anda miliki!

Kembangkan karir di industri Marketing dinamis dengan gaji kompetitif & benefit lengkap.", "content2": "

Kesempatan
Kami perusahaan syariah mencari Talent Content Creator yang berbakat dan kreatif untuk bergabung dengan tim Marketing & Communications kami di taat.co.id. Sebagai Talent Content Creator, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam membangun peran dan memperkuat identitas merek kami melalui konten visual dan naratif yang menarik di berbagai platform digital. Posisi ini memerlukan kemampuan untuk menerjemahkan visi merek menjadi konten yang engaging, relevan, dan sejalan dengan target audiens kami. Jabatan ini merupakan pekerjaan penuh waktu berbasis di Tangerang, Banten, dengan peluang untuk berkembang dalam industri Marketing & Communications yang dinamis.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  • Menjadi Talent di depan layar sosial media.

  • Mengembangkan dan memproduksi konten original berkualitas tinggi yang mencakup grafis, video, copywriting, dan visual storytelling yang selaras dengan pedoman merek dan strategi komunikasi perusahaan.

  • Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan konten di berbagai platform digital termasuk media sosial, website, dan saluran komunikasi lainnya untuk memaksimalkan jangkauan dan engagement.

  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim Marketing, Brand Management, dan departemen lainnya untuk memahami kebutuhan kampanye dan menghadirkan solusi konten yang inovatif.

  • Melakukan riset tren konten, audience behavior, dan best practices untuk memastikan konten tetap relevan dan kompetitif di pasar.

  • Mengelola kalender editorial dan jadwal publikasi konten untuk memastikan konsistensi dan ketepatan waktu dalam distribusi konten.

  • Mengukur dan menganalisis performa konten melalui metrics dan KPI untuk terus meningkatkan efektivitas strategi konten.

  • Berpartisipasi dalam brainstorming dan pengembangan konsep kreatif untuk kampanye pemasaran dan brand awareness.


Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan

  • Priamuslim

  • Berpenampilan menarik/ good looking

  • Ekstrovert

  • Keturunan Arab nilai Plus

  • Penampilan Syariah nilai Plus

  • Bisa terjun ke lapangan, karena project ada di sekitar Jabodetabek

  • Mengetahui properti nilai plus

  • Diploma atau Gelar sarjana dalam Desain Grafis, Komunikasi, Media Digital, Marketing, Periklanan, atau bidang terkait.

  • Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Content Creator, Social Media Manager, atau posisi serupa dalam industri Marketing & Communications.

  • Portofolio yang kuat yang menampilkan beragam jenis konten (video, grafis, copywriting) dan campaign yang telah dilakukan.

  • Mahir dalam menggunakan tools desain seperti Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) atau Canva.

  • Penguasaan teknik video editing dan photography untuk konten multimedia.

  • Pemahaman mendalam tentang platform media sosial (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook) dan algoritma konten.

  • Kemampuan copywriting yang kuat dengan pemahaman tentang tone of voice dan brand messaging.

  • Kreativitas tinggi, inovasi, dan kemampuan berpikir out-of-the-box dalam mengembangkan konsep konten.

  • Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dengan kemampuan mengelola multiple projects secara simultan.

  • Perhatian detail yang tinggi dan komitmen terhadap kualitas konten.

  • Pengalaman dengan analytics tools dan social media management tools merupakan nilai tambah.

  • Solat 5 waktu

  • Tidak Meroko


Manfaat Utama

  • Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kontribusi Anda.

  • Lingkungan Islami

  • Tunjangan kinerja dan bonus berdasarkan pencapaian target.

  • Kesempatan pengembangan karir melalui training, workshop, dan program mentoring.

  • Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung kreativitas dan inovasi.

  • Fleksibilitas dalam bekerja dengan sistem kerja yang seimbang antara produktivitas dan kesejahteraan karyawan.

  • Cuti tahunan, cuti sakit, dan hari libur nasional yang sesuai dengan peraturan ketenagakerjaan Indonesia.

  • Kesempatan untuk berkolaborasi dengan brand-brand ternama dan berkembang dalam industri yang dinamis.


Tentang Kami
taat.co.id adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi inovatif dalam industri Marketing & Communications. Dengan fokus pada Brand Management, kami membantu berbagai perusahaan membangun identitas merek yang kuat dan engagement yang bermakna dengan audiens mereka. Kami percaya pada kekuatan kreativitas, inovasi, dan kolaborasi dalam menciptakan kampanye yang impactful. Tim kami terdiri dari profesional berbakat yang passionate dalam menciptakan konten berkualitas tinggi dan strategi komunikasi yang efektif. Kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, mendukung pertumbuhan profesional, dan menghargai setiap kontribusi dari anggota tim. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan menjadi bagian dari perjalanan menciptakan brand storytelling yang luar biasa.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda merasa tertarik dan memenuhi kualifikasi di atas, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar posisi Content Creator ini. Kirimkan CV, portfolio konten Anda, dan surat motivasi ke tim Human Resources kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda dan kemampuan kreatif yang Anda miliki!

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: Driving growth and deliver innovative solutions for construction leaders We are looking for a high potential candidate with strong business acumen to unleash high potential at Hilti, starting as Account Manager. This is no ordinary job. Our people come from all different backgrounds with a shared dedication to high performance, consistent results and outstanding customer service. What You'll do The purpose of the role is to create value in the allocated account's portfolio through effective design and implementation of individual account strategies to build long term, sustainable and profitable relationships with the customer. The role involves professional field sales and high-level customer consultation in the Kalimantan area. The job holder needs to provide efficient solutions and technical support to customers and represent the Hilti brand in the market place. What You’ll Bring Bachelor of Engineering from a reputable University At least 2 year of sales experience or equivalent customer facing experience in the construction industry Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Dynamic personality with strong winning and high-performance mindset Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment Self-motivated and a quick learner Highly adaptable with a “can-do” attitude Valid driving license Must be available for work placements in Balikpapan What’s In It for You We’ll give you everything you need to excel in your role, including your own van full of tools and one-to-one coaching. You’ll enjoy a rare combination of autonomy and camaraderie, as you’ll manage your own diary while being part of a friendly team. We’ll give you lots of responsibility, including your own portfolio of customers, and these might be trades experts, project managers or company leaders. From there, we’ll trust you to do whatever it takes to deliver outstanding results. Go the extra mile and we’ll reward you with unrivalled training, development and career opportunities as soon as you’re ready for the next challenge. Day to day, you’ll report to your Area Sales Manager, who will also be there to help you manage your career. Why Hilti Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. Commitment to Inclusion At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together. .

jobs.title: Solution Consultant
jobs.description: Empower customers with expert advice and seamless service The purpose of the role is to achieve profitable sales by providing timely and appropriate customer service and technical expertise in response to customers' needs to ensure the successful achievement of the company objectives and growth. The role involves providing information and technical advice via telephone or e-mail on products and applications. The job holder needs to actively promote sales in cooperation with other sales channels. What You'll do 1. Well-equipped as the expert of ON!Track service and Fleet Management to understand software & hardware requirement, conduct initial assessment of customer office & warehouse setting, pitch to customers of all levels with the asset management analysis and capable to guide internal sales team in the 8-step journey from raising the top management level’s interest to customer care phase 2. Work closely with sales, sales manager, Implementation & Care Specialist (ICS) and service manager to define a list of potential customers for ON!Track and Fleet management service by leveraging existing customer relationship. 3. Lead the end-to-end selling cycle of ON!Track service and Fleet Management from customer acquisition, service implementation and retaining the customers as well as training to customers 4. Continue the momentum in driving ON!Track service after initial success to ensure we achieve long term and sustainable growth by going beyond the current customer pool What You’ll Bring 1. Bachelor of Engineering from a reputable University 2. At least 3 year of sales experience or equivalent customer facing experience in the construction industry 3. Demonstrated work experience in solution and consultative selling especially in asset management Service, with proven tangible end result. 4. Capable in working in cross-functional team environment (eg. Sales, marketing, external vendor) 5. Highly proficient in both written and verbal English 6. Highly motivated, self-starter; capable of working independently 7. Ability to develop a systematic analysis report and present it professionally to the top management level 8. A great communication skills with the customers especially to High-level Management Team 9. Valid driving license What’s In It for You We’ll give you everything you need to excel in your role, including your own van full of tools and one-to-one coaching. You’ll enjoy a rare combination of autonomy and camaraderie, as you’ll manage your own diary while being part of a friendly team. We’ll give you lots of responsibility, including your own portfolio of customers, and these might be trades experts, project managers or company leaders. From there, we’ll trust you to do whatever it takes to deliver outstanding results. Go the extra mile and we’ll reward you with unrivalled training, development and career opportunities as soon as you’re ready for the next challenge. Why Hilti Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together. .

jobs.title: Lead Engineer
jobs.description: Lead complex engineering projects from concept to completion. Lead Engineer is a customer facing role responsible to deliver charged engineering services within the scope of Integrated Project Solution along full project lifecycle from acquisition to execution to maximize project SoW. Coordinate and supervise the assigned engineering scope of the project to ensure the technical objectives are met within the approved scope, budget, and schedule. Supervise, oversee, and coordinate regular and timely technical reviews of engineering scope deliverables developed by Design Engineering team, ensuring design optimization in compliance with relevant codes, standards, and best practices. Coordination and support of other functional roles within the Project Team to resolve technical issues and ensure quality Engineering execution and design integrity. What You'll do Project acquisition Actively support the Construction Project Manager and Project Execution Manager to assess the availability of required information, the scope and the required time to perform value adding engineering services, Consult/ support the Construction Project Manager in quoting for the project and consult Framework feasibility. Project Execution Ensure quality and accuracy of Engineering and Design activities, system integration, and design selection. Supervise and manage the review and approval of Design Engineering team’s work, ensuring compliance with Projects specifications/requirements, relevant codes and external and internal standards, and best industry practices. Provide technical advisory and coordination with customer’s discipline specialists. Based on the customer requirements create design guideline/input to Modeler(s) (in/external) By request join “clash” coordination sessions as Hilti representative Ensure proper engineering documentation as per design guideline. Coordinate the required engineering participation and contribute input and expertise in developing and analysing various design options to validate and optimize Design Engineering Team’s output. Teamwork and development Provide support to Project Managers and Engineers within the Projects Management Team organization. Establish excellent working relationships with Regional LE and functional counterparts in regions. Interface with Managers, Team Leaders and Engineers in other departments, Operations Units and Fulfilment Department. Interface regularly with Design Engineers in the Value Engineering HUBs, Project Management Team, Team Leaders as and when required. Create an open working climate through the integration and motivation of others. Be the role model to develop DE`s on their career path. What You’ll Bring 1. Bachelor Degree from Technical/Engineering education (Civil/ Mechanical Engineering is preferable) 2. Min. 5 years of experience within project engineering role. 3. Familiar with working at Construction/ Industrial site 4. Experience in selling Construction/ Industrial Technical products is a plus 5. Certified through LE MasterClass is a plus 6. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 7. Good command of written and spoken English 8. Valid car driving license 9. Dynamic personality with strong winning and high-performance mindset 10. Highly adaptable with a “can-do” attitude What’s In It for You Lead high-impact engineering projects from acquisition through execution and see your solutions come to life. Work directly with customers and become a trusted technical advisor on complex construction and industrial projects. Collaborate with talented project, engineering, and design teams across regions to deliver innovative solutions. Gain exposure to large-scale, multidisciplinary projects while influencing project success, quality, and design optimization. Accelerate your professional growth in a dynamic, customer-focused environment that values expertise, ownership, and continuous development. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

jobs.description: Job Description 1. Job Requirement 1. 3+ years experience as DB Engineer/Administrator manage AWS RDS Aurora, RDS Proxy, AWS DocumentDB, AWS DynamoDB, AWS OpenSearch and AWS Elasicache 2. Experience to perform DB Optimization, such as Index optimization, query optimization, configuration tuning to improve performance 3. Have good understanding about limitation, constraint, best practices of each DB engine above 4.Experience to create scripting and automation using AWS CLI, Bash or Powershell. And Familiar using AWS SSM Document 5.Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and fast learning, able to identify and resolve complex technical issues 6.Strong collaboration in a team, capable to work individually 7.Lead improvement and optimization initiatives that align with Sampoerna/PMI Standard 8.Positive attitude and strong commitment to deliver quality work Skill Requirement Information Security Database Administration Database

jobs.title: Indonesia Remote DevOps  Platform Engineer AI first
jobs.description: The role You will own the platform that Signal and Connect run on. Today that means a Kubernetes cluster onDigitalOcean with managed Postgres and Redis, an edge layer on Cloudflare, deploys through GitHubActions and Helm, and observability on Grafana and Loki. Tomorrow it means three data-residencyzones: the existing DigitalOcean UK zone plus two greenfield Azure zones (EU and US), all managedfrom one Terraform codebase so a single config change fans out to every zone. The platform handles millions of requests across dozens of ecommerce brands, and the eventsflowing through it feed the advertising and analytics platforms our clients spend against. When itdegrades, someone's marketing data degrades with it. This is a hands-on role. You will write Terraform, debug a failing deploy, tune a Cloudflare Workerroute, and review the pipeline that ships the app, sometimes all in the same week. You will also writecode beyond infrastructure: internal tooling, automation, the occasional fix in the Flask/Celery appwhen the problem sits between app and platform. What is hard about this job Honesty helps both of us here. This is a breadth role: edge, clusters, databases, pipelines, and the appwhen the problem lands between layers. Some days you will context-switch more than you wouldlike. Incidents are not abstract, when tracking breaks, a client's ad spend is flying blind, so pressurecomes with a commercial clock on it. Parts of the platform are better documented than others, andone of your jobs is to close that gap. And a small company means fewer specialists to lean on: moreautonomy, less cover. If you have only ever run infrastructure inside a large team, think about whetherthat trade excites you. How we work People create the advantage. We think critically and try to falsify our own conclusions beforeshipping them. We bias for action: a good change today beats a perfect one next month, and weimprove iteratively from there. We own outcomes end to end. If something is broken, the person whofound it fixes it or drives the fix, regardless of whose problem it officially is. We are a small team and attitude carries more weight than skill. Skills can be learned; how you treatpeople when things go wrong cannot be taught as easily. We want someone who stays constructivewhen production is on fire, hears "this design has a problem" as useful information rather than anattack, and lets the best idea win no matter whose it was. Being wrong here is cheap and admitting itearly is respected. If you need to be the smartest person in the room, or you keep score on credit, wewill not work well together. You would work directly with the CTO and the engineering team, with a lot of autonomy and theexpectation that you use it.

This is not a first DevOps role. We need someone who has already owned production infrastructureas their job, has been on the hook for uptime, and has scars from a migration or an incident to showfor it. You will be the owner of this platform from early on, with the CTO as your partner rather thanyour safety net.
Production Terraform experience: modules, state management, importing live infrastructure. Youhave done an import before and know why zero-destroy plans matter.
Kubernetes in production: Helm, ingress, upgrades, debugging workloads. DOKS or AKSexperience helps but the concepts transfer.
Solid Postgres and Redis operations: backups, connection handling, migrations under load.
CI/CD ownership: you have built and maintained GitHub Actions (or equivalent) pipelines thatother engineers depend on.
Cloudflare beyond DNS: Workers, WAF, routing. You do not need to be an expert, but our edgelayer is load-bearing. It includes traffic filtering at the edge, and you would operate and deploythose rules (the analysis behind them is a team effort you would grow into).
Enough software engineering to be dangerous: Python and TypeScript/JavaScript are what youwill meet most.
You communicate in writing. Decisions go in the repo, incidents get clear write-ups, and what isconfirmed stays separate from what is inferred.
Working AI-first
We build with AI as a default, and we expect you to work that way too. Concretely:
You use coding agents (Claude Code or similar) as your daily working mode, not as an occasionalautocomplete. You know when to hand work to an agent and when to do it yourself.
You write infrastructure and runbooks that agents can execute: explicit steps, checkableoutcomes, guardrails in the repo rather than in someone's head. Our current runbooks are writtenthis way and we want to go further.
You review AI-written code and plans critically. You can spot when an agent is confidently wrongabout a Terraform plan or a Kubernetes manifest.
You look at every recurring manual task and ask whether an agent, a workflow, or a monitor shouldbe doing it instead. Much of our ops automation already runs this way.
If your instinct is that AI tools are a threat to craft rather than a multiplier of it, this is not the right role.
We pay for the tooling we expect you to use: frontier-model coding agents and whatever else earnsits keep. You will not be asked to work AI-first on a personal ChatGPT subscription.

You write infrastructure and runbooks that agents can execute: explicit steps, checkableoutcomes, guardrails in the repo rather than in someone's head. Our current runbooks are writtenthis way and we want to go further. You review AI-written code and plans critically. You can spot when an agent is confidently wrongabout a Terraform plan or a Kubernetes manifest. You look at every recurring manual task and ask whether an agent, a workflow, or a monitor shouldbe doing it instead. Much of our ops automation already runs this way. If your instinct is that AI tools are a threat to craft rather than a multiplier of it, this is not the right role. We pay for the tooling we expect you to use: frontier-model coding agents and whatever else earnsits keep. You will not be asked to work AI-first on a personal ChatGPT subscription.

Role Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities while growing existing client accounts. Build strong relationships with clients. Understand client needs and translate them into relevant IT solutions and business opportunities. Manage the sales process from opportunity development to closing and long-term account growth.

Pada tahun 1997, sebuah perusahaan kecil yang memasok suku cadang dan komponen kendaraan listrik untuk pasar luar negeri.

Pada tahun 2005, Tianjin SAIGE didirikan di Tianjin, yang mengkhususkan diri dalam R&D, produksi, penjualan dan layanan kendaraan listrik, khususnya sepeda listrik untuk pasar Asia.

Pada tahun 2008, SAIGE Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd. didirikan di Wuxi, Kapasitas Produksi saat ini tidak dapat memenuhi kebutuhan klien, kami harus memperluas pabrik. Jajaran produknya semakin luas, sepeda motor listrik, skuter listrik, 350W hingga 2000W, 3000W, 5000W. Menjual ke Timur Tengah, Rusia, AS, Euro.

Pada tahun 2013, SAIGE Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd di Shandong, memproduksi mobil listrik roda 3, sepeda roda tiga listrik, roda tiga listrik penumpang, roda tiga listrik kargo, sepeda roda tiga listrik rekreasi.

Pada tahun 2018, SAIGE Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd di Henan, mobil mini listrik merek kendaraan energi baru EGGOO 4 roda.

Pada tahun 2023, SAIGE mendirikan perusahaan cabang di Ekuador, yang bertanggung jawab penuh atas pembangunan merek dan penjualan SAIGE di Ekuador.

Pada 2023 Juga Saige Memperluas Lini bisnisnya di Indonesia, Melalui PT. Saige Teknologi Indonesia Yang bertanggung Jawab atas Produksi dan Pembangunan Merk di Indonesia.



Pabrik kami
SAIGE Kendaraan Listrik Technology Co, Ltd adalah produsen 6 teratas di bidang sepeda motor listrik di Cina. Pada tahun 1997, kami memulai kegiatan manufaktur di bidang sepeda motor listrik, sepeda listrik, roda tiga listrik, skuter listrik dengan baterai Lithium dan basis tenaga asam timbal, dll. Kami memiliki lima pusat manufaktur (Tianjin, Wuxi, ShanDong, Henan, Shangqiu), masing-masing pabrik yang mengkhususkan diri dalam setiap kategori, dengan lebih dari 1500 staf dan 80, 000 unit kapasitas produksi bulanan. Grup SAIGE memiliki 3 merek: SAIGE, EGGOO, produk HEEGO juga telah diekspor ke Asia Tenggara, AS, Rusia Timur Tengah, Amerika Selatan di dunia. Kami mencari grosir dan distributor di seluruh dunia.

Kami bangga karena perusahaan kami dinobatkan sebagai perusahaan misi yang bertanggung jawab oleh pemerintah. Jutaan masyarakat juga telah menikmati kualitas ebike kami dan menyapa Khalayak Umum di saluran CCTV

Pada tahun 1997, sebuah perusahaan kecil yang memasok suku cadang dan komponen kendaraan listrik untuk pasar luar negeri.

Pada tahun 2005, Tianjin SAIGE didirikan di Tianjin, yang mengkhususkan diri dalam R&D, produksi, penjualan dan layanan kendaraan listrik, khususnya sepeda listrik untuk pasar Asia.

Pada tahun 2008, SAIGE Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd. didirikan di Wuxi, Kapasitas Produksi saat ini tidak dapat memenuhi kebutuhan klien, kami harus memperluas pabrik. Jajaran produknya semakin luas, sepeda motor listrik, skuter listrik, 350W hingga 2000W, 3000W, 5000W. Menjual ke Timur Tengah, Rusia, AS, Euro.

Pada tahun 2013, SAIGE Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd di Shandong, memproduksi mobil listrik roda 3, sepeda roda tiga listrik, roda tiga listrik penumpang, roda tiga listrik kargo, sepeda roda tiga listrik rekreasi.

Pada tahun 2018, SAIGE Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd di Henan, mobil mini listrik merek kendaraan energi baru EGGOO 4 roda.

Pada tahun 2023, SAIGE mendirikan perusahaan cabang di Ekuador, yang bertanggung jawab penuh atas pembangunan merek dan penjualan SAIGE di Ekuador.

Pada 2023 Juga Saige Memperluas Lini bisnisnya di Indonesia, Melalui PT. Saige Teknologi Indonesia Yang bertanggung Jawab atas Produksi dan Pembangunan Merk di Indonesia.



Pabrik kami
SAIGE Kendaraan Listrik Technology Co, Ltd adalah produsen 6 teratas di bidang sepeda motor listrik di Cina. Pada tahun 1997, kami memulai kegiatan manufaktur di bidang sepeda motor listrik, sepeda listrik, roda tiga listrik, skuter listrik dengan baterai Lithium dan basis tenaga asam timbal, dll. Kami memiliki lima pusat manufaktur (Tianjin, Wuxi, ShanDong, Henan, Shangqiu), masing-masing pabrik yang mengkhususkan diri dalam setiap kategori, dengan lebih dari 1500 staf dan 80, 000 unit kapasitas produksi bulanan. Grup SAIGE memiliki 3 merek: SAIGE, EGGOO, produk HEEGO juga telah diekspor ke Asia Tenggara, AS, Rusia Timur Tengah, Amerika Selatan di dunia. Kami mencari grosir dan distributor di seluruh dunia.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan Menawarkan dan mempromosikan produk kepada calon konsumen di area penempatan. Memberikan informasi produk dengan ramah, jelas, dan menarik. Membantu meningkatkan penjualan sesuai target yang telah ditentukan. Menjaga display dan ketersediaan produk agar tetap rapi dan menarik. Melakukan pelayanan kepada konsumen dengan baik dan profesional. Membangun komunikasi yang baik dengan konsumen maupun pihak toko/outlet. Kualifikasi Wanita, berpenampilan menarik dan rapi. Komunikatif, ramah, percaya diri, dan memiliki kemampuan menawarkan produk. Bertanggung jawab, disiplin, dan memiliki orientasi terhadap target. Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman sebagai SPG, sales promotion, atau bidang penjualan. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Bersedia ditempatkan sesuai kebutuhan di area yang tersedia.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan Menawarkan dan mempromosikan produk kepada calon konsumen di area penempatan. Memberikan informasi produk dengan ramah, jelas, dan menarik. Membantu meningkatkan penjualan sesuai target yang telah ditentukan. Menjaga display dan ketersediaan produk agar tetap rapi dan menarik. Melakukan pelayanan kepada konsumen dengan baik dan profesional. Membangun komunikasi yang baik dengan konsumen maupun pihak toko/outlet. Melakukan pencatatan penjualan dan melaporkan hasil kegiatan kepada atasan. Menjaga kebersihan serta kerapihan area promosi. Mengikuti arahan, briefing, dan program promosi perusahaan. Kualifikasi Wanita, berpenampilan menarik dan rapi. Komunikatif, ramah, percaya diri, dan memiliki kemampuan menawarkan produk. Bertanggung jawab, disiplin, dan memiliki orientasi terhadap target. Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman sebagai SPG, sales promotion, atau bidang penjualan. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Bersedia ditempatkan sesuai kebutuhan di area yang tersedia.
Education: high school
Experience: 12 months

jobs.title: Sales Taking Order Kendari
jobs.description: LOWONGAN KERJA : SALES REPRESENTATIVE PT EAGET INOVASI NUSANTARA Tentang Perusahaan: EAGET adalah pemimpin global dalam industri memori portabel selama lebih dari 22 tahun yang berpusat di Shenzhen. Dengan semangat inovasi dan prinsip bisnis "Easy to Get" , kami berkomitmen memberikan solusi memori dan aksesori gadget terbaik melalui keahlian profesional dan integrasi sumber daya yang unggul. DESKRIPSI PEKERJAAN : Aktif turun ke lapangan untuk menjual seluruh lini produk memori portabel (SSD, RAM, Flash Drive) ke jaringan retail, grosir, maupun distributor. Mencari customer baru dan membangun hubungan distribusi yang kuat untuk memperluas market share perusahaan. Melakukan kunjungan rutin ke banyak toko perharinya 10 toko. Menjaga hubungan profesional jangka panjang dengan pelanggan lama untuk memastikan repeat order dan loyalitas brand. Mengumpulkan informasi kompetitor, tren harga, serta memberikan laporan aktivitas kunjungan harian. KUALIFIKASI PELAMAR : Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1–3 tahun sebagai Field Sales / Sales Lapangan (diutamakan pengalaman Taking Order). Wajib memiliki pengalaman dalam menjual aksesoris komputer atau HP dan terbiasa dengan karakteristik pasar toko retail serta grosir. Memiliki jaringan (database) pelanggan aktif yang luas di wilayah penempatan. Memiliki bukti kinerja pencapaian target penjualan minimal 80% di perusahaan sebelumnya.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant & General Affairs
jobs.description: Kesempatan NPP CONSULTING' mencari Personal Assistant & General Affairs yang profesional dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Jakarta Utara. Dalam peran ini, Anda akan menjadi tulang punggung operasional kami, memberikan dukungan administratif yang komprehensif kepada manajemen senior dan memastikan kelancaran operasi sehari-hari perusahaan. Posisi ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk bekerja di lingkungan yang dinamis dan profesional, di mana kontribusi Anda akan langsung berdampak pada efisiensi organisasi. Ini adalah posisi penuh waktu yang berlokasi di Jakarta Utara, Jakarta . Personal Assitant & General Affairs Tugas & Tanggung Jawab 1. Personal Assistant Membantu Management dalam kegiatan dan pekerjaan sehari-hari. Mengatur jadwal meeting, appointment, dan agenda Management. Membantu mengatur perjalanan, termasuk tiket pesawat, hotel, transportasi, dan itinerary. Menyiapkan dokumen dan kebutuhan meeting. Membantu follow-up pekerjaan dan permintaan Management kepada pihak terkait. Membantu komunikasi dengan klien, vendor, dan pihak lainnya jika diperlukan. Menangani dokumen dan informasi yang bersifat rahasia. Membantu kebutuhan Management lainnya sesuai kebutuhan. 2. General Affairs Mengurus kebutuhan operasional kantor sehari-hari. Mengatur pembelian ATK, perlengkapan kantor, pantry, dan kebutuhan lainnya. Mengurus dan berkoordinasi dengan vendor, building management, kurir, teknisi, cleaning service, dan pihak lainnya. Memantau kondisi fasilitas dan perlengkapan kantor. Mengelola inventaris dan aset kantor. Mengatur pengiriman dan penerimaan dokumen atau barang. Membantu menyiapkan meeting, acara kantor, dan kegiatan perusahaan. Mengurus administrasi umum perusahaan. Kriteria Usia maksimal 25 tahun . Minimal pendidikan SMK/D3/S1 . Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun sebagai Personal Assistant, Secretary, Admin, General Affairs , atau posisi yang sejenis. Bisa mengatur jadwal dan pekerjaan dengan baik. Cepat tanggap, teliti, rapi, dan memiliki inisiatif. Bisa mengerjakan beberapa pekerjaan sekaligus dan menentukan prioritas. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan sopan. Bisa bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) dan Google Workspace, WhatsApp, email, dan aplikasi administrasi lainnya dengan baik. Bersedia melakukan pekerjaan yang fleksibel sesuai kebutuhan Management dan Perusahaan, didalam maupun DILUAR kantor. Bersedia melakukan pekerjaan diluar jam kerja normal dan hari libur. Dapat menjaga kerahasiaan informasi perusahaan dan Management . Memiliki attitude yang baik, bertanggung jawab, dan dapat dipercaya. Nilai Tambah Bisa berbahasa Mandarin , minimal HSK 3. Bisa berbahasa Inggris , minimal CFER A2. Latar belakang Pendidikan Hukum atau Akuntansi/Pajak. Memiliki pengalaman bekerja di perusahaan konsultan atau perusahaan multinasional. Tentang NPP CONSULTING NPP CONSULTING adalah perusahaan konsultan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi bisnis berkualitas tinggi kepada klien-klien terkemuka di seluruh Indonesia. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri, kami membangun reputasi sebagai mitra terpercaya yang mengutamakan profesionalisme, integritas, dan hasil yang terukur. Perusahaan kami didukung oleh tim profesional yang berdedikasi dan memiliki visi untuk terus berkembang dan berinovasi. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami dibangun atas fondasi kerja sama yang solid, budaya saling menghormati, dan komitmen terhadap keunggulan. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari tim yang dinamis dan terus berkembang. Lamar Sekarang dan tunjukkan bagaimana Anda dapat menjadi aset berharga bagi tim NPP CONSULTING!

jobs.title: SALES AREA BALI
jobs.description: 🐾 PT SINAR LINTANG HORISON PT Sinar Lintang Horison merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang pet industry & retail, menyediakan berbagai kebutuhan hewan peliharaan serta layanan terkait pet care. Seiring dengan perkembangan bisnis, kami terus membangun tim yang memiliki semangat berkembang, profesional, dan berorientasi pada hasil. Kami membuka kesempatan bagi anda yang memiliki kemampuan sales, business development, dan relationship management untuk bergabung sebagai: 💼 SALES EXECUTIVE Tanggung Jawab: * Mencari dan mengembangkan customer baru. * Mengembangkan dan memperluas jaringan pelanggan baru, seperti pet shop, klinik hewan, distributor, maupun mitra bisnis lainnya. * Melakukan prospecting, kunjungan, presentasi, dan follow-up customer. * Membangun dan menjaga hubungan jangka panjang dengan customer. * Mengidentifikasi kebutuhan customer dan memberikan solusi produk yang sesuai. * Melakukan negosiasi dan follow-up hingga terjadi transaksi. * Mengembangkan customer existing untuk meningkatkan repeat order dan omzet. * Memantau perkembangan customer dan peluang pasar. * Membuat laporan aktivitas, pipeline, dan perkembangan customer. * Berkoordinasi dengan Admin Sales, Warehouse/Logistics, dan Finance dalam proses pemenuhan kebutuhan customer. jobs.title: SALES CANVASING - RSE
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Sales Canvasing yang energik, berdedikasi, dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim PT Mitracomm Ekasarana di Jakarta Raya. Sebagai Sales Canvasing, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengembangkan bisnis melalui prospecting langsung, membangun hubungan pelanggan, dan mencapai target penjualan yang ambisius. Kandidat ideal memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang luar biasa, motivasi tinggi untuk mencapai target, dan keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat untuk berinteraksi dengan berbagai segmen pelanggan. Posisi ini adalah pekerjaan berbasis kontrak yang memerlukan fleksibilitas dan ketangguhan dalam bekerja di lapangan di wilayah Jakarta Raya. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan kerjasama kepada UMKM, Toko Retail, Warung dan lainnya untuk penggunaan mesin EDC Merchant (Produk Sound boos) dari Warung Buku (sama seperti mesin speaker penerimaan pembayaran). Memberikan edukasi kepada merchant mengenai produk dan manfaat layanan. Melakukan canvasing dan prospecting aktif untuk mengidentifikasi prospek pelanggan potensial di area yang ditugaskan di area DKI Jakarta (Pusat, Selatan, Timur, Barat dan Utara). Melakukan presentasi produk atau layanan secara persuasif kepada calon pelanggan melalui pertemuan tatap muka dan pendekatan langsung. Membangun dan memelihara hubungan jangka panjang dengan pelanggan melalui follow-up yang konsisten dan layanan pelanggan UMKM, Toko Retail, Warung, dan lainnya yang responsif. Mencapai dan melampaui target penjualan bulanan dan kuartalan yang telah ditetapkan oleh manajemen. Mendokumentasikan setiap interaksi pelanggan, proposal, dan transaksi penjualan dengan akurat dalam sistem manajemen penjualan. Melaporkan feedback pasar, tren kompetitor, dan kebutuhan pelanggan kepada tim manajemen untuk pengembangan strategi penjualan. Mengatasi keberatan pelanggan dengan profesional dan mencari solusi yang memuaskan kedua belah pihak. Berpartisipasi dalam pelatihan produk dan pengembangan keterampilan penjualan yang diselenggarakan oleh perusahaan. Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan : Pendidikan SMA/K sederajat Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman dalam peran penjualan, retail, atau customer acquisition, terutama dalam canvasing atau direct sales (diutamakan sales FMCG dan terbiasa bekerja sebagai sales lapangan). Kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang sangat baik dalam bahasa Indonesia. Kemampuan negosiasi yang kuat dan keterampilan closing yang efektif untuk mengkonversi prospek menjadi pelanggan. Ketahanan emosional dan motivasi intrinsik yang tinggi untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan berbasis target yang kompetitif. Keterampilan manajemen waktu yang baik dengan kemampuan mengelola beberapa prospek secara bersamaan. Pengetahuan produk yang mendalam tentang kategori retail dan consumer products dianggap menguntungkan. Kemampuan beradaptasi dengan cepat terhadap perubahan strategi pasar dan feedback pelanggan. Memiliki kendaraan sendiri (Motor) dan SIM C Aktif atau kemampuan mobilitas untuk area kerja di Jakarta Raya adalah keuntungan. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Kompensasi berbasis kinerja dengan struktur komisi yang menarik untuk pencapaian target penjualan. Tunjangan insentif dan bonus bulanan untuk performa terbaik dan pencapaian luar biasa. Kesempatan pengembangan karier dengan jalur promosi ke posisi team leader atau manajemen penjualan. Program pelatihan dan pengembangan keterampilan penjualan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan profesionalisme. Lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan suportif dengan tim yang kolaboratif. Jaminan sosial dan tunjangan kesehatan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundangan. Pengalaman bekerja di perusahaan terkemuka dalam industri retail dan consumer products yang memberikan kredibilitas profesional. Tentang PT Mitracomm Ekasarana PT Mitracomm Ekasarana adalah perusahaan terkemuka dalam industri retail dan consumer products di Indonesia dengan reputasi yang solid dalam memberikan solusi bisnis berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di pasar, kami berkomitmen untuk menghadirkan produk dan layanan terbaik yang memenuhi kebutuhan konsumen modern. Perusahaan kami dibangun atas fondasi nilai-nilai integritas, inovasi, dan kepuasan pelanggan. Kami percaya pada pertumbuhan bersama dan memberdayakan setiap anggota tim untuk mencapai potensi maksimal mereka. PT Mitracomm Ekasarana menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif di mana setiap individu memiliki kesempatan yang sama untuk berkembang dan berkontribusi pada kesuksesan organisasi. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki passion dalam penjualan, motivasi tinggi untuk mencapai target, dan siap untuk tantangan di lapangan, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Lamar sekarang dan mulai perjalanan karier Anda bersama PT Mitracomm Ekasarana sebagai Sales Canvasing yang sukses dan berdampak di Jakarta Raya.

About the role

Ahli K3 Bidang Elevator dan Eskalator responsible for overseeing the implementation of occupational health and safety management systems in elevator and escalator installation, maintenance, modernization, and repair work.

Key responsibilities

  • Melakukan pengawasan penerapan Sistem Manajemen K3 pada pekerjaan instalasi, perawatan, modernisasi, dan perbaikan elevator serta eskalator

  • Melakukan identifikasi bahaya, penilaian risiko, dan pengendalian risiko pekerjaan

  • Memberikan rekomendasi teknis terkait keselamatan kerja pada pekerjaan elevator dan eskalator

  • Melakukan inspeksi lapangan serta memastikan pekerjaan memenuhi peraturan K3 yang berlaku

  • Menyusun laporan hasil inspeksi dan evaluasi K3

  • Mendampingi audit internal maupun eksternal terkait K3

  • Memberikan pelatihan dan sosialisasi K3 kepada teknisi

  • Melakukan investigasi kecelakaan kerja serta menyusun tindakan perbaikan

  • Berkoordinasi dengan Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan dan instansi terkait mengenai pemenuhan regulasi K3

  • Mendukung proses pemenuhan dan pemeliharaan izin PJK3 perusahaan

About you

  • Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Teknik Industri, atau jurusan teknik lainnya

  • Memiliki SK Penunjukan Ahli K3 Bidang Elevator dan Eskalator dari Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan RI

  • Memiliki Kartu Lisensi Ahli K3 Elevator dan Eskalator yang masih berlaku

  • Memahami Permenaker terkait elevator dan eskalator

  • Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke seluruh Indonesia

jobs.title: E-Commerce Specialist (Mandarin)
jobs.description: Job Responsibilities 1. Responsible for the overall operation of one category of smart wearables, or mobile accessories, and coordinating the operational strategies and pace of the three major platforms: Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop . 2. Independently responsible for the full lifecycle operation of the category, including product selection and testing, large-scale growth, and stable operations, and regularly producing business reviews and next-phase business strategies 3. Conduct weekly market analysis on the platform to identify market gaps in price ranges, product selling points, and content strategies, and form a list of opportunity points; Continuously track competitor trends, anticipate market trends, and develop response strategies. 4. Deeply understand the usage scenarios and needs of local Indonesian users regarding TWS and smart wearable products, transform user pain points into product requirements, and collaborate with headquarters product managers to drive implementation. 5. Responsible for category profit management, including formulating pricing strategies for different stages (measurement period, growth period, stable phase), and reviewing the profit and loss model for individual SKUs 6. Coordinate internal team resources such as operations, influencers/KOLs, platforms, and products to promote major promotions and new product launches; Identify issues promptly and promote escalation when resources are insufficient Job Requirements 1. 1-2years of experience operating e-commerce categories, focused on consumer electronics such as audio, smartwatches/bands, earphones, power banks, or mobile phone accessories is preferred 2. Familiar with the core operational logic of at least two platforms: Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop , with quantifiable category growth cases. 3. Strong data analysis skills, able to break down business issues based on traffic × conversion rate × average transaction value × gross margin framework, identify growth opportunities, and drive execution. 4. Possess the perspective of a category operator, strong product sense , able to distinguish between performance-oriented and brand seeding-based marketing strategies; practical experience in TikTok Shop content e-commerce is preferred 5. Pendidikan min. Diploma/ S1 Akuntasi/ Perpajakan Pengalaman min. 3 Tahun dibidang Akuntansi/ Perpajakan Memahami peraturan akuntansi dan perpajakan Indonesia, terutama perpajakan Orang Pribadi Menguasai Microsoft Excel/Accounting System/Coretax DJP. jobs.title: Supermarket Store Manager
jobs.description: About us Founded in 2001 in Bali, Pepito Supermarket began with a simple vision to bring a world-class shopping experience to local communities. What started as a compact neighbourhood supermarket has grown into a trusted premium supermarket brand across Bali and Lombok. Our motto — "Freshness, Quality, Customer Satisfaction" — has guided everything we do, reflecting our commitment to delivering fresh groceries, high-quality local produce, and a curated range of imported goods that meet international standards. SUPERMARKET STORE MANAGER - LOMBOK Requirements Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's degree (S1), preferably in Management, Business, Retail Management, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in supermarket, retail, FMCG, or grocery , with at least 2 years in a Store Manager or Store Assistant Manager position. Proven experience managing supermarket operations across various product categories, including fresh, grocery, bakery, frozen, beverage, and non-food . Strong understanding of sales management, sales targets, Profit & Loss (P&L), budgeting, and store productivity. Good knowledge of inventory management, stock accuracy, stocktaking, replenishment, expiry control, and shrinkage control. jobs.title: HR
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan QIANREN MEDIA INDONESIA mencari profesional HR yang berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Jakarta Barat. Sebagai HR, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan kebijakan sumber daya manusia yang mendukung pertumbuhan perusahaan dan kesejahteraan karyawan. Posisi ini adalah pekerjaan penuh waktu yang berfokus pada manajemen talenta, pengembangan organisasi, dan konsultasi HR secara umum. Anda akan menjadi mitra penting bagi manajemen dalam menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang produktif, inklusif, dan selaras dengan visi perusahaan. Lokasi pekerjaan berada di West Jakarta, Jakarta. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola siklus rekrutmen lengkap, termasuk identifikasi kebutuhan talenta, posting pekerjaan, seleksi kandidat, dan onboarding karyawan baru. Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan kebijakan HR yang efektif, konsisten dengan regulasi ketenagakerjaan Indonesia dan standar terbaik industri. Mengelola kompensasi dan benefit karyawan, memastikan program yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan budaya perusahaan. Menyediakan konsultasi HR kepada manajemen dan karyawan mengenai isu-isu ketenagakerjaan, peraturan, dan pengembangan karier. Memfasilitasi program pengembangan karyawan, pelatihan, dan succession planning untuk membangun kapabilitas tim. Menangani administrasi HR, termasuk pemeliharaan data karyawan, pengelolaan dokumen, dan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan ketenagakerjaan. Mengelola employee relations dan menyelesaikan konflik atau masalah ketenagakerjaan dengan profesional dan adil. Mendukung pelaksanaan budaya perusahaan dan program engagement karyawan untuk meningkatkan retensi dan kepuasan kerja. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Gelar Sarjana di bidang Manajemen Sumber Daya Manusia, Psikologi, Bisnis, atau disiplin ilmu terkait. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman bekerja di bidang HR dengan latar belakang konsultasi HR atau manajemen talenta. Pengetahuan mendalam tentang peraturan ketenagakerjaan Indonesia dan komitmen terhadap kepatuhan hukum. Keterampilan komunikasi yang sangat baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis, untuk berinteraksi dengan berbagai tingkatan organisasi. Kemampuan analitis kuat untuk mengidentifikasi kebutuhan organisasi dan mengembangkan solusi strategis. Keahlian dalam menggunakan sistem HR Management (HRIS) dan perangkat lunak office suite seperti Microsoft Excel dan Word. Kemampuan manajemen proyek yang solid dengan perhatian terhadap detail dan kemampuan multitasking. Integritas tinggi, kepercayaan diri, dan kemampuan untuk menangani informasi sensitif dengan kerahasiaan. Pengalaman dengan recruitment branding dan employer value proposition adalah nilai tambah. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kompetensi Anda. Paket benefit yang komprehensif termasuk asuransi kesehatan karyawan dan keluarga. Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan profesional berkelanjutan di industri HR. Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif dan mendukung inovasi dalam praktik HR modern. Cuti tahunan yang fleksibel dan tunjangan hari raya sesuai peraturan yang berlaku. Kesempatan untuk mengembangkan program HR strategis yang memberikan dampak nyata pada organisasi. Tim yang profesional dan supportif yang menghargai kontribusi setiap anggota. Tentang QIANREN MEDIA INDONESIA QIANREN MEDIA INDONESIA adalah perusahaan yang berfokus pada penyediaan solusi media dan komunikasi berkualitas tinggi. Kami berkomitmen untuk membangun tim yang beragam, berbakat, dan berdedikasi dalam menciptakan nilai bagi klien dan stakeholder kami. Dengan budaya kerja yang positif dan inovatif, kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim memiliki kontribusi penting dalam kesuksesan organisasi. Kami membuka peluang kepada kandidat dengan berbagai latar belakang dan perspektif untuk bergabung dan mengembangkan karier mereka bersama kami. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda tertarik dengan posisi ini dan memenuhi kualifikasi yang dibutuhkan, kami mengundang Anda untuk mengirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan portofolio HR Anda. Bergabunglah dengan QIANREN MEDIA INDONESIA dan jadilah bagian dari tim yang membuat perbedaan dalam organisasi kami!

jobs.description: To develop the company’s business in the Local Key Accounts in his/her sales territory and ensure implementation of effective customer management practices Join Frisian Flag Indonesia as a Area Sales Manager Modern Trade within our dynamic Asia Business Group, where you will play a vital role in driving the growth and success of our key retail accounts. Key Responsibilities: Develop comprehensive Customer Business Plans for assigned accounts, ensuring alignment with company goals and securing approval from the Area Sales Manager or Regional Account Manager. Drive effective implementation of promotional activities within the agreed Customer Business Plans, monitoring progress and making necessary adjustments to maximise impact and return on investment. Coordinate and support the rollout of the national promotional calendar for National Key Accounts as outlined by the National Key Account Manager, providing timely feedback and insights to enhance future campaigns. Prepare accurate and timely sales forecasts to guarantee supply continuity for your customers, collaborating with supply chain and production teams to meet demand efficiently. Conduct detailed monthly analyses of sales performance and promotion effectiveness, identifying trends, opportunities, and challenges. Provide actionable recommendations to improve sales outcomes and customer satisfaction. Monitor service levels and account performance rigorously, proposing corrective actions when necessary to maintain high standards of customer service and operational excellence. Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with key customer stakeholders, understanding their business environments, challenges, and growth strategies to position Frisian Flag Indonesia as a trusted partner. Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, supply chain, finance, and other internal departments to ensure seamless execution of account plans and to support business objectives. Qualifications and Skills: Proven experience in account management, ideally within the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector or related industries. Strong analytical skills with proficiency in sales forecasting and market analysis. Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of influencing at multiple levels within customer organisations. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Collaborative mindset with a strong customer orientation and problem-solving approach. A commitment to continuous learning and professional development, adaptable to changing market conditions. Why Join Frisian Flag Indonesia? At Frisian Flag Indonesia, we are committed to innovation, quality, and sustainability. Our inclusive and diverse workplace fosters growth and offers opportunities to develop your career within a company that values integrity and collaboration. As a B2C Account Manager, you will have the chance to work on impactful projects that contribute significantly to our brand's success in the Asia region.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead - F&B (Talent Pool)
jobs.description: Job Description Develop and implement marketing strategies to drive brand awareness and revenue growth. Lead and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, social media, influencer marketing, offline activations, and PR. Manage and oversee the brand’s positioning, messaging, and storytelling to create a strong market presence. Conduct market research to understand industry trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape. Collaborate with internal teams such as Sales, Operations, and Product Development to align marketing initiatives with business objectives. Monitor and analyze marketing performance metrics and optimize campaigns for effectiveness. Manage relationships with external agencies, vendors, and strategic partners. Develop and manage the marketing budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in marketing , preferably within the F&B, retail, or FMCG industries. Strong experience in digital marketing, social media, and brand management . Excellent communication and leadership skills. Creative thinker with a data-driven mindset and strong analytical skills. Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.   • Able to communicate in at least Business English level
  • Willing to mobile / travel.

jobs.description: Job Description Support the Executive Chef in managing daily bakery and pastry production operations. Develop recipes and production standards for bakery and pastry products, including artisan bread, viennoiserie, cakes, and related items. Supervise and ensure consistency in product quality, including taste, texture, and presentation. Lead and manage the production team (bakers and pastry cooks), including training, scheduling, and performance evaluation. Develop, implement, and enforce SOPs related to production processes, food safety, and hygiene standards. Collaborate closely with the R&D, Quality Control, and procurement teams to ensure product excellence and operational efficiency. Job Requirements Experience as a Kitchen operations, Sous Chef or Senior Baker in the bakery and pastry industry. Strong expertise in dough handling, fermentation techniques, cake decoration, and the use of commercial baking equipment. Solid understanding of HACCP principles, food safety regulations, and kitchen sanitation standards. Able to work efficiently under pressure, highly detail-oriented, and accustomed to high-volume production targets. Strong leadership skills with the ability to train, guide, and motivate operational teams.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager Erajaya Active Lifestyle (Talent Pool)
jobs.description: Job Description Strategic Marketing Planning Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies to support business growth and brand positioning. Analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and challenges. Collaborate with the leadership team to set marketing goals and KPIs. Brand Management Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all customer touchpoints. Plan and execute campaigns to build and enhance brand equity. Monitor brand performance and implement improvements based on feedback and analytics. Digital Marketing and Social Media Oversee the digital marketing strategy, including SEO, SEM, email campaigns, and social media management. Develop engaging content to increase online presence and follower growth on key platforms. Analyze digital performance metrics and optimize campaigns for maximum ROI. Campaign Management Plan and execute marketing campaigns for new product launches, seasonal promotions, and events. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, sales, and R&D) to ensure seamless campaign execution. Monitor campaign performance and recommend adjustments for continuous improvement. Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Develop and manage loyalty programs to drive repeat purchases and customer retention. Utilize CRM tools to analyze customer data and deliver personalized marketing initiatives. Collect and act on customer feedback to improve marketing strategies and customer satisfaction. Partnerships and Collaborations Identify and establish partnerships with influencers, media, and complementary brands. Negotiate sponsorships and collaborations to maximize brand exposure. Manage relationships with external vendors, including agencies and suppliers. Budgeting and Reporting Prepare and manage the marketing budget, ensuring efficient use of resources. Track and report on marketing campaign performance, including ROI and other KPIs. Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders based on data analysis. Job Requirements Minimum 5-7 years of experience in marketing, preferably in retail. Proven track record in developing and executing successful marketing campaigns. Strong understanding of the Indonesian market and consumer behavior. Expertise in digital marketing tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Ads). Proficiency in CRM and loyalty program management. Excellent project management and organizational skills. Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Languages: Proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English.

  • Develop engaging content to increase online presence and follower growth on key platforms.
  • Analyze digital performance metrics and optimize campaigns for maximum ROI.

Campaign Management

  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns for new product launches, seasonal promotions, and events.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, sales, and R&D) to ensure seamless campaign execution.
  • Monitor campaign performance and recommend adjustments for continuous improvement.

Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

  • Develop and manage loyalty programs to drive repeat purchases and customer retention.
  • Utilize CRM tools to analyze customer data and deliver personalized marketing initiatives.
  • Collect and act on customer feedback to improve marketing strategies and customer satisfaction.

Partnerships and Collaborations

  • Identify and establish partnerships with influencers, media, and complementary brands.
  • Negotiate sponsorships and collaborations to maximize brand exposure.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors, including agencies and suppliers.

Budgeting and Reporting

  • Prepare and manage the marketing budget, ensuring efficient use of resources.
  • Track and report on marketing campaign performance, including ROI and other KPIs.
  • Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders based on data analysis.

Job Requirements

  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in marketing, preferably in retail.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing successful marketing campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of the Indonesian market and consumer behavior.
  • Expertise in digital marketing tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Ads).
  • Proficiency in CRM and loyalty program management.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Languages: Proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Assistant Manager
jobs.description: Job Description Lead end-to-end recruitment activities to ensure timely fulfillment of manpower requirements across business functions. Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to develop annual workforce planning and recruitment strategies aligned with business objectives. Design and execute effective sourcing strategies through various channels, including talent databases, job portals, social media, employee referrals, campus partnerships, and professional networks. Drive the selection process, including candidate screening, interviewing, assessment coordination, offer management, and onboarding readiness. Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers by providing market insights, talent availability analysis, and recruitment recommendations. Collaborate with the Employer Branding team to develop and execute initiatives that strengthen the company's employer value proposition and attract top talent. Monitor recruitment metrics and hiring performance to identify opportunities for process improvement and optimize hiring outcomes. Ensure a positive candidate and hiring manager experience throughout the recruitment journey. Stay updated on industry trends, talent market dynamics, and competitor hiring practices within the retail fashion industry. Job Requirements Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition with proven exposure to full-cycle recruitment and stakeholder management. Experience recruiting for Retail Fashion is highly preferred. Strong capability in workforce planning, talent sourcing, interviewing, and offer management. Experience working closely with senior stakeholders and hiring managers across multiple business functions. Strong understanding of employer branding initiatives and talent attraction strategies. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and recruitment reporting/analytics. Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, both written and verbal. Agile, proactive, and able to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Data Analyst & Monitoring Supervisor - Palembang (Talent Pool)
jobs.description: Job Description 1. Perform target setting for value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand, by depot, by sales (distribution channel) 2. Setting sales targets per BU, by store by category (retail channel) 3. Monitoring the achievement of target value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand, by depot, by sales. 4. Conduct an analysis of productivity in achieving target value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand by depot by sales and create a proposal plan for improvement. 5. Monitoring the productivity of dealers (both new dealers and existing dealers) 6. Conduct monitoring and analysis of sales achievements per Business Unit, by store by category. 7. Conduct an analysis of the profitability of stores in each channel, whether multibrand, monobrand, or joint business, to create a development plan. 8. Providing the required reports for the business, whether daily, weekly, or monthly reports, which will be used by the sales team in planning. 9. Creating a visual report or dashboard related to sales data and customers 10. Conducting an analysis of customer dynamics to provide business improvement proposals to be implemented in retail or distribution channels. 11. To develop and propose a project improvement in reporting Job Requirements 1. Educational background in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field are welcomed to apply 2. 1–2 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Monitoring Officer, or in a related analytical role. 3. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and basic data analysis. 4. Capable of visualizing data and turning insights into clear, engaging presentations. 5. Experienced in using Canva, Google Slides, PowerPoint, or similar tools for creating reports and visual storytelling. 6. Able to use data tools such as SQL, Power BI, or Tableau is a must 7. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. 8. Strong communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, including written and verbal. 9. Willing to work fully from office in Palembang (South Sumatra)

Pada tahun 2018, SAIGE Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd di Henan, mobil mini listrik merek kendaraan energi baru EGGOO 4 roda.
